Triggers
  actual_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.actual_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON actual FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id int default null;
if (old.task_class = 'Task') then
	select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id
		from s2_prodn.task as t
			left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
			left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
            where t.task_id = old.task_id;
	     
	call triggercall_auto_task(old.task_id, 'Actual');
    call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Actual');
	call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'ActAssgnAlloc');
	call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
end if;
END;
  actual_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.actual_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON actual FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id int default null;
if (new.task_class = 'Task') then
	select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id
		from s2_prodn.task as t
			left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
			left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
            where t.task_id = new.task_id;
    call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Actual'); 
	call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Actual'); 
    call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'ActAssgnAlloc');
    call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
  
end if;
END;
  actual_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.actual_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON actual FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id int default null;
if (!(new.person_id <=> old.person_id) 
	or !(new.task_class <=> old.task_class)
    or !(new.task_id <=> old.task_id)
    or !(new.hours <=> old.hours)) 
	and new.task_class = 'Task' then
	select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id
		from s2_prodn.task as t
			left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
			left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
            where t.task_id = new.task_id;
	call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Actual');
    call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Actual');
	call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'ActAssgnAlloc');
	call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
 
end if;
END;

Triggers
  actual1_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.actual1_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON actual1 FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 declare day_in_time, day_out_time timestamp;
 set new.der_day_id = (select day_id from s2_prodn.timecard_date1 where td_id = new.td_id);
 if new.end_time_lt <= new.start_time_lt then
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End time cannot be earlier than start time.";
 end if;
 if round((timestampdiff(minute,new.start_time_lt,new.end_time_lt)/60),2) > 24 then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End time cannot be more than 24 hours after start time.";
 end if;
 
 select in_time,out_time into day_in_time,day_out_time from timecard_date1 where td_id= new.td_id;
 if (new.start_time_lt < day_in_time) or (new.start_time_lt > day_out_time) 
	or (new.end_time_lt > day_out_time) or (new.end_time_lt < day_in_time) then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "An activity cannot occur outside of the start-of-day and end-of-day window.";
 end if;
END;
  actual1_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.actual1_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON actual1 FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
declare day_in_time, day_out_time timestamp;
if !(new.end_time_lt <=> old.end_time_lt) or !(new.start_time_lt <=> old.start_time_lt) then
	if new.end_time_lt <= new.start_time_lt then
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End time cannot be earlier than start time.";
	end if;
    if round((timestampdiff(minute,new.start_time_lt,new.end_time_lt)/60),2) > 24 then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End time cannot be more than 24 hours after start time.";
	end if;
    
    select in_time,out_time into day_in_time,day_out_time from timecard_date1 where td_id= new.td_id;
	if (new.start_time_lt < day_in_time) or (new.start_time_lt > day_out_time) 
	or (new.end_time_lt > day_out_time) or (new.end_time_lt < day_in_time) then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "An activity cannot occur outside of the start-of-day and end-of-day window.";
	end if;
end if;
END;

  affiliation_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.affiliation_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON affiliation FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	
	-- call triggercall_person(old.person_id,'Affiliation');
    SET @affiliation_count  = (select count(*) from s2_prodn.affiliation where person_id = old.person_id);
    IF @affiliation_count = 0 THEN 
        update s2_prodn.person as p
			set p.der_cur_affil_is_active =  null,
			p.der_cur_affil_id = null,
			p.der_badge_id = null, 
			p.der_nickname = null, 
			p.der_cur_affil_type = null,  
			p.der_active_dir_name =  null, 
			p.der_bot_internal_email = null,
			p.der_bot_external_email = null, 
			p.der_shotbot_userid = null, 
			p.der_cur_affil_start_date = null
            where p.person_id = old.person_id;
	ELSE 
		call triggercall_person(old.person_id,'Affiliation');
	END IF;
END;

Triggers
  assignment_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.assignment_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON assignment FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id, t_person_id int default null;
select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id, t.person_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id, t_person_id
	from s2_prodn.task as t
		left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
		left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where t.task_id = old.task_id;
        
call triggercall_auto_week_person(t_person_id, old.day_id,'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_task(old.task_id, 'Assigned'); 
call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'ActAssgnAlloc');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
  
END;
  assignment_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.assignment_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON assignment FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id, t_person_id int default null;
select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id, t.person_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id, t_person_id
	from s2_prodn.task as t
		left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
		left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where t.task_id = new.task_id;

call triggercall_auto_week_person(t_person_id, new.day_id,'Assigned');
        
call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'ActAssgnAlloc');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Full');
END;
  assignment_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.assignment_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON assignment FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id, t_person_id int default null;
select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id, t.person_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id, t_person_id
	from s2_prodn.task as t
		left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
		left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where t.task_id = new.task_id;
        
call triggercall_auto_week_person(t_person_id, new.day_id,'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Assigned');
call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'ActAssgnAlloc');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Full');
END;
Options
ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COMMENT='Created 2/15/20 by Hitesh'

Foreign Key

Referring Foreign Key
fk_billing_item_authorization auth_id ↙ ❏ billing_item
Triggers
  authorization_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.authorization_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON authorization FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	call triggercall_authorization(old.auth_id);
END;
  authorization_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.authorization_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON authorization FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	call triggercall_authorization(new.auth_id);
    
    
    if not isnull(new.client_PO) then
		update billing_item set client_PO = NEW.client_PO where auth_id=NEW.auth_id;
	end if;
END;
  authorization_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.authorization_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON authorization FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	call triggercall_authorization(new.auth_id);
    
    
    	if not isnull(new.client_PO) then
		update billing_item set client_PO = NEW.client_PO where auth_id=NEW.auth_id;
	end if;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON bid FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
/* Added by Hitesh 10MAR22 
	if show_id changes, update all of the billing_item der_show_id fields for all 
    affected bins */
    
if !(new.show_id <=> old.show_id) then
	update billing_item as bi
		set bi.der_show_id = new.show_id
        where bi.bid_id = new.bid_id;
end if;
END;

Triggers
  bid_prop_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON bid_prop FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
if new.prop_stage <> "WIP" then
	update bid_prop_item as bpi left join quote as q on (bpi.quote_id = q.quote_id)
		set q.`locked` = 1
		where bpi.bid_prop_id = new.bid_prop_id;
        
else 
	update quote as q left join bid_prop_item as bpi on (bpi.quote_id = q.quote_id)
    left join billing_item as bi on (q.bin = bi.bin)
		set q.locked = 
        (select ifnull(max(if(bp2.prop_stage != "WIP",1,0)),0) from bid_prop_item as bpi2 left join bid_prop as bp2 on (bpi2.bid_prop_id = bp2.bid_prop_id)
			where bpi2.quote_id = q.quote_id and bp2.bid_prop_id != new.bid_prop_id
            group by bpi2.quote_id)
	where bi.`status` != "Authorized" and bpi.bid_prop_id = new.bid_prop_id;
end if;
END;
  bid_prop_BEFORE_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON bid_prop FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

	if old.prop_stage != "WIP" then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
			SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "Cannot delete a Proposal that is not in WIP stage.";
    end if;
END;
  bid_prop_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON bid_prop FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

	if old.prop_stage != "WIP" and new.prop_stage <=> old.prop_stage then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
			SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "Cannot update a Proposal that is not in WIP stage.";
    end if;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_item_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON bid_prop_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    declare target_bin_status varchar(45) default null;
    
    
    select `status` into target_bin_status from billing_item where quote_id = old.quote_id;
    if target_bin_status != "Authorized" then
		update quote set `locked` = 0 where quote_id = old.quote_id;
	end if;
END;
  bid_prop_item_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_item_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON bid_prop_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

    declare target_prop_stage varchar(45) default null;
    
    
    select prop_stage into target_prop_stage from bid_prop where bid_prop_id = new.bid_prop_id;
    if target_prop_stage != "WIP" then
		update quote set quote.`locked` = 1 where quote_id = new.quote_id;
	end if;
    
END;
  bid_prop_item_BEFORE_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_item_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON bid_prop_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

	Declare current_prop_stage enum('WIP','Submitted','Evaluated','Void');
    
    
	select prop_stage into current_prop_stage 
		from bid_prop where bid_prop_id=old.bid_prop_id;
     
	
	if current_prop_stage != "WIP" then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
			SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "Cannot delete a Proposal Item for a Proposal that is not in WIP stage.";
    end if;
END;
  bid_prop_item_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_item_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON bid_prop_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

 Declare bin_show_id, bid_show_id int default null;
 Declare target_bid_prop_stage varchar(45) default null;
 Declare quote_bin int default null;
 Declare conflict_bin_count int default 0;
 declare is_net_price_empty bool default 0;
  Declare msg text;
  
  
 
 select b.show_id,bi.bin into bin_show_id, quote_bin
	from quote as q left join billing_item as bi on (q.bin = bi.bin)
    left join bid b on (b.bid_id = bi.bid_id)
          where q.quote_id = new.quote_id;
  
  set new.der_bin = quote_bin;
 
 select show_id,prop_stage into bid_show_id,target_bid_prop_stage 
 from bid_prop where bid_prop_id = new.bid_prop_id;
 
 
 if target_bid_prop_stage != "WIP" then
	SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
		SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 
        "Cannot add proposal items to a non-WIP stage proposal.";
 End If;
 
 
 
 if bid_show_id != bin_show_id then
 	set msg = concat("The given Quote ID (",new.quote_id,") is not from the same Show ID as the Proposal.");
	SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
		SET MESSAGE_TEXT = msg;
 End If;
 
 
 
 select isnull(net_price) into is_net_price_empty from quote where quote_id = new.quote_id;
 if is_net_price_empty then
  	SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
		SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "The selected quote does not have a price associated with it.";
 End If;
 
END;
  bid_prop_item_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.bid_prop_item_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON bid_prop_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
  
 Declare quote_show_id, prop_show_id int default null;
 Declare quote_bin int default null;
 Declare conflict_bin_count int default 0;
 Declare current_prop_stage enum('WIP','Submitted','Evaluated','Void');
 Declare msg text;
 
 
 
 select b.show_id,bi.bin into quote_show_id, quote_bin
	from quote as q 
    left join billing_item as bi on (q.bin = bi.bin)
    left join bid as b on (bi.bid_id = b.bid_id)
          where q.quote_id = new.quote_id;
  
  set new.der_bin = quote_bin;
  
 select show_id into prop_show_id from bid_prop where bid_prop_id = new.bid_prop_id;
 
 
 if prop_show_id != quote_show_id then
	set msg = concat("The given Quote ID (",new.quote_id,") is not from the same Show ID as the Proposal.");
	SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
		SET MESSAGE_TEXT = msg;
 End If;
 
 
 
 select prop_stage into current_prop_stage 
		from bid_prop where bid_prop_id=new.bid_prop_id;
        
 
 if current_prop_stage != "WIP" then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
			SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "Cannot update a Proposal Item for a Proposal that is not in WIP stage.";
  end if;
END;

Triggers
  billing_item_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.billing_item_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON billing_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	call triggercall_billing_item(old.bin);
        
    call triggercall_auto_billing_item(old.bin);
    
       
    insert into billing_item_history
		(bin, crud, updated_on, updated_by)
		values (old.bin, "Delete", now(), old.initialentry_by);
		
END;
  billing_item_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.billing_item_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON billing_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	
    
    update quote set quote_scope = NEW.client_service_desc where quote_id = NEW.quote_id;
    
    call triggercall_billing_item(new.bin);
    
    
    call triggercall_auto_billing_item(new.bin);
    
    
    insert into billing_item_history
		(bin, crud, updated_on, updated_by, obj_name, quote_id, service_type_id, service_label, group_name,
			shot_frame_start, shot_frame_end, shot_frame_count, auth_id, seq_number, `status`,
            client_po, obj_description, client_service_desc, final_due)
		values (new.bin, "Insert", now(), new.initialentry_by, new.obj_name, new.quote_id, new.service_type_id,
				new.service_label, new.group_name, new.shot_frame_start, new.shot_frame_end, new.shot_frame_count,
                new.auth_id, new.seq_number, new.`status`, new.client_po, new.obj_description, new.client_service_desc, new.final_due);
		
END;
  billing_item_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.billing_item_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON billing_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

    
	
	call triggercall_billing_item(new.bin);
    
	
	if !(new.bid_id <=> old.bid_id) or !(new.status <=> old.status) or !(new.auth_id <=> old.auth_id)
		or !(new.service_type_id <=> old.service_type_id) or !(new.quote_id <=> old.quote_id) then
		call triggercall_auto_billing_item(new.bin);
	end if;
    
       
    insert into billing_item_history
		(bin, crud, updated_on, updated_by, obj_name, quote_id, service_type_id, service_label, group_name,
			shot_frame_start, shot_frame_end, shot_frame_count, auth_id, seq_number, `status`,
            client_po, obj_description, client_service_desc, final_due)
		values (new.bin, "Update", now(), new.lastupdated_by, new.obj_name, new.quote_id, new.service_type_id,
				new.service_label, new.group_name, new.shot_frame_start, new.shot_frame_end, new.shot_frame_count,
                new.auth_id, new.seq_number, new.`status`, new.client_po, new.obj_description, new.client_service_desc, new.final_due);
		
END;
  billing_item_BEFORE_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.billing_item_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON billing_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	if (old.`status` = "Authorized")    then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
			SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Billing item cannot be deleted because it is locked (Authorized).';
    end if;
        
END;
  billing_item_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.billing_item_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON billing_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    declare q_bin int default null;
	declare obj_name_show_repeat_count int default 0;
	declare obj_name_bid_repeat_count int default 0;
    declare target_show_id int default null;
  
	if not isnull(new.auth_id) then
		set new.`status` = 'Authorized';
	else 
		if new.`status`='Authorized' then
			set new.`status` = null;
		end if;
	end if;
	
    /* Added by Hitesh 10MAR22 */
	select show_id into target_show_id from bid where bid_id = new.bid_id;
	set new.der_show_id = target_show_id;
    
  
END;
  billing_item_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.billing_item_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON billing_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	declare target_show_id int default null;
    
	if not isnull(new.auth_id) then
		set new.`status` = 'Authorized';
	else 
		if new.`status`='Authorized' then
			set new.`status` = null;
		end if;
	end if;
    
	/* Added by Hitesh 10MAR22 */
	if !(new.bid_id <=> old.bid_id) then
		select show_id into target_show_id from bid where bid_id = new.bid_id;
		set new.der_show_id = target_show_id;
	end if;
END;

  ingest_job_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.ingest_job_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON ingest_job FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	
    select s.show_name, a.account_id, a.nickname into @show_name, @client_id, @client_name from s2_prodn.`show` s 
     left join s2_prodn.account a on a.account_id = s.account_id
    where s.show_id = new.show_id ;
    
    set new.client_id = @client_id;
    
END;
  ingest_job_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.ingest_job_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON ingest_job FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
if new.show_id <> old.show_id then
    select s.show_name, a.account_id, a.nickname into @show_name, @client_id, @client_name from s2_prodn.`show` s 
     left join s2_prodn.account a on a.account_id = s.account_id
    where s.show_id = new.show_id ;
    
    set new.client_id = @client_id;
end if;
END;

Referring Foreign Key

Triggers
  invoice_item_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.invoice_item_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON invoice_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
  call triggercall_auto_invoice_item(old.inv_item_id);
  call triggercall_auto_billing_item(old.bin);
END;
  invoice_item_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.invoice_item_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON invoice_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
  call triggercall_auto_invoice_item(new.inv_item_id);
  call triggercall_auto_billing_item(new.bin);
END;
  invoice_item_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.invoice_item_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON invoice_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	if  !(new.inv_item_id <=> old.inv_item_id) then
		call triggercall_auto_invoice_item(old.inv_item_id);
	end if;
    if  !(new.bin <=> old.bin) then
        call triggercall_auto_billing_item(old.bin);    
    end if;
	if !(new.inv_amount <=> old.inv_amount) or !(new.item_category <=> old.item_category) 
		or !(new.der_paid_to_date <=> old.der_paid_to_date)	or !(new.bin <=> old.bin) 
        or !(new.inv_item_id <=> old.inv_item_id) then
        call triggercall_auto_invoice_item(new.inv_item_id);
        call triggercall_auto_billing_item(new.bin);
	end if;
END;
Options
ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=223300 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3

Table note
IdxColumn NameDefinitionDescription
* note_id INT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT

Triggers
  note_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.note_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON note FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
case old.assoc_element
	when 'Show' then
		call triggercall_auto_show(old.show_id, 'Note');
	when 'Object' then
		call triggercall_auto_object(old.object_id, 'Note');
	when 'Service' then
		call triggercall_auto_service(old.service_id, 'Note');
	when 'Task' then
		call triggercall_auto_task(old.task_id, 'Note');
	else set @a:=old.assoc_element;
end case;
END;
  note_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.note_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON note FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
case new.assoc_element
	when 'Show' then
		call triggercall_auto_show(new.show_id, 'Note');
	when 'Object' then
		call triggercall_auto_object(new.object_id, 'Note');
	when 'Service' then
		call triggercall_auto_service(new.service_id, 'Note');
	when 'Task' then
		call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Note');
		
	else set @a:=new.assoc_element;
		
end case;
END;
  note_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.note_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON note FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

if (new.service_id is not null) then
	SET new.object_id = 
		(select ob.object_id from s2_prodn.object ob left join s2_prodn.service se on ob.object_id=se.object_id where se.service_id = new.service_id);
end if;
if (new.task_id is not null) then
	set new.service_id = (select se.service_id from s2_prodn.service se left join s2_prodn.task tk on se.service_id = tk.service_id where tk.task_id=new.task_id);
	set new.object_id = (select ob.object_id from s2_prodn.object ob left join s2_prodn.service se on ob.object_id=se.object_id where se.service_id = @service);
end if;
END;
Options
ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=38085 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3

	if 	!(new.show_id <=> old.show_id)

        or !(new.reference_pub_id <=> old.reference_pub_id)

CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.payment_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON payment FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
if (new.paid_amount) then
	set new.allocation_gap = new.paid_amount - (select sum(item_alloc_payment) as alloc_total from s2_prodn.payment_item where payment_id = new.payment_id);
    end if;
END;
  payment_BEFORE_UPDATE

	if !(new.paid_amount <=> old.paid_amount) then
		set new.allocation_gap = new.paid_amount - (select sum(item_alloc_payment) as alloc_total from s2_prodn.payment_item where payment_id = new.payment_id);
    end if;
END;

Triggers
  payment_item_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.payment_item_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON payment_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	update invoice_item as ii
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = 0
			where inv_item_id = old.inv_item_id;
	 with a as (select sum(item_alloc_payment) as paid_to_date
			from payment_item where inv_item_id = old.inv_item_id
			group by inv_item_id)
	 update invoice_item as ii, a 
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = a.paid_to_date
			where inv_item_id = old.inv_item_id;
	call triggercall_payment_item(old.payment_id);
END;
  payment_item_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.payment_item_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON payment_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	update invoice_item as ii
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = 0
			where inv_item_id = new.inv_item_id;
	 with a as (select sum(item_alloc_payment) as paid_to_date
			from payment_item where inv_item_id = new.inv_item_id
			group by inv_item_id)
	 update invoice_item as ii, a 
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = a.paid_to_date
			where inv_item_id = new.inv_item_id;
	call triggercall_payment_item(new.payment_id);
END;
  payment_item_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.payment_item_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON payment_item FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    
	 update invoice_item as ii
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = 0
			where inv_item_id = old.inv_item_id;
	 with a as (select sum(item_alloc_payment) as paid_to_date
			from payment_item where inv_item_id = old.inv_item_id
			group by inv_item_id)
	 update invoice_item as ii, a 
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = a.paid_to_date
			where inv_item_id = old.inv_item_id;
            
     with a as (select sum(item_alloc_payment) as paid_to_date
			from payment_item where inv_item_id = new.inv_item_id
			group by inv_item_id)
	 update invoice_item as ii, a 
			set ii.der_paid_to_date = a.paid_to_date
			where inv_item_id = new.inv_item_id;
	call triggercall_payment_item(new.payment_id);
	
END;

CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.role_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON person_role FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	
    /*
	declare t_person_id int default null;
    
    select a.person_id into t_person_id 
		from s2_prodn.`person_role` as r 
        join s2_prodn.affiliation as a on (a.affiliation_id = r.affiliation_id)
        where r.role_id = old.role_id;
      */  
	-- call s2_prodn.triggercall_person(t_person_id, 'Role');
    declare t_person_id int default null;
    select person_id into t_person_id from
		s2_prodn.affiliation 
		where affiliation_id = old.affiliation_id;
    update s2_prodn.person as p
			set p.der_cur_role_type = null, 
				p.der_cur_dept_label = null, 
				p.der_cur_billable = null
			where p.person_id = t_person_id;
END;
  role_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.role_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON person_role FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	
    declare t_person_id int default null;
    
    select a.person_id into t_person_id 
		from s2_prodn.`person_role` as r 
        join s2_prodn.affiliation as a on (a.affiliation_id = r.affiliation_id)
        where r.role_id = new.role_id;
        
	 call triggercall_person(t_person_id, 'Role'); 
END;
  role_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.role_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON person_role FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
	
     declare t_person_id int default null;
    
    select a.person_id into t_person_id 
		from s2_prodn.`person_role` as r 
        join s2_prodn.affiliation as a on (a.affiliation_id = r.affiliation_id)
        where r.role_id = new.role_id;
        
	call s2_prodn.triggercall_person(t_person_id, 'Role'); 
    
END;

Table published
IdxColumn NameDefinitionDescription
* pub_id INT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT
* assoc_element ENUM('Show','Object','Service','Task')

object_id INT UNSIGNED
service_id INT UNSIGNED
task_id INT UNSIGNED
* pub_class ENUM('Client Provided','Partner Provided','Internal','For Delivery')
  pub_label VARCHAR(45) The label for this publish. It must be unqiue within the associated entity (show, object, service, task). The format for the label is not enforced. However, it should follow some conventions for internal clarity.
* pub_status ENUM('Submitted','Processing','Rejected','Completed') DEFAULT 'Submitted'
  publish_processing_failure_code INT A code representing the reason for failure of publish process or warning code.\\\
E.g. File could not be found in Storage or Files could not be converted to proxy media (if playable media)
  pub_init_note TINYTEXT
* pub_on TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  calc_pub_on_yrweek INT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (yearweek(`pub_on`, 3))
* pub_person_id INT UNSIGNED
* file_name VARCHAR(128)
  file_ext VARCHAR(8)
* file_category ENUM('Movie','Image Seq','Image','DCC Source','Text','Data','Other') This category determined how the published item is treated at the 'publish' event., and how it is presented in the UI.
Mapping:
Movie - .mov , .mp4 ...
Image Seq - .exr, .dpx, .tif, .jpg, .png ...
Image - .jpg, .png, .gif, .tif, ...
DCC Source - .nk, .sfx, .3de, .ma, .mb, .obj, .rv, .psd, .ai ...
Text - .txt, .rtf, .doc, ...
Data - .csv, .json, .xls, ...
Other - rest of file types
  calc_is_playable TINYINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (if((`file_category` in (_utf8mb3'Movie', _utf8mb3'Image Seq', _utf8mb3'Image')), 1, 0))
  file_path VARCHAR(255)
  file_source ENUM('BOT Central','BOT Staging')
  file_count INT UNSIGNED
  file_size BIGINT
  file_created_on TIMESTAMP
  file_modified_on TIMESTAMP
  last_audited_by ENUM('Script1','Script2','Script3')
  last_audited_on TIMESTAMP
* is_link_broken TINYINT
  is_pub_file_changed TINYINT
  thumb_mediafile_id BINARY(16)
  proxyqt_mediafile_id BINARY(16)
  proxyqt_frames INT
  proxyqt_duration VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci
  deliv_full_ver_number INT UNSIGNED If this is 'for delivery' pub_class, and is a full version (i.e. not a WIP or v0 or Temp deliv), then indicate the iteration number of the delivery (which should be the version number). If it is anything but a full delivery version, then put 0 here.
If it is not 'for delivery' keep null..
  initialentry TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
* initialentry_by INT UNSIGNED

* lastupdated_by INT UNSIGNED
  der_note_count SMALLINT UNSIGNED

  price_discount DECIMAL(10,2)

Triggers
  quote_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.quote_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON quote FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
declare b int default null;
select bin into b from billing_item where quote_id = old.quote_id;
call triggercall_auto_billing_item(b);
END;
  quote_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.quote_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON quote FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
declare b int default null;
if !(new.net_price <=> old.net_price) then
	select bin into b from billing_item where quote_id = new.quote_id;
    call triggercall_auto_billing_item(b); 
end if;
END;
  quote_BEFORE_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.quote_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON quote FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 
 if OLD.`locked` = 1 then
	SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
		SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Quote cannot be deleted because it is locked.';
 End If;
END;
  quote_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.quote_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON quote FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
END;
  quote_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.quote_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON quote FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
  
  
  
 
 if(old.locked = 1 and 
	(new.bin 			!= old.bin or
    new.quote_label 	!= old.quote_label or
    new.quote_scope 	!= old.quote_scope or
    new.client_quote_notes != old.client_quote_notes or
    new.working_start 	!= old.working_start or
    new.working_end 	!= old.working_end or
	new.working_count 	!= old.working_count or
    new.client_due 		!= old.client_due or
    new.est_by 			!= old.est_by or
    new.est_on 			!= old.est_on or
    new.est_deliv_date 	!= old.est_deliv_date or
    new.est_complexity 	!= old.est_complexity or
    new.pd_bid 			!= old.pd_bid or
	new.pd_approved		!= old.pd_approved or
	new.qty_locked2apd	!= old.qty_locked2apd or
	new.quantity		!= old.quantity or
	new.unit_price		!= old.unit_price or
	new.price			!= old.price or
	new.apply_discount	!= old.apply_discount or
	new.price_discount	!= old.price_discount or
	new.net_price		!= old.net_price or
	new.notes_to_client	!= old.notes_to_client or
	new.notes_to_producer	!= old.notes_to_producer or
	new.initialentry	!= old.initialentry or
	new.initialentry_by	!= old.initialentry_by
    ))
 then
	SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' 
		SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Quote cannot be updated because it is locked!!!.',  MYSQL_ERRNO = 1001;
 End If;
 
END;
Options
ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=249841 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3

Referring Foreign Key

Triggers
  service_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.service_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON service FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_show_id int default null;
select  show_id into t_show_id
	from  s2_prodn.object where object_id = old.object_id;
delete from s2_prodn.auto_service where service_id = old.service_id;        
call triggercall_auto_object(old.object_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
END;
  service_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.service_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON service FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_show_id int default null;
select  show_id into t_show_id
	from  s2_prodn.object where object_id = new.object_id;
call triggercall_auto_service(new.service_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_object(new.object_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
INSERT INTO `s2_prodn`.`service_history`
		(`service_id`,
		`timestamp`,
		`status_label`,
		`person_id`)
	VALUES
		(new.service_id,now(),new.status_label,new.lastupdated_by);
END;
  service_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.service_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON service FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_show_id int default null;
select  show_id into t_show_id
	from  s2_prodn.object where object_id = new.object_id;
call triggercall_auto_service(new.service_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_object(new.object_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');	

if !(new.work_to_date_pct <=> old.work_to_date_pct) 
	or !(new.work_to_date_notes <=> old.work_to_date_notes) then
		insert into s2_prodn.service_wtd_history
			(service_id, work_to_date_when, work_to_date_pct, work_to_date_who, work_to_date_notes)
			values (old.service_id, ifnull(old.work_to_date_when,old.lastupdated), 
            old.work_to_date_pct, ifnull(old.work_to_date_who,old.lastupdated_by), 
            old.work_to_date_notes);
end if;
if !(new.status_label <=> old.status_label) then
	INSERT INTO `s2_prodn`.`service_history`
		(`service_id`,
		`timestamp`,
		`status_label`,
		`person_id`)
	VALUES
		(new.service_id,now(),new.status_label,new.lastupdated_by);
end if;
END;
  service_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.service_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON service FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
if !(new.status_label <=> old.status_label) then set new.substatus_id = NULL;
end if;
END;

  task_AFTER_DELETE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.task_AFTER_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON task FOR EACH ROW BEGIN

Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id int default null;
select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id
	from  s2_prodn.service as svc 
		left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where svc.service_id = old.service_id;
delete from s2_prodn.auto_task where task_id = old.task_id;        
call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Task');
call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');
END;
  task_AFTER_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.task_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON task FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id int default null;
select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id
	from  s2_prodn.service as svc 
		left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where svc.service_id = new.service_id;
        
call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Task');
call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Task');
call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'Service');  
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service');

END;
  task_AFTER_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.task_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON task FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
Declare t_service_id,t_object_id,t_show_id int default null;
select svc.service_id, o.object_id, o.show_id into t_service_id, t_object_id,t_show_id
	from  s2_prodn.service as svc 
		left join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where svc.service_id = new.service_id;
call triggercall_auto_task(new.task_id, 'Task');
call triggercall_auto_service(t_service_id, 'Task');
call triggercall_auto_object(t_object_id, 'Service');
call triggercall_auto_show(t_show_id, 'Service'); 
END;

Triggers
  timecard_date1_BEFORE_INSERT 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.timecard_date1_BEFORE_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON timecard_date1 FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
if new.out_time <= new.in_time then
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End time cannot be earlier than start time.";
 end if;
 if round((timestampdiff(minute,new.in_time,new.out_time)/60),2) > 24 then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT ="End of day entry cannot be more than 24 hours after start time entry.";
 end if;
END;
  timecard_date1_BEFORE_UPDATE 
CREATE TRIGGER s2_prodn.timecard_date1_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON timecard_date1 FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
declare earliest, latest timestamp;
if !(new.out_time <=> old.out_time) or !(new.in_time <=> old.in_time) then
	if new.out_time <= new.in_time then
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End time cannot be earlier than start time.";
	end if;
    if round((timestampdiff(minute,new.in_time,new.out_time)/60),2) > 24 then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "End of day entry cannot be more than 24 hours after start time entry.";
	end if;
    
    select min(start_time_lt),max(end_time_lt) into earliest,latest from actual1 where td_id=new.td_id;
	if (new.out_time < latest) or (new.in_time > earliest) then
		SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
				SET MESSAGE_TEXT = "Start-of-day and end-of-day cannot conflict with the timings of the activities in the day.";
	end if;
    
end if;
END;

View leaf_i_ar_list

VIEW

Query
 
CREATE VIEW ${fullName} AS select `s2_prodn`.`inv`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_label` AS `inv_label`,`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_date` AS `inv_date`,`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date` AS `due_date`,(to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) AS `age`,(case when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) < 0) then 'Not Yet Due' when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) = 0) then 'Due Today' when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) between 1 and 15) then 'Overdue(1-15)' when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) between 16 and 30) then 'Overdue(16-30)' when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) between 31 and 45) then 'Overdue(31-45)' when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) between 46 and 60) then 'Overdue(46-60)' when ((to_days(curdate()) - to_days(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`due_date`)) > 60) then 'Overdue(60+)' end) AS `age_text`,`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_status` AS `status`,`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_total` AS `inv_total`,`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`paid_total` AS `paid_total`,(ifnull(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_total`,0) - ifnull(`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`paid_total`,0)) AS `outstanding`,`ash`.`account_id` AS `account_id`,`ash`.`account_nickname` AS `account_nickname`,`ash`.`show_id` AS `show_id`,`ash`.`show_name` AS `show_name`,`ash`.`stage` AS `stage`,ifnull(`ash`.`exec_producer_nickname`,`ash`.`producer_nickname`) AS `exec_producer_nickname` from (`s2_prodn`.`root_invoice_list_pmt_details` `inv` join `s2_prodn`.`auto_show` `ash` on((`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`show_id` = `ash`.`show_id`))) where ((`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_status` in ('Released','Closed')) and (`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`outstanding` > 0)) order by (`s2_prodn`.`inv`.`inv_total` - `s2_prodn`.`inv`.`paid_total`) desc
IdxColumn NameData TypeDescription
  invoice_id INT
  inv_label VARCHAR
  inv_date DATE
  due_date DATE
  age INT
  age_text VARCHAR
  status ENUM
  inv_total DECIMAL
  paid_total DECIMAL
  outstanding DECIMAL
  account_id INT
  account_nickname VARCHAR
  show_id INT
  show_name VARCHAR
  stage ENUM
  exec_producer_nickname VARCHAR

View leaf_services_currently_due

VIEW

Query
 
CREATE VIEW ${fullName} AS select `svc`.`date_bot_due` AS `date_bot_due`,(case (to_days(`svc`.`date_bot_due`) - to_days(curdate())) when -(2) then '2 Days Ago' when -(1) then 'Yesterday' when 0 then 'Today' when 1 then 'Tomorrow' when 2 then '2 Days from Now' else `svc`.`date_bot_due` end) AS `bot_due_friendly`,`svc`.`date_client_due` AS `date_client_due`,(case (to_days(`svc`.`date_client_due`) - to_days(curdate())) when -(2) then '2 Days Ago' when -(1) then 'Yesterday' when 0 then 'Today' when 1 then 'Tomorrow' when 2 then '2 Days from Now' else `svc`.`date_client_due` end) AS `client_due_friendly`,`ash`.`account_nickname` AS `account_nickname`,`ash`.`show_name` AS `show_name`,`e`.`episode_name` AS `episode_name`,`og`.`group_name` AS `group_name`,`o`.`obj_name` AS `obj_name`,`asvc`.`der_service_type_label` AS `der_service_type_label`,`svc`.`service_label` AS `service_label`,`svc`.`client_priority` AS `client_priority`,`svc`.`status_label` AS `status_label`,`svc`.`pd_bid` AS `pd_bid`,`svc`.`pd_approved` AS `pd_approved`,`asvc`.`der_pd_actual` AS `der_pd_actual`,`asvc`.`der_pre_ffd` AS `der_pre_ffd`,`asvc`.`der_post_ffd` AS `der_post_ffd`,`asvc`.`der_date_ffd` AS `der_date_ffd`,`svc`.`working_frame_start` AS `working_frame_start`,`svc`.`working_frame_end` AS `working_frame_end`,`svc`.`working_frame_count` AS `working_frame_count`,`s2_prodn`.`botstaff`.`exec_producer` AS `exec_producer`,`s2_prodn`.`botstaff`.`producer` AS `producer`,`s2_prodn`.`botstaff`.`assoc_producer` AS `assoc_producer`,`s2_prodn`.`botstaff`.`supervisor` AS `supervisor`,`s2_prodn`.`botstaff`.`coordinator` AS `coordinator`,`s2_prodn`.`alist`.`artistlist` AS `artistlist` from (((((((`s2_prodn`.`service` `svc` left join `s2_prodn`.`auto_service` `asvc` on((`asvc`.`service_id` = `svc`.`service_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`root_service_artistlist` `alist` on((`s2_prodn`.`alist`.`service_id` = `svc`.`service_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`object` `o` on((`o`.`object_id` = `svc`.`object_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`episode` `e` on((`o`.`episode_id` = `e`.`episode_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`obj_group` `og` on((`og`.`group_id` = `o`.`group_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`auto_show` `ash` on((`ash`.`show_id` = `o`.`show_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`root_botstaff_by_show` `botstaff` on((`s2_prodn`.`botstaff`.`show_id` = `o`.`show_id`))) where (((`svc`.`calc_yrweek_bot_due` = yearweek(curdate(),3)) or (`svc`.`calc_yrweek_client_due` = yearweek(curdate(),3))) and (`svc`.`status_label` in ('WIP','reWIP','Pend','AI'))) order by `svc`.`date_bot_due`

Query
 
CREATE VIEW ${fullName} AS select `act`.`calc_yrweek` AS `yrweek`,`p`.`person_id` AS `person_id`,`act`.`actual_activity_id` AS `activity_type_id`,`aa`.`activity_type` AS `activity_type`,`act`.`task_id` AS `task_id`,`ash`.`show_name` AS `show_name`,`o`.`obj_name` AS `obj_name`,`s`.`service_type_id` AS `service_type_id`,`s`.`service_label` AS `service_label`,`t`.`task_label` AS `task_label`,ifnull(sum(`act`.`hours`),0) AS `total_hours`,if((sum(`act`.`hours`) < 30),2,if((sum(`act`.`hours`) < 36),1,0)) AS `completeness_warning_code`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 2),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_1`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 3),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_2`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 4),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_3`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 5),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_4`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 6),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_5`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 7),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_6`,ifnull(sum(if((dayofweek(`act`.`day_id`) = 1),`act`.`hours`,0)),0) AS `hours_7` from ((((((`s2_prodn`.`person` `p` join `s2_prodn`.`actual` `act` on((`act`.`person_id` = `p`.`person_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`actual_activity` `aa` on((`aa`.`actual_activity_id` = `act`.`actual_activity_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`task` `t` on((`act`.`task_id` = `t`.`task_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`service` `s` on((`t`.`service_id` = `s`.`service_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`object` `o` on((`s`.`object_id` = `o`.`object_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`auto_show` `ash` on((`o`.`show_id` = `ash`.`show_id`))) group by `p`.`person_id`,`act`.`actual_activity_id`,`act`.`task_id`,`act`.`calc_yrweek`

`stage`,count(distinct `bi`.`bin`) AS `bin_count`,ifnull((sum(`q`.`net_price`) / nullif(sum(`q`.`pd_approved`),0)),0) AS `avg_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 1),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 1),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_comp_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 2),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 2),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_roto_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 3),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 3),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_paint_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 4),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 4),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_mm_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 5),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 5),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_rm_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 6),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 6),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_asset_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 7),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 7),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_extract_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 8),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 8),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_mogrph_rate`,ifnull((sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 9),`q`.`net_price`,0)) / nullif(sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 9),`q`.`pd_approved`,0)),0)),0) AS `avg_others_rate`,cast(ifnull(sum(`q`.`net_price`),0) as decimal(10,2)) AS `auth_value_total1`,sum(`q`.`net_price`) AS `auth_value_net`,sum(if((`s`.`status_label` in ('Hold','Omit')),((ifnull(cast((1 - `s`.`work_to_date_pct`) as decimal(5,2)),1) / 1) * `q`.`net_price`),0)) AS `auth_value_ho_exclusion`,sum(if((`s`.`status_label` in ('Hold','Omit')),((ifnull(cast(ifnull(`s`.`work_to_date_pct`,0) as decimal(5,2)),1) / 1) * `q`.`net_price`),`q`.`net_price`)) AS `auth_value_total`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 1),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `comp_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 2),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `roto_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 3),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `paint_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 4),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `mm_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 5),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `rm_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 6),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `asset_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 7),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `extract_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 8),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `mogrph_net_price`,sum(if((`bi`.`service_type_id` = 9),`q`.`net_price`,0)) AS `others_net_price` from (((((`s2_prodn`.`show` `sh` left join `s2_prodn`.`auto_show` `ash` on((`sh`.`show_id` = `ash`.`show_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`bid` `b` on((`sh`.`show_id` = `b`.`show_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`billing_item` `bi` on((`b`.`bid_id` = `bi`.`bid_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`quote` `q` on((`bi`.`quote_id` = `q`.`quote_id`))) left join `s2_prodn`.`service` `s` on((`s`.`bin` = `bi`.`bin`))) where (`bi`.`auth_id` is not null) group by `sh`.`show_id`), `bpct` as (select count(`s2_prodn`.`bid_prop`.`bid_prop_id`) AS `proposal_count`,`s2_prodn`.`bid_prop`.`show_id` AS `show_id` View root_rawcapacity_from_now_by_week

VIEW

Query
 
CREATE VIEW ${fullName} AS with `skls` as (select `rt`.`role_type_id` AS `role_type_id`,`rt`.`default_skill_id` AS `skill_id`,`rt`.`default_proficiency` AS `prof`,(case `rt`.`default_skill_id` when 1 then 'Roto' when 2 then 'Paint' when 3 then 'MM/RM' when 5 then 'Comp' when 6 then 'CG' when 8 then 'CG' when 58 then 'CG' else 'CG' end) AS `dept`,yearweek(`a`.`end_date`,3) AS `last_week` from (((`s2_prodn`.`person` `p` join `s2_prodn`.`affiliation` `a` on((`a`.`person_id` = `p`.`person_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`person_role` `pr` on((`pr`.`affiliation_id` = `a`.`affiliation_id`))) join `s2_prodn`.`role_type` `rt` on((`rt`.`role_type_id` = `pr`.`role_type_id`))) where ((0 <> `a`.`is_active`) and (0 <> `pr`.`is_active`) and (0 <> `rt`.`billable`)) group by `p`.`person_id`) select `awp`.`yrweek` AS `yrweek`,count(0) AS `tot_billable_hc`,(count(0) * `awp`.`prodn_days`) AS `total_rawcap`,`awp`.`prodn_days` AS `prodn_days`,(sum(if((`skls`.`dept` = 'Roto'),1,0)) * `awp`.`prodn_days`) AS `roto_rawcap`,(sum(if((`skls`.`dept` = 'Paint'),1,0)) * `awp`.`prodn_days`) AS `paint_rawcap`,(sum(if((`skls`.`dept` = 'MM/RM'),1,0)) * `awp`.`prodn_days`) AS `mmrm_rawcap`,(sum(if((`skls`.`dept` = 'Comp'),1,0)) * `awp`.`prodn_days`) AS `comp_rawcap`,(sum(if((`skls`.`dept` = 'CG'),1,0)) * `awp`.`prodn_days`) AS `cg_rawcap` from (`skls` join `s2_prodn`.`auto_week_pcal` `awp`) where ((`awp`.`yrweek` >= yearweek(curdate(),3)) and (`awp`.`yrweek` < ifnull(`skls`.`last_week`,(`awp`.`yrweek` + 1)))) group by `awp`.`yrweek` order by `awp`.`yrweek`
IdxColumn NameData TypeDescription
  yrweek INT
  tot_billable_hc BIGINT
  total_rawcap BIGINT
  prodn_days TINYINT
  roto_rawcap DECIMAL
  paint_rawcap DECIMAL
  mmrm_rawcap DECIMAL
  comp_rawcap DECIMAL
  cg_rawcap DECIMAL

Functions
CALC_BI_INV2DATE 
CREATE  FUNCTION `CALC_BI_INV2DATE`(in_bin int(11)) RETURNS decimal(10,2)
    DETERMINISTIC
BEGIN

	return (select sum(inv_amount) 
				from invoice_item as ii join invoice as i on i.invoice_id=ii.invoice_id 
				where (bin=in_bin and (i.status="Released" or i.status="Closed"))  group by bin);
END
pd2cellfill 
CREATE  FUNCTION `pd2cellfill`(pd decimal(5,2)) RETURNS int
    DETERMINISTIC
BEGIN
return 
	(case 
		when (pd < 0.125) then 0 
        when (pd < 0.375) then 1 
        when (pd < 0.625) then 2 
        when (pd < 0.875) then 3 
        when (pd < 1.25) then 4 
        when (pd >= 1.125) then 5 
        else NULL 
	end);
END


Procedures
DELETE_TRASH 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `DELETE_TRASH`(in in_show_id int)
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE o_id, svc_id, t_id int default null;
  

      
  DECLARE cur_service CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT svc.service_id
        from s2_prodn.service as svc 
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
        join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;

  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur_service;
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur_service INTO svc_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_service(svc_id,'Full');
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_service;
END
DELETE_recalc_auto_week_pcal 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `DELETE_recalc_auto_week_pcal`(in in_facility ENUM('LBR', 'CJB', 'ATL'), in in_day_id date, in in_working tinyint)
BEGIN
	DECLARE v_yearweek, v_dayofweek int;
    set v_yearweek = yearweek(in_day_id,3);
    set v_dayofweek = dayofweek(in_day_id);

   
   
	case v_dayofweek
		when 2 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_1 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_1 = values(prodn_1);
		when 3 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_2 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_2 = values(prodn_2);
		when 4 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_3 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_3 = values(prodn_3);
		when 5 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_4 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_4 = values(prodn_4);
		when 6 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_5 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_5 = values(prodn_5);
		when 7 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_6 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_6 = values(prodn_6);
		when 1 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal
				 set facility_code = in_facility,
					 yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 prodn_7 = in_working
			on duplicate key update 
				facility_code = values(facility_code),
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				prodn_7 = values(prodn_7);
	end case;

END
DELETE_recalc_auto_week_pcal_full 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `DELETE_recalc_auto_week_pcal_full`()
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE v_yearweek, v_dayofweek int;

  DECLARE v_facility varchar(10);
 
  DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT yearweek(day_id,3),dayofweek(day_id), facility, working FROM pcal;
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;
  
 delete from auto_week_pcal;
        
  OPEN cur1;

  my_loop: LOOP
	FETCH cur1 INTO v_yearweek,v_dayofweek,v_facility, v_prodn;
    IF done THEN

	case v_dayofweek
		when 2 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal 
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,

			on duplicate key update

		when 3 then

			on duplicate key update

		when 4 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal 
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 facility = v_facility,
					 prodn_3 = v_prodn
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				facility = values(facility),
				prodn_3 = values(prodn_3);
		when 5 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal 
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 facility = v_facility,
					 prodn_4 = v_prodn
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				facility = values(facility),
				prodn_4 = values(prodn_4);
		when 6 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal 
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 facility = v_facility,
					 prodn_5 = v_prodn
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				facility = values(facility),
				prodn_5 = values(prodn_5);
		when 7 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal 
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 facility = v_facility,
					 prodn_6 = v_prodn
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				facility = values(facility),
				prodn_6 = values(prodn_6);
		when 1 then
			insert into auto_week_pcal 
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 facility = v_facility,
					 prodn_7 = v_prodn
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				facility = values(facility),
				prodn_7 = values(prodn_7);
	end case;
END LOOP;
CLOSE cur1;

DELETE_triggercall_note 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `DELETE_triggercall_note`(in in_assoc_element enum('Inherited','Show','Object','Service','Task','Published'),
														 in in_show_id int,
                                                         in in_object_id int, 
                                                         in in_service_id int, 
                                                         in in_task_id int)
BEGIN

	
	case in_assoc_element
		when 'Show' then	
			insert into auto_show
				(show_id, show_note_count)
                select * from (select in_show_id,count(*) as show_note_count from note where assoc_element = 'Show' and show_id = in_show_id) as tgt
			on duplicate key update
				show_note_count = tgt.show_note_count;
                
		when 'Object' then
			insert into auto_object
				(object_id, der_note_count) 
                select * from (select in_object_id, count(*) from note where assoc_element = 'Object' and object_id = in_object_id) as tgt
                
			on duplicate key update
				der_note_count = values(der_note_count);
      
		when 'Service' then
			insert into auto_service
				(service_id, der_note_count)
                select * from (select in_service_id, count(*) from note where assoc_element = 'Service' and service_id = in_service_id) as tgt
			on duplicate key update
				der_note_count = values(der_note_count);
        
		when 'Task' then
			insert into auto_task
				(task_id, der_note_count)
                select * from (select in_task_id,count(*) from note where assoc_element = 'Task' and task_id = in_task_id) as tgt
			on duplicate key update
				der_note_count = values(der_note_count);
        
		when 'Published' then
        
			update published set der_note_count = (select count(*) from note where assoc_element = 'Published' and task_id = in_task_id) where task_id = in_task_id;
            
    end case;
END
create_generic_pcal_records 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `create_generic_pcal_records`(in start_date date, in end_date date)
BEGIN
 
   
 DECLARE cur_date DATE DEFAULT start_date;

 IF end_date > start_date THEN
	  WHILE cur_date <= end_date DO
		insert into pcal
			set day_id = cur_date,
				facility_code = "LBR",
                working = 1,
                working_part_of_day="Full";
		SET cur_date = adddate(cur_date,1);
	  END WHILE;
 END IF;
END
delete_everything_in_a_show 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `delete_everything_in_a_show`(in in_show_id int)
BEGIN


delete from `note` as n
	where n.object_id in (select object_id from object where show_id = in_show_id);
    
delete from service 
	where object_id in (select object_id from object where show_id = in_show_id);
    
delete from obj_group where show_id = in_show_id;

delete from sequence where show_id = in_show_id;

delete from object where show_id = in_show_id;

delete from episode where show_id = in_show_id;

delete from note where show_id = in_show_id;

delete from `show` where show_id = in_show_id;

delete from auto_show_episode_summary where show_id = in_show_id;

END
gen_show_financial 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `gen_show_financial`()
BEGIN
SET SQL_SAFE_UPDATES = 0;
delete from s2_prodn.gen_show_financial;

INSERT INTO `s2_prodn`.`gen_show_financial`
	(`show_id`,
	`show_name`,
    account_id , 
	account_nickname ,
	producer_nickname ,
	exec_producer_nickname ,
	assoc_producer_nickname ,
	coordinator_nickname ,
	supervisor_nickname ,
    date_work_start,
	stage,
	`bin_count`,
	`proposal_count`,
	`avg_rate`,
	`avg_comp_rate`,
	`avg_roto_rate`,
	`avg_paint_rate`,
	`avg_mm_rate`,
	`avg_rm_rate`,
	`avg_asset_rate`,
	`avg_extract_rate`,
	`avg_mogrph_rate`,
	`avg_others_rate`,
	`auth_value_total`,
	`auth_value_ho_exclusion`,
	`auth_value_net`,
	`comp_net_price`,
	`roto_net_price`,
	`paint_net_price`,
	`mm_net_price`,
	`rm_net_price`,
	`asset_net_price`,
	`extract_net_price`,
	`mogrph_net_price`,
	`others_net_price`,
	`inv_to_date`,
	`invoice_count`,
	`comp_inv_to_date`,
	`roto_inv_to_date`,
	`paint_inv_to_date`,
	`mm_inv_to_date`,
	`rm_inv_to_date`,
	`asset_inv_to_date`,
	`extract_inv_to_date`,
	`mogrph_inv_to_date`,
	`others_inv_to_date`,
	`paid_to_date`,
	`payment_count`)
(SELECT 
`bis`.`show_id` AS `show_id`,
`bis`.`show_name` AS `show_name`,
bis.account_id as account_id, 
bis.account_nickname as account_nickname,
bis.producer_nickname as producer_nickname,
bis.exec_producer_nickname as exec_producer_nickname,
bis.assoc_producer_nickname as assoc_producer_nickname,
bis.coordinator_nickname as coordinator_nickname,
bis.supervisor_nickname as supervisor_nickname,
bis.date_work_start as date_work_start,
bis.stage as stage,
ifnull(`bis`.`bin_count`,0) AS `bin_count`,
ifnull(`bis`.`proposal_count`,0) AS `proposal_count`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_rate`,0) AS `avg_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_comp_rate`,0) AS `avg_comp_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_roto_rate`,0) AS `avg_roto_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_paint_rate`,0) AS `avg_paint_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_mm_rate`,0) AS `avg_mm_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_rm_rate`,0) AS `avg_rm_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_asset_rate`,0) AS `avg_asset_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_extract_rate`,0) AS `avg_extract_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_mogrph_rate`,0) AS `avg_mogrph_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`avg_others_rate`,0) AS `avg_others_rate`,
ifnull(`bis`.`auth_value_total`,0) AS `auth_value_total`,
ifnull(`bis`.`auth_value_ho_exclusion`,0) AS `auth_value_ho_exclusion`,
ifnull(`bis`.`auth_value_net`,0) AS `auth_value_net`,
ifnull(`bis`.`comp_net_price`,0) AS `comp_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`roto_net_price`,0) AS `roto_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`paint_net_price`,0) AS `paint_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`mm_net_price`,0) AS `mm_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`rm_net_price`,0) AS `rm_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`asset_net_price`,0) AS `asset_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`extract_net_price`,0) AS `extract_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`mogrph_net_price`,0) AS `mogrph_net_price`,
ifnull(`bis`.`others_net_price`,0) AS `others_net_price`,
ifnull(`iis`.`inv_to_date`,0) AS `inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`invoice_count`,0) AS `invoice_count`,
ifnull(`iis`.`comp_inv_to_date`,0) AS `comp_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`roto_inv_to_date`,0) AS `roto_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`paint_inv_to_date`,0) AS `paint_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`mm_inv_to_date`,0) AS `mm_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`rm_inv_to_date`,0) AS `rm_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`asset_inv_to_date`,0) AS `asset_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`extract_inv_to_date`,0) AS `extract_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`mogrph_inv_to_date`,0) AS `mogrph_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`iis`.`others_inv_to_date`,0) AS `others_inv_to_date`,
ifnull(`pis`.`paid_to_date`,0) AS `paid_to_date`,
ifnull(`pis`.`payment_count`,0) AS `payment_count`
    FROM
        `root_billing_item_stats_by_show` `bis`
        LEFT JOIN `root_invoice_stats_by_show` `iis` ON `bis`.`show_id` = `iis`.`show_id`
        LEFT JOIN `root_payment_stats_by_show` `pis` ON `bis`.`show_id` = `pis`.`show_id`
    WHERE
        `bis`.`stage` IN ('Active' , 'Inactive', 'Closed') and bis.auth_value_total is not null);
        -- and bis.auth_value_total is not null)
        
SET SQL_SAFE_UPDATES = 1;
END
gen_show_financial_cost_index 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `gen_show_financial_cost_index`(in in_show_id int)
BEGIN
/*  Created by Hitesh 15-Nov-2022
	To generate a single show's cost_index based on skill mix of the actuals
*/
with show_actuals_by_skill as
	(Select 
		o.show_id as show_id,
		case p.der_cur_facility /*  This is a temporary approach - the US India distinction */
			when "ATL" then "US"
			else "India"
		end as country,
		case p.der_cur_facility 
			when "ATL" then "ATL"
			else "LBR"
		end as facility_code,
		der_cur_primary_skill_id as skill_id,
		der_cur_primary_skill as skill_label,
		der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency as proficiency,
		sum(a.pd) as total_actual_pds
		from actual as a
		left join person as p on (a.person_id = p.person_id)
		left join task as t on (a.task_id = t.task_id)
		left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
		left join object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
		where o.show_id = in_show_id and not isnull(p.der_cur_facility) and not isnull(der_cur_primary_skill_id)
		group by country,der_cur_primary_skill_id,der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency
		order by country,der_cur_primary_skill_id,der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency),
index_matched as
	(select show_id,
			country,
			acts.facility_code,
			acts.skill_id,
			acts.proficiency,
			acts.total_actual_pds,
			ifnull(indx.index,1) as skill_index,  /* Temporary fix for when no records are found in skill_cost_index table */
			(acts.total_actual_pds * ifnull(indx.index,1)) as weighted
		from show_actuals_by_skill as acts
		left join skill_cost_index as indx on (acts.facility_code = indx.facility_code and acts.skill_id = indx.skill_id and acts.proficiency = indx.proficiency))
select show_id, 
		sum(total_actual_pds) as acutals_basis,
		if(sum(total_actual_pds)>0, (sum(weighted)/sum(total_actual_pds)),null) as show_cost_index
	from index_matched;
END
