leaf_account_balance_summary 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_account_balance_summary`(in in_account_id int, in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN
/*  Created by Hitesh 8/22/22  */
(select s.account_nickname as account_name,
		i.inv_date as activity_date,
        "Invoice" as activity_type,
	   concat("Show: ",s.show_name," (",s.show_id,")   Invoice: ",i.inv_label," (",i.invoice_id,")") as details,
       sum(aii.inv_amount) as debit_amount,
       null as credit_amount
	from auto_invoice_item as aii
	join invoice as i on (i.invoice_id = aii.invoice_id)
    join auto_show as s on (s.show_id = i.show_id)
    where i.status in ("Closed","Released") and s.account_id = in_account_id and i.inv_date between in_start_date and in_end_date
    group by i.invoice_id)
Union
    
(select s.account_nickname as account_name,
		paid_on as activity_date,
		"Payment" as activity_type,
        concat("Payment ID:",p.payment_id,"  Shows : (",group_concat( distinct s.show_name),")") as details,
        null as debit_amount,
        sum(pi.item_alloc_payment) as credit_amount
	from payment_item as pi
    join payment as p on (p.payment_id = pi.payment_id)
    join invoice_item as ii on (pi.inv_item_id = ii.inv_item_id)
    join invoice as i on (i.invoice_id = ii.invoice_id)
    join auto_show as s on (s.show_id = i.show_id)
    where s.account_id = in_account_id and p.paid_on between in_start_date and in_end_date
    group by p.payment_id)
order by activity_date asc;
END
leaf_ar_ageing_by_date 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_ar_ageing_by_date`(in in_as_of_date date)
BEGIN
/* Created by Hitesh 06June2022
Gives A/R ageing report as of the data provided - i.e. if payments came after that date, they are not counted
Note this is effective after May 2021 to weed out bad records for outstanding.
*/
select "Outstanding" as pmt_status, inv_date, due_date,  inv_label, 
account_nickname,account_id, show_name, show_id, exec_producer,
item_count, inv_total
	from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
	where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') 
    and due_date between "2021-05-01" and in_as_of_date
    and (paid_on_earliest > in_as_of_date or outstanding>0);
END
leaf_artist_availability_by_person 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_artist_availability_by_person`(in_person_id varchar(65), in_from_date date,in_to_date date)
BEGIN

set @in_person := SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(in_person_id, ' ', 1), ' ', -1);
SELECT 
    `pcal`.`yrweek` AS `yrweek`,
    `per`.`person_id` AS `person_id`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_1` AS `task_id_1`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_2` AS `task_id_2`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_3` AS `task_id_3`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_4` AS `task_id_4`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_5` AS `task_id_5`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_6` AS `task_id_6`,
    `awpass`.`task_id_7` AS `task_id_7`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_1` AS `tot_pd_1`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_2` AS `tot_pd_2`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_3` AS `tot_pd_3`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_4` AS `tot_pd_4`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_5` AS `tot_pd_5`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_6` AS `tot_pd_6`,
    `awpass`.`tot_pd_7` AS `tot_pd_7`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_1` AS `asgn_cellfill_1`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_2` AS `asgn_cellfill_`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_3` AS `asgn_cellfill_3`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_4` AS `asgn_cellfill_4`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_5` AS `asgn_cellfill_5`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_6` AS `asgn_cellfill_6`,
    `awpass`.`asgn_cellfill_7` AS `asgn_cellfill_7`,
    `per`.`der_nickname` AS `nickname`,
    `per`.`der_cur_primary_skill_id` AS `skill_id`,
    `per`.`der_cur_primary_skill` AS `skill`,
    `per`.`der_cur_role_type` AS `role_type`,
    `per`.`der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency` AS `skill_proficiency`
FROM
    `auto_week_pcal` AS `pcal`
        LEFT JOIN
    `leaf_week_person_assignment` AS `awpass` ON `pcal`.`yrweek` = `awpass`.`yrweek`
        LEFT JOIN
    `leaf_week_person_actual` AS `awpact` ON `pcal`.`yrweek` = `awpact`.`yrweek`
        LEFT JOIN
    `person` AS `per` ON `per`.`person_id` = `awpass`.`person_id`
WHERE
    per.person_id IN (select SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(in_person_id, ' ', 1), ' ', -1))
        AND pcal.yrweek BETWEEN YEARWEEK(in_from_date, 3) AND YEARWEEK(in_to_date, 3);
END
leaf_artist_task_schedule 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_artist_task_schedule`(in_person_id INT, in_from_date date,in_to_date date)
BEGIN
select 
`obj`.`show_id` as `show_id`,
 `s`.`show_name` as `show_name`, 
 `obj`.`object_id` as `object_id`,
 `obj`.`obj_name` as `object_name`,
 `t`.`service_id` as `service_id`, 
 `styp`.`service_type_id` as `service_type_id`, 
 `styp`.`service_type_label` as `service_type_label`, 
 `t`.`task_label` as `task_label`, 
 `t`.`skill_id` as `skill_id`,
 `t`.`task_complexity` as `task_complexity`, 
 `t`.`pd_allocated` as `pd_allocated`, 
 `at`.`der_pd_assigned` as `pd_scheduled`,
 `at`.`der_pd_actual` as `pd_actual`,
 `per`.`person_id` as `person_id`, 
 `per`.`der_nickname` as `nickname`, 
 `per`.`der_badge_id` as `badge_id`, 
 `ser`.`date_client_due` as `date_client_due`,
 `ser`.`date_bot_due` as `date_bot_due`,
 `awt`.`yrweek` as `yrweek`,
 `awt`.`task_id` as `task_id`,
 `awt`.`pd_1` as `pd_1`, 
 `awt`.`pd_2` as `pd_2`, 
 `awt`.`pd_3` as `pd_3`,
 `awt`.`pd_4` as `pd_4`,
 `awt`.`pd_5` as `pd_5`, 
 `awt`.`pd_6` as `pd_6`,
 `awt`.`pd_7` as `pd_7`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_1` as `cellfill_1`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_2` as `cellfill_2`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_3` as `cellfill_3`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_4` as `cellfill_4`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_5` as `cellfill_5`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_6` as `cellfill_6`,
 `awt`.`cellfill_7` as `cellfill_7` 
 from `object` as `obj` 
 left join `show` as `s` on `s`.`show_id` = `obj`.`show_id` 
 left join `episode` as `e` on `e`.`episode_id` = `obj`.`episode_id` 
 left join `service` as `ser` on `ser`.`object_id` = `obj`.`object_id` 
 left join `task` as `t` on `t`.`service_id` = `ser`.`service_id` 
 left join `auto_task` as `at` on `at`.`task_id` = `t`.`task_id` 
 left join `service_type` as `styp` on `ser`.`service_type_id` = `styp`.`service_type_id` 
 left join `person` as `per` on `t`.`person_id` = `per`.`person_id` 
 left join `leaf_week_task_assignment` as `awt` on `t`.`task_id` = `awt`.`task_id` 
 where per.person_id = in_person_id and yrweek between yearweek(in_from_date, 3) and yearweek(in_to_date, 3);

END
leaf_authorize_bin 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_authorize_bin`(in target_quote_id int, in target_auth_id int, in_entry_by INT,out exec_status bool, out exec_msg tinytext, out exec_bin int)
mySP: BEGIN


declare target_bin int default null;
declare isnull_net_price bool default null;
declare target_bin_auth_isnull bool;
declare target_auth_exists bool;
declare target_bin_status varchar(16) default null;
declare target_client_PO varchar(45) default null;
set exec_status = 0;
set exec_msg="-";
 

select bin,isnull(net_price) into target_bin,isnull_net_price from quote where quote.quote_id = target_quote_id;
select isnull(auth_id),`status` into target_bin_auth_isnull,target_bin_status
		from billing_item where bin=target_bin;

set exec_bin = target_bin;
	select count(*),client_PO into target_auth_exists,target_client_PO from authorization where auth_id=target_auth_id;
	if not target_auth_exists		
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = concat("Authorization failed: Authorization ID #",target_auth_id," does not exist.");
			leave mySP;
	end if;


	if not target_bin_auth_isnull	
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = concat("Authorization failed: Bin assocaited with quote (bin #",target_bin,") is already authorized.");
			leave mySP;
	end if;
    





	if isnull_net_price			
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = concat("Authorization failed: The Net Price on this quote cannot be empty (it can be zero).");
			leave mySP;
	end if;
	

	start transaction;  				  
		update billing_item
		 set quote_id = target_quote_id,  
			 auth_id = target_auth_id,    
			 `status` = "Authorized", 	  
             client_PO = target_client_PO,
             lastupdated_by=in_entry_by
		 where bin=target_bin;
		update quote 
			set locked = 1, lastupdated_by=in_entry_by			 
			where quote_id = target_quote_id;

		set exec_status = 1;
		set exec_msg = "Successfully authorized";
	commit;


END
leaf_bi_invoicing_by_show 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bi_invoicing_by_show`(in_show_id INT, in_inv_id INT,in_inv_item_id int)
BEGIN

	declare compare_value varchar(10);
    declare cost_to_date, inv_to_date, net_price decimal(10,2);
    if (in_inv_item_id = '') then
		set in_inv_item_id = null;
	end if;
    select * from 
		(
SELECT 
    `bi`.`bin`,
    `bi`.`group_name`,
    `bi`.`obj_name` AS `bin_obj_name`,
    `bi`.`service_type_id`,
    `styp`.`service_type_label`,
    `bi`.`service_label`,
    `bi`.`auth_id`,
    `bi`.`client_po`,
    `ser`.`status_label`,
    `q`.`net_price`,
    q.pd_bid,
   q.pd_approved,
    CALC_BI_INV2DATE(bi.bin) AS inv_to_date,
 
   
     if(in_inv_id,max(if(ii.invoice_id=in_inv_id,ii.inv_item_id,null)),null) as inv_item_id,
    if(in_inv_id,max(if(ii.invoice_id=in_inv_id,ii.inv_amount,null)),null) as inv_amount,
    if(in_inv_id,group_concat(if(ii.invoice_id=in_inv_id,ii.inv_notes,'') separator ''),null) as inv_notes,
    `ser`.`work_to_date_pct`,
    `ser`.`work_to_date_notes`
FROM
    `billing_item` AS `bi`
        LEFT JOIN
    `bid` AS `b` ON `b`.`bid_id` = `bi`.`bid_id`
        LEFT JOIN
    `service_type` AS `styp` ON `bi`.`service_type_id` = `styp`.`service_type_id`
        LEFT JOIN
    `quote` AS `q` ON `q`.`quote_id` = `bi`.`quote_id`
        LEFT JOIN
    `invoice_item` AS `ii` ON `ii`.`bin` = `bi`.`bin`
        LEFT JOIN
    `invoice` AS `i` ON `i`.`invoice_id` = `ii`.`invoice_id`
        LEFT JOIN
    `service` AS `ser` ON `ser`.`bin` = `bi`.`bin`
WHERE
    `bi`.`auth_id` IS NOT NULL
        AND `b`.`show_id` = in_show_id group by bi.bin) as t1
             where if(ISNULL(in_inv_item_id), '1=1', t1.inv_item_id=in_inv_item_id) ;
END
leaf_bid_prop_item_pdf_data 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bid_prop_item_pdf_data`( in_bid_prop_id INT )
BEGIN
 	 SELECT
 		`billing_item`.`bin`,
 		`billing_item`.`obj_name`,
		`bid_prop_item`.`bid_prop_item_id`,
 		`quote`.`locked`,
 		`billing_item`.`auth_id`,
 		`billing_item`.`service_type_id`,
         `billing_item`.obj_description,
         billing_item.client_service_desc,
 		`service_type`.`service_type_label`,
 		`quote`.`working_start`,
 		`quote`.`working_end`,
 		`quote`.`working_count`,
 		`quote`.`pd_bid`,
 		`quote`.`pd_approved`,
 		`quote`.`unit_price`,
 		`quote`.`qty_locked2apd`,
		`quote`.`quantity`,
        `quote`.`price`,
        `quote`.`apply_discount`,
        `quote`.`price_discount`,
        `quote`.`net_price`,   
        `quote`.`client_due`,  
        `billing_item`.`group_name`,
        `quote`.`est_deliv_date`,
        `quote`.`est_complexity`,
        `quote`.`work_approach_notes`,
        `quote`.`notes_to_client`,
        `quote`.`quote_scope`,
        `quote`.`est_by`,
        `quote`.`est_on`
 	 FROM
 		`bid_prop_item` 
 		INNER JOIN `quote` ON `quote`.`quote_id` = `bid_prop_item`.`quote_id`
 		INNER JOIN `billing_item` ON `billing_item`.`bin` = `quote`.`bin`
         INNER JOIN `service_type` ON `service_type`.`service_type_id` = `billing_item`.`service_type_id`
 	 WHERE
 		`bid_prop_item`.`bid_prop_id` = in_bid_prop_id;
  
  END
leaf_bid_prop_link 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bid_prop_link`(in_bid_prop_id INT, in_show_id INT)
BEGIN
SELECT 
    `bi`.`bin`,
    `bi`.`obj_name`,
    `bi`.`status`,
    `bi`.`service_type_id`,
    `bi`.`group_name`,
    `bi`.`bid_id`,
    `b`.`bid_name`,
    `s`.`show_id`,
    `bpi`.`bid_prop_id`,
    `bpi`.`bid_prop_item_id`,
    IF(ISNULL(bpi.bid_prop_item_id),
        bi.quote_id,
        bpi.quote_id) AS selected_quote_id,
    `q`.`quote_id`,
    `q`.`quote_label`,
    `q`.`pd_bid`,
    `q`.`pd_approved`,
    `q`.`price`,
    `q`.`net_price`,
    `q`.`locked`,
    CASE
        WHEN bpi.bid_prop_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END Inprop,
    IF(bi.quote_id = q.quote_id, 1, 0) AS IsCurrentQuote
FROM
    `billing_item` AS `bi`
        LEFT JOIN
    `quote` AS `q` ON `q`.`bin` = `bi`.`bin`
        LEFT JOIN
    bid_prop_item AS bpi ON (bpi.quote_id = q.quote_id
        AND bpi.bid_prop_id = in_bid_prop_id)
        LEFT JOIN
    `bid` AS `b` ON `b`.`bid_id` = `bi`.`bid_id`
        LEFT JOIN
    `show` AS `s` ON `s`.`show_id` = `b`.`show_id`
WHERE
    s.show_id = in_show_id
GROUP BY `q`.`quote_id`;

END
leaf_bid_prop_pdf_data 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bid_prop_pdf_data`( in_bid_prop_id INT )
BEGIN
SELECT
  `b`.bid_id,
  `bp`.bid_prop_id,
  `b`.bid_name,
  `bp`.prop_name,
  `bp`.prop_date,
  `ac`.nickname as account_name,
  
	`s`.payment_structure_id,
    `ps`.payment_structure_desc,
  `a`.client_PO,
  AVG(IFNULL(`q`.`price`, 0)) AS `gross_due`,
  AVG(IFNULL(`q`.`price_discount`, 0)) AS `total_discount`,
  AVG(IFNULL(`q`.`net_price`, 0)) AS `net_due`,
  `s`.show_name,
  `b`.init_date
  
  
  
  
  
  
  FROM
	((((((`bid` `b`
    LEFT JOIN `show` `s` ON (`b`.`show_id` = `s`.`show_id`))
    LEFT JOIN `bid_prop` `bp` ON ((`s`.`show_id` = `bp`.`show_id`)))
    LEFT JOIN `bid_prop_item` `bpi` ON ((`bpi`.`bid_prop_id` = `bp`.`bid_prop_id`)))
    LEFT JOIN `quote` `q` ON ((`bpi`.`quote_id` = `q`.`quote_id`)))
    LEFT JOIN `billing_item` `bi` ON ((`bi`.`bid_id` = `b`.`bid_id`)))
    LEFT JOIN `authorization` `a` ON ((`bi`.`auth_id` = `a`.`auth_id`)))
    LEFT JOIN `account` `ac` ON ((`ac`.`account_id` = `s`.`account_id`))
    Left join `payment_structure` `ps` ON ((`ps`.`payment_structure_id` = s.payment_structure_id))
  WHERE
	`bp`.bid_prop_id = in_bid_prop_id
  GROUP BY `bp`.`bid_prop_id`;
 
 END
leaf_bin_create_from_object 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bin_create_from_object`( in target_bid_id int, in target_object_id int, in target_service_id int, in target_initialentry_by int, out exec_status bool, out exec_bin int, out exec_msg tinytext )
BEGIN	
	
    declare bin_count int default 0;
    declare target_bin_obj_name varchar(64) default null;
    declare target_bin_group_name varchar(50) default null;
    declare target_bin_client_desc text default null;
    declare target_bin_service_type_id int default null;
    declare target_bin_final_due date default null;
    declare target_bin_service_label varchar(50) default null;
    declare target_bin_shot_frame_start int default null;
    declare target_bin_shot_frame_end int default null;
    declare target_bin_shot_frame_count int default null;
    
    declare target_quote_working_start int default null;
    declare target_quote_working_end int default null;
    declare target_quote_working_count int default null;
    declare target_bin_obj_description text default null;
    declare target_quote_pd_bid decimal(7,2) default null;
    declare target_quote_pd_approved decimal(7,2) default null;
    declare target_quote_complexity enum('1','2','3','4','5') default null;
	declare target_show_id int(11) default null;
    declare target_quote_label varchar(64) default "v1";
    declare is_obj_name_duplicate int default 0;
    declare created_bin int default null;
    declare created_quote_id int default null;
    set exec_status = 0;
    set exec_bin = 0;
	set exec_msg = "Attempt to Insert a new Bin and associated Quote Failed.";
    select count(*) into bin_count from billing_item where bid_id = target_bid_id group by bid_id;
    
	select 
		obj.obj_name,
        obgp.group_name,
        shot_frame_start,
        shot_frame_end,
       
        `description`
		
        
      
        
			into
        target_bin_obj_name,
        target_bin_group_name,
        target_bin_shot_frame_start,
        target_bin_shot_frame_end,
      
        target_bin_obj_description
        
        
       
    from object obj 
		left join obj_group obgp on obj.group_id = obgp.group_id where obj.object_id = target_object_id;
        
	select 
		client_service_desc,
        service_type_id,
        date_final_due,
        service_label,
        pd_bid,
        pd_approved,
        service_complexity,
        working_frame_start,
        working_frame_end
			into 
        target_bin_client_desc,
        target_bin_service_type_id,
        target_bin_final_due,
        target_bin_service_label,
        target_quote_pd_bid,
        target_quote_pd_approved,
        target_quote_complexity,
        target_quote_working_start,
        target_quote_working_end
	from service 
    where service_id = target_service_id;

    
    select show_id into target_show_id from bid where bid_id = target_bid_id;
    select sum(if(obj_name = target_bin_obj_name,1,0)) into is_obj_name_duplicate from billing_item as bi
		left join bid as b on (b.bid_id = bi.bid_id)
		where b.show_id = target_show_id;
    if is_obj_name_duplicate then 
		set target_bin_obj_name = concat(target_bin_obj_name,"_",cast(round(rand()*1000,0) as char));
	end if;

    
    start transaction;
		
		insert into billing_item
			  (obj_name,
              group_name,
			  bid_id,
              seq_number,
			  client_service_desc,
			  service_type_id,
              final_due,
              service_label,
              shot_frame_start,
              shot_frame_end,
             
              obj_description,
              initialentry_by,
              lastupdated_by)
			  values(
			  target_bin_obj_name,
              target_bin_group_name,
			  target_bid_id,
              (bin_count+1),
              target_bin_client_desc,              
			  target_bin_service_type_id,
              target_bin_final_due,
              target_bin_service_label,
              target_bin_shot_frame_start,
              target_bin_shot_frame_end,
             
              target_bin_obj_description,
              target_initialentry_by,
              target_initialentry_by
			 );
		SET created_bin = LAST_INSERT_ID();
        
		
		insert into quote (bin,quote_label,locked,initialentry_by,lastupdated_by) 
				values (created_bin,target_quote_label,0,target_initialentry_by,target_initialentry_by);
		SET created_quote_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();
        
        update quote 
			set 
            
				pd_bid=target_quote_pd_bid, 
				pd_approved=target_quote_pd_approved, 
				est_complexity=target_quote_complexity, 
                working_start=target_quote_working_start,
                working_end=target_quote_working_end,
              
                lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by
            where 
				quote_id=created_quote_id;
        
        update service set bin = created_bin, lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by  where service_id = target_service_id;
        
		update billing_item set quote_id = created_quote_id,lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by where bin=created_bin;
        
        set exec_status = 1;
        set exec_bin = created_bin;
		set exec_msg = "Successfully inserted.";
             
	commit;
              
  END

CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bin_create_with_quote`( in target_bid_id int, in target_service_type_id int, in target_initialentry_by int, out exec_status bool, out exec_bin int, out exec_msg tinytext )
BEGIN	
	
    declare bin_count int default 0;
    declare target_bin_obj_name varchar(64) default null;
	declare target_show_id int(11) default null;
    declare target_quote_label varchar(64) default "v1";
    declare def_service_label varchar(50) default '';
    declare target_service_label varchar (50) default '';
    declare is_obj_name_duplicate int default 0;
    declare created_bin int default null;
    declare created_quote_id int default null;
    DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK;
        RESIGNAL;
    END;
    set exec_status = 0;
    set exec_bin = 0;
	set exec_msg = "Attempt to Insert a new Bin and associated Quote Failed.";
        
    
    select count(*) into bin_count from billing_item where bid_id = target_bid_id group by bid_id;
    
    select service_type_label into def_service_label  from s2_prodn.service_type where service_type_id = target_service_type_id;
    set target_bin_obj_name = concat("temp_",cast((bin_count+1) as char));
    set target_service_label  = concat(def_service_label, cast((bin_count+1) as char));

    
    select show_id into target_show_id from bid where bid_id = target_bid_id;
    select sum(if(obj_name = target_bin_obj_name,1,0)) into is_obj_name_duplicate from billing_item as bi
		left join bid as b on (b.bid_id = bi.bid_id)
		where b.show_id = target_show_id;
    if is_obj_name_duplicate then 
		set target_bin_obj_name = concat(target_bin_obj_name,"_",cast(round(rand()*1000,0) as char));
	end if;

    
    start transaction;
		
		insert into billing_item
			  (obj_name,
			  bid_id,
              seq_number,
			  service_type_id,
              service_label,
              initialentry_by,
              lastupdated_by)
			  values(
			  target_bin_obj_name,
			  target_bid_id,
              (bin_count+1),
			  target_service_type_id,
              target_service_label,
              target_initialentry_by,
              target_initialentry_by
			 );
		SET created_bin = LAST_INSERT_ID();
        
		
		insert into quote (bin,quote_label,locked,initialentry_by,lastupdated_by) 
				values (created_bin,target_quote_label,0,target_initialentry_by,target_initialentry_by);
		SET created_quote_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();
        
        
		update billing_item set quote_id = created_quote_id,lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by where bin=created_bin;
        
        set exec_status = 1;
        set exec_bin = created_bin;
		set exec_msg = "Successfully inserted.";
             
	COMMIT;
              
  END
leaf_bin_swap_quote 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_bin_swap_quote`( in in_quote_id INT, in target_initialentry_by int )
BEGIN
	declare _bin int;
    declare _quote_scope text;
  
  	select bin,quote_scope into _bin,_quote_scope from quote where quote_id=in_quote_id;
      
	update billing_item set quote_id = in_quote_id, client_service_desc = _quote_scope, lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by where bin = _bin;
      
    select * from billing_item where bin=_bin;
END
leaf_create_dailies_ticket_request 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_create_dailies_ticket_request`(in in_entry_by int,in in_pub_id int, in in_req_type_id int, in in_notes text,in in_target_reviewer int, in_parent_req_id int)
BEGIN

    declare target_show_id int default null;
    declare target_episode_id int default null;
    declare target_object_id int default null;
    declare target_service_id int default null;
    declare target_task_id int default null;
    declare target_owner int default null;
    declare created_req_id int default null;
    declare child_created_req_id int default null;
	DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK;
        RESIGNAL;
    END;
	
    
	
   SELECT 
    pub.show_id,
    obj.episode_id,
    pub.object_id,
    pub.service_id,
    pub.task_id,
    pub.pub_person_id into
    target_show_id,
    target_episode_id,
    target_object_id,
    target_service_id,
    target_task_id,
    target_owner
FROM
    s2_prodn.published pub
        LEFT JOIN
    s2_prodn.object obj ON pub.object_id = obj.object_id
WHERE
    pub.pub_id = in_pub_id;

START TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO `s2_prodn`.`dailies_ticket_request` 
(`req_type_id`, `show_id`, `episode_id`, `object_id`, `service_id`, `task_id`, `der_current_state_id`,  `owner`, `target_reviewer`,`lastupdated_by`) 
VALUES (in_req_type_id, target_show_id, target_episode_id, target_object_id, target_service_id, target_task_id, '1',  in_entry_by, in_target_reviewer,in_entry_by);

SET created_req_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();

INSERT INTO `s2_prodn`.`dailies_ticket_event` (`req_id`, `state_id`, `who`, `notes`, `pub_id`,`lastupdated_by`) VALUES (created_req_id, '1', in_entry_by, in_notes, in_pub_id,in_entry_by);
select 1, "Successfully inserted.", created_req_id as req_id;
SET child_created_req_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();


If in_parent_req_id is not null then
UPDATE `s2_prodn`.`dailies_ticket_request` SET `parent_req_id` = in_parent_req_id WHERE (`req_id` = created_req_id);
UPDATE `s2_prodn`.`dailies_ticket_request` SET `der_child_req_id` = created_req_id WHERE (`req_id` = in_parent_req_id);
end if;
COMMIT;
    
END

leaf_dailies_dashboard_aggregate 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_dailies_dashboard_aggregate`(in in_start date, in in_end date)
BEGIN
select tix_date as tix_date,
		req_type,
		count(*) as total_count,
		sum(is_resolved) as resolved_count,
        count(*) - sum(is_resolved) as open_count,
        round(avg(if(is_resolved, resolve_time,null)),0) as avg_resolve_mins
	from s2_prodn.root_dailies_dashboard_res_time_by_tix
    where tix_date between in_start and in_end
	group by tix_date,req_type 
    order by tix_date,req_type;
END
leaf_dailies_dashboard_reviewer 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_dailies_dashboard_reviewer`(in in_start date, in in_end date)
BEGIN
select 
		target_reviewer,
        service_type,
		count(*) as total_count,
		sum(is_resolved) as resolved_count,
        count(*) - sum(is_resolved) as open_count,
        round(avg(if(is_resolved, resolve_time,null)),0) as avg_resolve_mins
	from root_dailies_dashboard_res_time_by_tix
    where tix_date between in_start and in_end
	group by target_reviewer, service_type
    order by target_reviewer, service_type;
END
leaf_dailies_dashboard_service_type 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_dailies_dashboard_service_type`(in in_start date, in in_end date)
BEGIN
select 
        service_type,
		count(*) as total_count,
		sum(is_resolved) as resolved_count,
        count(*) - sum(is_resolved) as open_count,
        round(avg(if(is_resolved, resolve_time,null)),0) as avg_resolve_mins
	from root_dailies_dashboard_res_time_by_tix
    where tix_date between in_start and in_end
	group by service_type
    order by service_type;
END
leaf_deauthorize_bin 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_deauthorize_bin`(in target_bin int,in target_initialentry_by int, out exec_status bool, out exec_msg tinytext, out exec_bin int)
mySP: BEGIN

DECLARE target_bin_auth_isnull bool;
DECLARE target_bin_invoice_count int default 0;
DECLARE target_prop_state_lock_count int default 0;
DECLARE target_auth_quote_id int default null;

DECLARE exception_code CHAR(5) DEFAULT '00000';
DECLARE exception_msg TEXT DEFAULT '--';

DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
		BEGIN
              GET DIAGNOSTICS CONDITION 1
              exception_code = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, exception_msg = MESSAGE_TEXT;
              
              set exec_status = 0;
              SET exec_msg = CONCAT("exec_code ", exception_code, " message", exception_msg);
              ROLLBACK; 
              
	END;
        
SET exec_status = 0;
SET exec_msg="-";
SET exec_bin = target_bin;

SELECT isnull(auth_id) into target_bin_auth_isnull from billing_item where bin=target_bin;

IF target_bin_auth_isnull	
		THEN
			SET exec_status = 0;
			SET exec_msg = concat("De-authorization failed: Billing item ",target_bin," is not currently authiorized.");
		LEAVE mySP;
END IF;

SELECT count(*) into target_bin_invoice_count
FROM invoice_item where bin=target_bin;

IF target_bin_invoice_count > 0	
	THEN
			SET exec_status = 0;
			SET exec_msg = concat("De-authorization failed: Billing item is currently assocaited with ",target_bin_invoice_count," invoice(s).");
            select exec_status, exec_msg;
	END IF;
    
SELECT quote_id INTO target_auth_quote_id FROM billing_item WHERE  bin=target_bin;
    
SELECT sum(if(bp.prop_stage != "WIP",1,0))  INTO target_prop_state_lock_count 
                FROM bid_prop_item as bpi
				LEFT JOIN bid_prop as bp on (bpi.bid_prop_id = bp.bid_prop_id)
				WHERE bpi.quote_id = target_auth_quote_id
                GROUP BY bpi.quote_id;

    
	START TRANSACTION;  		
    
		UPDATE quote  SET locked = if(target_prop_state_lock_count,1,0),lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by WHERE quote_id = target_auth_quote_id;
		UPDATE billing_item SET auth_id = null, `status` = "Pending", lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by WHERE  bin = target_bin;
		SET exec_status = 1;
		SET exec_msg = "Successfully Deauthorized";
        
	COMMIT;


END
leaf_delete_bid_opportunity 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_delete_bid_opportunity`(in in_bid_id INT, out exec_status int, out exec_msg tinytext)
delSP: BEGIN
	
    set exec_status = 0;
	set exec_msg="Failed";
    
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s2_prodn.billing_item WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id AND `status` <> "Pending") THEN
		
		set exec_status = 0;
		set exec_msg="Failed! one of the BillingItem is not in Pending state!";
		leave delSP;		
    END IF;
    
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM s2_prodn.billing_item WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id) < 1 THEN
		
		DELETE FROM s2_prodn.bid WHERE bid_id = in_bid_id;
        
        set exec_status = 200;
		set exec_msg = "Successfully deleted";
    END IF;
    
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s2_prodn.billing_item WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id AND `status`="Pending") THEN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s2_prodn.quote WHERE bin in (SELECT bin FROM s2_prodn.billing_item WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id AND `status`="Pending")) THEN		
			
            start transaction;
            
            UPDATE s2_prodn.billing_item SET quote_id=NULL WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id AND `status`="Pending";
			DELETE FROM s2_prodn.quote WHERE bin in (SELECT bin FROM s2_prodn.billing_item WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id AND `status`="Pending");
			DELETE FROM s2_prodn.billing_item WHERE bid_id=in_bid_id AND `status`="Pending";
			DELETE FROM s2_prodn.bid WHERE bid_id = in_bid_id AND bid_id NOT IN (select bid_id from s2_prodn.bid_prop where bid_id=in_bid_id);
            set exec_status = 201;
			set exec_msg = "Successfully deleted";
            Commit;
        END IF;  
    END IF;

END
leaf_delete_bin 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_delete_bin`(in target_bin int, out exec_status bool, out exec_msg tinytext)
mySP: BEGIN


declare target_bin_auth_isnull bool default 0;
declare target_bin_prop_count int default 0;
DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK;
        RESIGNAL;
    END;
set exec_status = 0;
set exec_msg="-";


	select isnull(auth_id) into target_bin_auth_isnull
		from billing_item where bin=target_bin;
    
	if  target_bin_auth_isnull  = 0
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = "Delete failed: Cannot delete billing item that is currently authorized.";
			leave mySP;  
	end if;


	select count(distinct bid_prop_id) into target_bin_prop_count 
			from billing_item as bi 
			left join quote as q on (bi.bin = q.bin)
			left join bid_prop_item as bpi on (bpi.quote_id = q.quote_id)
			where bi.bin = target_bin;
            
	if target_bin_prop_count > 0 	
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = concat("Delete failed: Billing item is currently in ",target_bin_prop_count," proposal(s).");
			leave mySP;
	end if;
	


	START TRANSACTION;
		update billing_item
			set quote_id = NULL
			where bin = target_bin;
			
		delete from quote
			where quote.bin = target_bin;
			
		delete from billing_item
			where bin = target_bin;

		set exec_status = 1;
		set exec_msg = "Billing Item Deleted Successfully";
    COMMIT;

END
leaf_delete_proposal 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_delete_proposal`(in target_bid_prop_id int, out exec_status bool, out exec_msg tinytext)
mySP: BEGIN

declare target_auth_exists_count int default 0;
set exec_status = 0;
set exec_msg="Failed";

	if((select prop_stage from bid_prop where bid_prop_id = target_bid_prop_id)) != "WIP" then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = "Proposal Delete Failed: Proposal not in WIP stage.";
			leave mySP;
	end if;

	start transaction;  				  
	
		delete from bid_prop_item where bid_prop_id = target_bid_prop_id;
        delete from bid_prop where bid_prop_id = target_bid_prop_id;
        
		set exec_status = 1;
		set exec_msg = "Successfully deleted";
	Commit;
end
leaf_delete_proposal_item 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_delete_proposal_item`( in in_bid_prop_id int,in in_bid_prop_item_id int )
BEGIN
DECLARE VAR INT;
DECLARE vQuoteId INT;
DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION SET VAR = 1;
SET VAR = 0;
	IF EXISTS (select 1 from bid_prop where bid_prop_id = in_bid_prop_id and prop_stage = 'WIP') THEN
		
		select quote_id into vQuoteId from bid_prop_item where bid_prop_item_id = in_bid_prop_item_id;
        
        delete from bid_prop_item where bid_prop_item_id = in_bid_prop_item_id;
		
		IF NOT EXISTS (select 1 from bid_prop_item where quote_id = vQuoteId and bid_prop_item_id <> in_bid_prop_item_id) THEN
		
			update quote SET locked = 0 where quote_id = vQuoteId;
					
		ELSE
			SET VAR = 1;
		END IF;
	END IF;
 
select VAR;
END
leaf_delete_quote 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_delete_quote`(in target_quote_id int, out exec_status bool, out exec_msg tinytext)
mySP: BEGIN


declare is_target_quote_auth bool default 0;
declare target_quote_prop_count int default 0;
set exec_status = 0;
set exec_msg="-";


	select (not isnull(auth_id)) into is_target_quote_auth
		from billing_item where quote_id=target_quote_id;

	if  is_target_quote_auth		
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = "Delete failed: Cannot delete quote because it is part of an authorized billing item.";
			leave mySP;
	end if;


	select count(*) into target_quote_prop_count from bid_prop_item
		where quote_id = target_quote_id;
		
	if target_quote_prop_count > 0		
		then
			set exec_status = 0;
			set exec_msg = concat("Delete failed: Quote is currently in ",target_quote_prop_count," proposal(s).");
			leave mySP;
	end if;
	

	delete from quote
		where quote.quote_id = target_quote_id;

	set exec_status = 1;
	set exec_msg = "Quote Deleted Successfully";

END
leaf_duplicate_task_by_task_id 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_duplicate_task_by_task_id`(in_task_id int, in_initialentry_by int)
BEGIN
	DECLARE new_task_id int;
	DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION 
    BEGIN
          ROLLBACK;
    END;
   select @qCount:= cast(cast( right(task_label,1) as unsigned) + 1 as char) from task where task_id=311963 order by task_label desc limit 1;
   START TRANSACTION;
	INSERT  into task (`feedsinto_task_id`, `service_id`, `task_label`, `skill_id`, `facility_code`, `task_desc`, `task_status`, `task_complexity`, `pd_allocated`, `initialentry_by`,`lastupdated_by`)
	select feedsinto_task_id , service_id , concat(task_label,@qCount) , skill_id , facility_code  , task_desc , task_status, task_complexity , pd_allocated, in_initialentry_by, in_initialentry_by from task where task_id = in_task_id;
	  SET new_task_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();

	INSERT  into assignment (task_id, day_id, pd, day_order, initialentry_by, lastupdated_by)
	select new_task_id, day_id, pd, day_order, in_initialentry_by,in_initialentry_by from assignment where task_id = in_task_id;
	COMMIT;
	
	select new_task_id;
END
leaf_exceptions_service_object 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_exceptions_service_object`(in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN


with framechk as 
		(select svc.service_id as service_id, 1 as err_frames
			from service as svc
			join object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
            where isnull(o.shot_frame_start) or isnull(o.shot_frame_end)),
	authworkchk as
		(select svc.service_id as service_id, 1 as err_authwork
			from service as svc
            join billing_item as bi on (svc.bin = bi.bin)
            where bi.status != 'Authorized' and svc.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP','Deliv','Appr')),
	authpdchk as
		(select svc.service_id as service_id, 1 as err_authpd
			from service as svc
            join billing_item as bi on (svc.bin = bi.bin)
            where bi.status = 'Authorized' and (isnull(svc.pd_bid) or svc.pd_bid=0 or isnull(svc.pd_approved) or svc.pd_approved = 0)),
	cplxchk as
		(select service_id, 1 as warn_complexity
			from service where isnull(service_complexity)
            group by service_id)
select 	s.date_bid_start, 
		s.show_id,
        s.show_name,
        o.object_id,
        o.obj_name,
        svc.service_id,
        framechk.service_id, 
		framechk.err_frames,
        authworkchk.err_authwork, 
        err_authpd, 
        warn_complexity
			from service as svc
			join object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
            join `show` as s on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
            left join framechk on (framechk.service_id = svc.service_id)
            left join authworkchk on (authworkchk.service_id = svc.service_id)
            left join authpdchk on (authpdchk.service_id = svc.service_id)
            left join cplxchk on (cplxchk.service_id = svc.service_id)
            where s.date_bid_start between in_start_date and in_end_date 
            and (err_frames or err_authwork or warn_complexity);
END
leaf_extract_booking_by_show_svc_month 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_extract_booking_by_show_svc_month`(in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN


    with staff as (select 	show_id,
							if(role_type='Producer',p.der_nickname,'') as producer,
                            if(role_type='Executive Producer',p.der_nickname,'') as exec_producer
					from s2_prodn.show_bot_staff as sbs join s2_prodn.person as p on (sbs.person_id = p.person_id) 
                    where role_type in ('Producer','Executive Producer'))
    select 	
        b.show_id,
		acct.name as account_name,
		s.show_name as show_name, 
        bi.service_type_id,
		st.service_type_label as service_name,
        extract(year_month from a.auth_on) as yrmon,
        staff.exec_producer as exec_producer,
        staff.producer as producer,
		s.calc_yrmon_bid_start as show_start_month,
    
		ifnull(s.production_metro,'') as prodn_metro,
		svc.service_id as service_id,
        format(sum(q.pd_approved),2) as total_approved_pd,
        format(sum(q.net_price),2) as total_net_price,
        format(ifnull(sum(q.net_price)/sum(q.pd_approved),0),2) as avg_net_price,
        now() as last_updated_on
from s2_prodn.billing_item as bi 
join s2_prodn.quote as q on (q.quote_id = bi.quote_id)
join s2_prodn.authorization as a on (a.auth_id = bi.auth_id)
join s2_prodn.bid as b on (b.bid_id = bi.bid_id)
join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (s.show_id = b.show_id)
left join staff  on (staff.show_id = s.show_id)
join s2_prodn.account as acct on (s.account_id = acct.account_id)
left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.bin = bi.bin)
left join s2_prodn.service_type as st on (st.service_type_id = bi.service_type_id)
where not isnull(bi.auth_id) and (a.auth_on between in_start_date and in_end_date) 
group by b.show_id,bi.service_type_id,extract(year_month from a.auth_on);
END

leaf_extract_rev_lineitems 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_extract_rev_lineitems`(in in_start_yrmon int, in in_end_yrmon int)
BEGIN
        
select 	i.calc_yrmon_inv_date as yearmonth,
        extract(year from min(i.inv_date)) as yr,
        extract(month from min(i.inv_date)) as mon,
        extract(quarter from min(i.inv_date)) as qtr,
        concat(extract(quarter from min(i.inv_date)),"Q",year(min(i.inv_date))) as qtr_yr,
		i.show_id,
        abi.service_type_id,
        ash.show_name,
        ash.account_id,
        ash.account_nickname,
        ash.account_group_name,
        ash.exec_producer_nickname,
        ash.show_type,
		s.billing_metro,
		ifnull(sum(aii.inv_amount),0) as revenue_inv_basis,
        ifnull(sum(aii.paid_to_date),0) as revenue_amount_paid,
        (ifnull(sum(aii.inv_amount),0)-ifnull(sum(aii.paid_to_date),0)) as revenue_amount_unpaid,
        round(avg(aii.calc_inv2pmt_days),1) as savg_inv2pmt_days
	from s2_prodn.auto_invoice_item as aii
    join s2_prodn.invoice as i  on (aii.invoice_id = i.invoice_id)
    join s2_prodn.auto_show as ash on (ash.show_id = i.show_id)
    join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (s.show_id = i.show_id)
    join s2_prodn.auto_billing_item as abi on (abi.bin = aii.bin)
    where i.calc_yrmon_inv_date between in_start_yrmon and in_end_yrmon
    group by i.calc_yrmon_inv_date, i.show_id, abi.service_type_id;
END
leaf_gen_auto_week_person_for_task 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_gen_auto_week_person_for_task`(in in_person_id int, in in_task_id int)
BEGIN
	
	delete from s2_prodn.auto_week_person awk where awk.person_id = in_person_id and awk.yrweek in 
	(select calc_yrweek from assignment a where a.task_id  = in_task_id); 
	
	
	insert into auto_week_person
			(yrweek,person_id,task_id_1,task_id_2,task_id_3,task_id_4,task_id_5,task_id_6,task_id_7,
			tot_pd_1,tot_pd_2,tot_pd_3,tot_pd_4,tot_pd_5,tot_pd_6,tot_pd_7)
			select * from (select a.calc_yrweek,t.person_id,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 2,a.task_id,null)) as task1,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 3,a.task_id,null)) as task2,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 4,a.task_id,null)) as task3,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 5,a.task_id,null)) as task4,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 6,a.task_id,null)) as task5,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 7,a.task_id,null)) as task6,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 1,a.task_id,null)) as task7,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 2,a.pd,0)) as asgn1,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 3,a.pd,0)) as asgn2,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 4,a.pd,0)) as asgn3,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 5,a.pd,0)) as asgn4,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 6,a.pd,0)) as asgn5,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 7,a.pd,0)) as asgn6,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 1,a.pd,0)) as asgn7
			from assignment as a 
			left join task t on a.task_id  = t.task_id 
			left join assignment as a2 on a2.calc_yrweek = a.calc_yrweek and a2.task_id  = in_task_id
				group by calc_yrweek,person_id) as placeholder where placeholder.person_id = in_person_id 
			on duplicate key update
				task_id_1 = task1,
				task_id_2 = task2,
				task_id_3 = task3,
				task_id_4 = task4,
				task_id_5 = task5,
				task_id_6 = task6,
				task_id_7 = task7,
				tot_pd_1 = asgn1,
				tot_pd_2 = asgn2,
				tot_pd_3 = asgn3,
				tot_pd_4 = asgn4,
				tot_pd_5 = asgn5,
				tot_pd_6 = asgn6,
				tot_pd_7 = asgn7;
END

DELETE FROM s2_dwh.core_affiliation;

leaf_generate_mediafile_id 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_generate_mediafile_id`(in init_person_id int)
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE new_uuid binary(16);
    SET new_uuid = UUID_TO_BIN(UUID());
	insert into s2_prodn.mediafile 
		set mediafile_id = new_uuid, initialentry_by=init_person_id, lastupdated_by=init_person_id; 
	case row_count()
		when 1 then select bin_to_uuid(new_uuid);
        else select null;
	end case;

leaf_invoice_list_by_date 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_invoice_list_by_date`(in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN

select 	s.account_nickname,
		s.show_name,
        s.stage,
        i.show_id,
        i.invoice_id,
        i.inv_date,
        i.yrmon,
        i.yrweek,
        i.item_count,
        i.bin_count,
        i.inv_status,
        i.inv_total,
        ifnull(sum(p.payment_inv_alloc),0) as paid,
        i.inv_total - ifnull(sum(p.payment_inv_alloc),0) as outstanding,
        group_concat(concat('Pmt#',p.payment_id,' (',p.paid_on,') : ',p.payment_inv_alloc) separator '\n')
	from  api_root_invoice_list as i 
    join auto_show as s on s.show_id = i.show_id
    left join api_root_payment_inv_alloc as p on p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
    where i.inv_date between in_start_date and in_end_date
    group by i.invoice_id
	order by i.inv_date asc;
        

END
leaf_link_bin_service 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_link_bin_service`( in_bin INT,in_service_id INT,in target_initialentry_by int, in transfer_quote tinyint(1) )
BEGIN

 DECLARE link_status_st VARCHAR(32);
 DECLARE VAR INT;
 
 set var=0;
 set @quote_id = null;
 set @pd_approved = null;
 set @pd_bid = null;
 set @complexity = null;
 set @quote_scope = null;
 set @client_service_desc = null;
 

 select @quote_id:=quote_id, @client_service_desc:=client_service_desc from billing_item where bin = in_bin;
 select @pd_approved:=pd_approved, @pd_bid:=pd_bid, @complexity:=est_complexity, @quote_scope:= quote_scope from quote where quote_id = @quote_id;
 
 
 IF transfer_quote = 1 THEN
	 UPDATE service ser
		SET 
			ser.bin = in_bin,
			ser.pd_bid = @pd_bid,
			ser.pd_approved = @pd_approved,
			ser.service_complexity = @complexity, 
			ser.client_service_desc = @client_service_desc, 
			ser.lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by
			WHERE
			ser.service_id = in_service_id;
END IF;

IF transfer_quote = 0 THEN
	UPDATE service ser
		SET
			ser.bin = in_bin,
            ser.lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by
			WHERE
			ser.service_id = in_service_id;
END IF;

SELECT in_service_id as service_id, in_bin  as bin;
 
 END
leaf_object_create_from_bin 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_object_create_from_bin`( in target_bin int, in target_initialentry_by int, out exec_status bool, out exec_obj int, out exec_msg tinytext )
BEGIN	
	
     DECLARE `_rollback` BOOL DEFAULT 0;
    declare is_obj_name_duplicate int default 0;
    declare is_group_name_duplicate int default 0;
    declare target_bid_id int default null;
    declare target_show_id int default null;
    declare target_quote_id int default null;
    declare target_obj_group_id int default null;
    declare target_obj_group_name varchar(50) default null;
    declare target_obj_name varchar(128) default null;
    declare target_obj_description text default null;
    declare target_obj_shot_frame_start int default null;
    declare target_obj_shot_frame_end int default null;
    declare target_obj_work_start int default null;
    declare target_obj_work_end int default null;
    
    declare target_service_type_id int default null;
	declare target_client_Service_desc text default null;
    declare target_client_due date default null;
    declare target_final_due date default null;
    declare target_service_complexity enum('1','2','3','4','5') default null;
    declare target_pd_approved decimal(10,2) default null;
    declare target_pd_bid decimal(10,2) default null;
    declare target_service_label varchar(50) default null;
    declare created_group_id int default null;
    declare created_object_id int default null;
    
    
    set exec_status = 0;
    set exec_obj = 0;
	set exec_msg = "Attempt to Insert a new object and associated service Failed.";
    
	select 
		obj_name,
       
        bid_id,
        client_service_desc,
        service_type_id,
        quote_id,
        final_due,
        service_label,
        shot_frame_start,
        shot_frame_end,
        obj_description        
			into
        target_obj_name,
       
        target_bid_id,
        target_client_Service_desc,
        target_service_type_id,
        target_quote_id,
        target_final_due,
        target_service_label,
        target_obj_shot_frame_start,
        target_obj_shot_frame_end,
        target_obj_description
        
    from billing_item 
	where 
		bin = target_bin;
        
	select 
		working_start,
        working_end,
        client_due,
        est_complexity,
        pd_bid,
        pd_approved
			into 
        target_obj_work_start,
        target_obj_work_end,
        target_client_due,
        target_service_complexity,
        target_pd_bid,
        target_pd_approved
	from quote 
    where quote_id = target_quote_id;

    
    select show_id into target_show_id from bid where bid_id = target_bid_id;
    select sum(if(obj_name = target_obj_name,1,0)) into is_obj_name_duplicate from object where show_id = target_show_id;
        
     if is_obj_name_duplicate then 
	 set target_obj_name = concat(target_obj_name,"_",cast(round(rand()*1000,0) as char));
	 end if;
	
    
    
    start transaction;
		
			
		
			
			
		
		
		insert into object
			  (show_id,
              
              obj_type,
              obj_name,
              `description`,
              shot_frame_start,
              shot_frame_end,
             
            
              initialentry_by,
              lastupdated_by)
			  values(
			  target_show_id,
              
              'Shot',
              target_obj_name,
              target_obj_description,
              target_obj_shot_frame_start,
              target_obj_shot_frame_end,
              
              
              target_initialentry_by,
              target_initialentry_by
			 );
		SET created_object_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();
        
		
		insert into service (service_type_id,
							 object_id,
                            bin,
                            client_service_desc,
                            date_client_due,
                            date_final_due,
                            service_complexity,
                            pd_bid,
                            pd_approved,
                            service_label,
                            working_frame_start,
                            working_frame_end,
                            initialentry_by,
                            lastupdated_by) 
				values (	
							target_service_type_id,
                            created_object_id,
                            target_bin,
                            target_client_Service_desc,
                            target_client_due,
                            target_final_due,
                            target_service_complexity,
                            target_pd_bid,
                            target_pd_approved,
							target_service_label,
                            target_obj_work_start,
							target_obj_work_end,
							target_initialentry_by,
                            target_initialentry_by);
        set exec_status = 1;
        set exec_obj = created_object_id;
		set exec_msg = "Successfully inserted.";
	
     IF `_rollback` THEN
		 set exec_status=0;
		 set exec_obj=0;
		 set exec_msg="Attempt to Insert a new object and associated service Failed.";
         ROLLBACK;
      ELSE
         COMMIT;
     END IF; 
     
	
              
  END
leaf_on_task_view_by_day 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_on_task_view_by_day`( in in_on_task_date date )
BEGIN
	with clist as (	
	 SELECT
     `root_actual_activity`.`td_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`person_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`day_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`activity_type`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`is_prodn_task`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`show_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`show_name`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`object_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`obj_name`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`service_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`service_type_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`status_label`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`service_label`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`task_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`task_label`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`skill_id`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`start_time_lt`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`end_time_lt`,
    `root_actual_activity`.`is_activity_open`

FROM `s2_prodn`.`root_actual_activity`
 WHERE
	is_activity_open = 1
    ),
dlist as (
	SELECT 
			td.person_id,
            td.day_id,
            td.in_time,
            td.out_time,
            lca.start_time_lt,
            lca.end_time_lt,
            lca.is_prodn_task,
            lca.activity_type,
            lca.show_id,
            lca.show_name,
            lca.object_id,
            lca.obj_name,
            lca.service_id,
            lca.service_type_id,
            lca.service_label,
            lca.task_id,
            lca.task_label,
            lca.skill_id as task_skill_id,
            lca.is_activity_open,
            if(isnull(td.out_time), 1,0) as is_day_open
    FROM
        s2_prodn.timecard_date1 AS td
        left join clist lca  ON td.td_id = lca.td_id
        WHERE td.day_id = in_on_task_date
        )
	select per.person_id,
    per.der_nickname as nickname,
    per.der_cur_role_type as role_type,
    per.der_cur_dept_id as dept_id,
    per.der_cur_dept_label as dept_label,
    per.der_cur_billable as billable,
    per.der_cur_facility as facility,
    rc.day_id,
    rc.in_time,
    rc.out_time,
    rc.start_time_lt,
    rc.end_time_lt,
    rc.is_prodn_task,
    rc.activity_type,
    rc.show_id,
    rc.show_name,
    rc.object_id,
    rc.obj_name,
    rc.service_id,
    rc.service_type_id,
    rc.service_label,
    rc.task_id,
    rc.task_label,
    rc.task_skill_id,
    rc.is_activity_open,
    rc.is_day_open
from 
	s2_prodn.person as per 
left join dlist rc on per.person_id = rc.person_id
where per.der_cur_affil_is_active = 1;
END
leaf_payment_item_allocation 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_payment_item_allocation`(in in_payment_id int, in in_invoice_id int)
BEGIN
SELECT 
        `ii`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,
        `ii`.`inv_item_id` AS `inv_item_id`,
        `bi`.`bin` AS `bin`,
        `pi`.`payment_id` AS `payment_id`,
        `bi`.`obj_name` AS `obj_name`,
        IFNULL(`ii`.`inv_amount`, 0) AS `inv_amount`,
        (IFNULL(`aii`.`paid_to_date`, 0) - SUM(IF((`pi`.`payment_id` = in_payment_id),
            IFNULL(`pi`.`item_alloc_payment`, 0),
            0))) AS `paid_to_date`,
        SUM(IF((`pi`.`payment_id` = in_payment_id),
            IFNULL(`pi`.`item_alloc_payment`, 0),
            0)) AS `allocation`,
        (IFNULL(`ii`.`inv_amount`, 0) - IFNULL(`aii`.`paid_to_date`, 0)) AS `outstanding`,
        GROUP_CONCAT(IF((`pi`.`payment_id` = in_payment_id),
                `pi`.`payment_item_id`,
                NULL)
            SEPARATOR ',') AS `payment_item_id`
    FROM
        (((`invoice_item` `ii`
        LEFT JOIN `auto_invoice_item` `aii` ON ((`aii`.`inv_item_id` = `ii`.`inv_item_id`)))
        JOIN `billing_item` `bi` ON ((`ii`.`bin` = `bi`.`bin`)))
        JOIN `payment_item` `pi` ON ((`ii`.`inv_item_id` = `pi`.`inv_item_id`)))
        where `ii`.`invoice_id` = in_invoice_id and `pi`.`payment_id` = in_payment_id
    GROUP BY `ii`.`inv_item_id`;
END
leaf_payment_list_by_date 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_payment_list_by_date`(in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN

select  p.payment_id,
		p.paid_on,
        p.yrmon,
		p.payor,
        s.account_nickname,
        group_concat(distinct concat(s.show_name,' (#',s.show_id,')') SEPARATOR '\n') as show_list,
		p.payment_total,
        sum(p.payment_inv_alloc) as inv_allocated_total,
        (p.payment_total - sum(p.payment_inv_alloc)) as inv_allocated_gap,
        count(p.invoice_id) as inv_count,
        group_concat(concat('Show#',s.show_id,':Inv#',p.invoice_id," : $",p.payment_inv_alloc) SEPARATOR '\n') as inv_allocated
	from api_root_payment_inv_alloc as p 
    join auto_show as s on p.show_id = s.show_id
    where p.paid_on between in_start_date and in_end_date
    group by p.payment_id;
END
leaf_proposal_duplicate 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_proposal_duplicate`( in_bid_prop_id int(11),in target_initialentry_by int )
BEGIN


 
 declare new_prop_id int;
 declare new_prop_item_id int;
 
 declare exit handler for sqlstate '23000'
 	SELECT 'Duplicate Proposal Failed' as result;
 insert into bid_prop
 (bid_prop_id,
 show_id,
 prop_name,
 prop_date,
 prop_stage,
initialentry,
 initialentry_by,
 lastupdated,
 lastupdated_by)
 
 SELECT 
     NULL,
 	show_id,
 	CONCAT('Copy of - ',prop_name),	
 	prop_date,
     'WIP',
    NOW(),
 	initialentry_by,
 	NOW(),
 	lastupdated_by
 FROM
     bid_prop
 WHERE
     bid_prop_id = in_bid_prop_id;
     
 SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID() INTO new_prop_id;
 
 update bid_prop set initialentry_by = target_initialentry_by,lastupdated_by=target_initialentry_by where bid_prop_id = new_prop_id;
 insert into bid_prop_item
 (bid_prop_item_id,
 bid_prop_id,
 quote_id,
 initialentry,
 initialentry_by,
 lastupdated,
 lastupdated_by)
 
 SELECT 
 	NULL,
 	new_prop_id,
     quote_id,
    NOW(),
 	initialentry_by,
 	NOW(),
 	lastupdated_by
 FROM
     bid_prop_item
 WHERE
     bid_prop_id = in_bid_prop_id;
     
 SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID() INTO new_prop_item_id;
 

 
 SELECT * FROM bid_prop WHERE bid_prop_id = new_prop_id;
 
END
leaf_quote_duplicate 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_quote_duplicate`( in_quote_id INT, in_initialentry_by INT)
BEGIN
 	declare new_quote_id int;
 	declare exit handler for sqlstate '23000'
 		SELECT 'Duplicate Quote Failed' as result;
	
    select @qCount:= cast(cast( right(quote_label,1) as unsigned) + 1 as char) from quote where bin=(select bin from quote where quote_id = in_quote_id) order by quote_label desc limit 1;
     set @bin = null;
     set @quote_id = null;
  
 	insert into quote(
 	`quote_id`,
 	`quote_label`,
 	`quote_scope`,
     `bin`,
 	`locked`,
 	`client_quote_notes`,
 	`working_start`,
 	`working_end`,
 	
 	`pd_bid`,
 	`pd_approved`,
 	`unit_price`,
 	`qty_locked2apd`,
 	`quantity`,
 	`price`,
 	`apply_discount`,
 	`price_discount`,
 	`net_price`,
 	`notes_to_client`,
 	`work_approach_notes`,
 	`notes_to_producer`,
 	`est_deliv_date`,
 	`est_complexity`,
 	`est_by`,
 	`est_on`,
    `initialentry_by`,
    `lastupdated_by`) 
     select
 	NULL,
 	
    concat('v',@qCount),
 	`q`.`quote_scope`,
     `q`.`bin`,
 	0,
 	`q`.`client_quote_notes`,
 	`q`.`working_start`,
 	`q`.`working_end`,
 	
 	`q`.`pd_bid`,
 	`q`.`pd_approved`,
 	`q`.`unit_price`,
 	`q`.`qty_locked2apd`,
 	`q`.`quantity`,
 	`q`.`price`,
 	`q`.`apply_discount`,
 	`q`.`price_discount`,
 	`q`.`net_price`,
 	`q`.`notes_to_client`,
 	`q`.`work_approach_notes`,
 	`q`.`notes_to_producer`,
 	`q`.`est_deliv_date`,
 	`q`.`est_complexity`,
 	`q`.`est_by`,
 	`q`.`est_on`,
    `q`.`initialentry_by`,
    `q`.`lastupdated_by`
     from `quote` as `q` where `q`.`quote_id` = in_quote_id;
     
     select LAST_INSERT_ID() into @quote_id;
     
     select bin into @bin from quote where quote_id = @quote_id;
     
     update quote set initialentry_by = in_initialentry_by, lastupdated_by=in_initialentry_by where quote_id = @quote_id;
     
     update billing_item set quote_id = @quote_id,lastupdated_by=in_initialentry_by where bin = @bin;
     
     select * from quote where quote_id = @quote_id;
  
  END
leaf_report_OnTask_exceptions 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_OnTask_exceptions`(in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN
with dpa as 
	(select der_day_id as prodn_date,
			person_id,
            activity_type, 
            sum(duration) as dur,
            count(distinct object_id) as object_count
	from actual1 where der_day_id between in_start_date and in_end_date
	group by der_day_id, person_id, activity_type ),
dp as 
    (select prodn_date,
			person_id,
            sum(dur) as dur_total,
            sum(if(activity_type="Billable Work",dur,0)) as dur_bill,
            sum(if(activity_type="Non-billable Work",dur,0)) as dur_nonbill,
            sum(if(activity_type="Training",dur,0)) as dur_training,
            sum(if(activity_type="Unassigned",dur,0)) as dur_unassigned,
            sum(if(activity_type="Downtime",dur,0)) as dur_downtime,
            sum(if(activity_type="Personal Time Off",dur,0)) as dur_pertimeoff,
            sum(object_count)
	from dpa group by prodn_date,person_id)
select 	der_cur_dept_label as dept,
		dp.person_id,
		der_nickname as nickname,
        der_cur_role_type as role,
        concat(der_cur_primary_skill," (", der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency,")") as skill,
        der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency as proficiency,
		prodn_date,
		dur_total,
        dur_bill,
        dur_nonbill,
        dur_training,
        dur_unassigned,
        dur_downtime,
        dur_pertimeoff,
		if(dur_total < 7.5,1,0) as error_incomplete_day,
        if(dur_bill <  4, 1, 0) as warning_lowbillable
	from dp
    join person as p on (p.person_id = dp.person_id)
    order by dept,nickname,prodn_date;
END
leaf_report_bw_revenue 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_bw_revenue`(in in_year int,in rev_type enum('Overall','Account Group','Account','Show','Exec Producer','Producer'))
BEGIN

declare yr int;
set yr = in_year * 100;
case rev_type
	when 'Overall' then
		select 
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+1,inv_total,0)) as jan_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+2,inv_total,0)) as feb_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+3,inv_total,0)) as mar_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+1,yr+2,yr+3),inv_total,0)) as q1_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+4,inv_total,0)) as apr_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+5,inv_total,0)) as may_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+6,inv_total,0)) as jun_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+4,yr+5,yr+6),inv_total,0)) as q2_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+7,inv_total,0)) as jul_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+8,inv_total,0)) as aug_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+9,inv_total,0)) as sep_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+7,yr+8,yr+9),inv_total,0)) as q3_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+10,inv_total,0)) as oct_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+11,inv_total,0)) as nov_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+12,inv_total,0)) as dec_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+10,yr+11,yr+12),inv_total,0)) as q4_rev,
				sum(inv_total) as yr_rev
			from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
			where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') and year(inv_date)=in_year;

  when 'Account Group' then
		select * from 
			(select 
                ifnull(account_group_name,account_nickname) as account_group,
                group_concat(distinct account_nickname) as account_list,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+1,inv_total,0)) as jan_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+2,inv_total,0)) as feb_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+3,inv_total,0)) as mar_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+1,yr+2,yr+3),inv_total,0)) as q1_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+4,inv_total,0)) as apr_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+5,inv_total,0)) as may_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+6,inv_total,0)) as jun_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+4,yr+5,yr+6),inv_total,0)) as q2_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+7,inv_total,0)) as jul_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+8,inv_total,0)) as aug_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+9,inv_total,0)) as sep_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+7,yr+8,yr+9),inv_total,0)) as q3_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+10,inv_total,0)) as oct_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+11,inv_total,0)) as nov_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+12,inv_total,0)) as dec_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+10,yr+11,yr+12),inv_total,0)) as q4_rev,
				sum(inv_total) as yr_rev
			from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
			where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') and year(inv_date)=in_year
			group by ifnull(account_group_name,account_nickname)) as orig
			order by yr_rev desc;
            
    when 'Account' then
		select * from 
			(select 
				account_id,
                account_nickname as account_name,
                account_group_name as account_group,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+1,inv_total,0)) as jan_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+2,inv_total,0)) as feb_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+3,inv_total,0)) as mar_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+1,yr+2,yr+3),inv_total,0)) as q1_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+4,inv_total,0)) as apr_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+5,inv_total,0)) as may_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+6,inv_total,0)) as jun_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+4,yr+5,yr+6),inv_total,0)) as q2_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+7,inv_total,0)) as jul_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+8,inv_total,0)) as aug_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+9,inv_total,0)) as sep_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+7,yr+8,yr+9),inv_total,0)) as q3_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+10,inv_total,0)) as oct_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+11,inv_total,0)) as nov_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+12,inv_total,0)) as dec_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+10,yr+11,yr+12),inv_total,0)) as q4_rev,
				sum(inv_total) as yr_rev
			from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
			where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') and year(inv_date)=in_year
			group by account_id) as orig
			order by yr_rev desc;
            
	when 'Show' then
    	select * from 
			(select 
				show_id,
                show_name,
                exec_producer,
                producer,
				account_id,
                account_nickname as account_name,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+1,inv_total,0)) as jan_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+2,inv_total,0)) as feb_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+3,inv_total,0)) as mar_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+1,yr+2,yr+3),inv_total,0)) as q1_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+4,inv_total,0)) as apr_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+5,inv_total,0)) as may_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+6,inv_total,0)) as jun_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+4,yr+5,yr+6),inv_total,0)) as q2_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+7,inv_total,0)) as jul_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+8,inv_total,0)) as aug_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+9,inv_total,0)) as sep_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+7,yr+8,yr+9),inv_total,0)) as q3_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+10,inv_total,0)) as oct_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+11,inv_total,0)) as nov_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+12,inv_total,0)) as dec_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+10,yr+11,yr+12),inv_total,0)) as q4_rev,
				sum(inv_total) as yr_rev
			from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
			where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') and year(inv_date)=in_year
			group by show_id) as orig
			order by yr_rev desc;
            
	when 'Exec Producer' then
    	select * from 
			(select 
				exec_producer,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+1,inv_total,0)) as jan_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+2,inv_total,0)) as feb_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+3,inv_total,0)) as mar_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+1,yr+2,yr+3),inv_total,0)) as q1_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+4,inv_total,0)) as apr_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+5,inv_total,0)) as may_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+6,inv_total,0)) as jun_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+4,yr+5,yr+6),inv_total,0)) as q2_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+7,inv_total,0)) as jul_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+8,inv_total,0)) as aug_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+9,inv_total,0)) as sep_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+7,yr+8,yr+9),inv_total,0)) as q3_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+10,inv_total,0)) as oct_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+11,inv_total,0)) as nov_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+12,inv_total,0)) as dec_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+10,yr+11,yr+12),inv_total,0)) as q4_rev,
				sum(inv_total) as yr_rev
			from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
			where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') and year(inv_date)=in_year
			group by exec_producer) as orig
			order by yr_rev desc;
            
	when 'Producer' then
    	select * from 
			(select 
				producer,
				exec_producer,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+1,inv_total,0)) as jan_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+2,inv_total,0)) as feb_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+3,inv_total,0)) as mar_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+1,yr+2,yr+3),inv_total,0)) as q1_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+4,inv_total,0)) as apr_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+5,inv_total,0)) as may_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+6,inv_total,0)) as jun_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+4,yr+5,yr+6),inv_total,0)) as q2_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+7,inv_total,0)) as jul_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+8,inv_total,0)) as aug_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+9,inv_total,0)) as sep_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+7,yr+8,yr+9),inv_total,0)) as q3_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+10,inv_total,0)) as oct_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+11,inv_total,0)) as nov_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon = yr+12,inv_total,0)) as dec_rev,
				sum(if(yrmon in (yr+10,yr+11,yr+12),inv_total,0)) as q4_rev,
				sum(inv_total) as yr_rev
			from root_invoice_list_pmt_details 
			where inv_status in ('Released','Closed') and year(inv_date)=in_year
			group by producer) as orig
			order by yr_rev desc;
end case;
END
leaf_report_mw_de_assignments_summary_by_week_service 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_assignments_summary_by_week_service`()
BEGIN

select 	a.calc_yrweek as week_no,
		min(a.day_id) as week_of,
		sum(if(s.service_type_id=1,a.pd,0)) as comp_asgn_pds,
        sum(if(s.service_type_id=2,a.pd,0)) as roto_asgn_pds,
        sum(if(s.service_type_id=3,a.pd,0)) as paint_asgn_pds,
        sum(if(s.service_type_id=4,a.pd,0)) as mm_asgn_pds,
        sum(if(s.service_type_id=5,a.pd,0)) as rm_asgn_pds,
        sum(if(s.service_type_id=6,a.pd,0)) as asset_asgn_pds,
        sum(a.pd) as tot_asgn_pds
	from assignment as a
    join task as t on a.task_id = t.task_id
    join service as s on s.service_id = t.service_id
    join auto_service as asvc on asvc.service_id = s.service_id
    join object as o on o.object_id = s.object_id
where a.calc_yrweek > yearweek(curdate())
group by a.calc_yrweek
order by a.calc_yrweek;
END
leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_by_month 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_by_month`(in in_yrmon int)
BEGIN

with slist as 
	(select d.calc_yrmon_deliv_date,
			svc.service_id, 
            os.os_provider_id,
			asvc.der_service_type_label as service_type,
			svc.pd_approved
		from service as svc
        left join auto_service as asvc on (svc.service_id = asvc.service_id)
        join delivery as d on (d.delivery_id = asvc.der_ffd_deliv_id)
        left join os_service as os on os.os_service_id = svc.os_service_id
        where d.calc_yrmon_deliv_date = in_yrmon   and svc.pd_approved>0 
        group by svc.service_id),
alist as
	(select calc_yrmon_deliv_date,
			slist.service_id, 
            service_type,
			slist.pd_approved, 
            os_provider_id, 
            sum(pd_allocated), 
            (slist.pd_approved -sum(pd_allocated)) AS gap,
            if((sum(t.pd_allocated) is null),0,1) as include_alloc, 
            round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='LBR' or isnull(p.der_cur_facility),pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as lbr_alloc,
			round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='CJB',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as cjb_alloc,
			round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='ATL',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as atl_alloc,
            round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='PNQ',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as pnq_alloc
		from slist 
		left join task as t on (slist.service_id = t.service_id)
		left join person as p on (t.person_id = p.person_id)
		group by slist.service_id)
select 
        calc_yrmon_deliv_date as yearmonth,
        sum(pd_approved) as tot_appr,
		sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*lbr_alloc),0)) as lbr_apd,
        sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*cjb_alloc),0)) as cjb_apd,
        sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*pnq_alloc),0)) as pnq_apd,
        sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*atl_alloc),0)) as atl_apd,
        sum(if(not include_alloc and isnull(os_provider_id),pd_approved,0)) as unknown_apd,
        sum(if(not include_alloc and not isnull(os_provider_id),pd_approved,0)) as outsource_pd
	from alist;
END
leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_by_month2 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_by_month2`(in in_yrmon int)
BEGIN
/* Fix provided 9/26/22 by Hitesh  */
with slist as 
	(select d.calc_yrmon_deliv_date,
			svc.service_id, 
            os.os_provider_id,
			asvc.der_service_type_label as service_type,
			svc.pd_approved
		from service as svc
        left join auto_service as asvc on (svc.service_id = asvc.service_id)
        join delivery as d on (d.delivery_id = asvc.der_ffd_deliv_id)
        left join os_service as os on os.os_service_id = svc.os_service_id
        where d.calc_yrmon_deliv_date = in_yrmon   and svc.pd_approved>0 
        group by svc.service_id),
alist as
	(select calc_yrmon_deliv_date,
			slist.service_id, 
            service_type,
            os_provider_id, 
            sum(pd_allocated) as pd_allocated,
			slist.pd_approved as pd_approved, 
			if(isnull(os_provider_id), 0, pd_approved-ifnull(sum(pd_allocated),0)) as os_net_pd_approved,
           
			ifnull(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='LBR',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),0)*pd_approved as lbr_prorata_pd_approved,
			ifnull(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='CJB',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),0)*pd_approved as cjb_prorata_pd_approved,
			ifnull(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='ATL',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),0)*pd_approved as atl_prorata_pd_approved,
            ifnull(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='PNQ',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),0)*pd_approved as pnq_prorata_pd_approved,
			ifnull(sum(if(ifnull(p.der_cur_facility,'') not in ('LBR','CJB','ATL','PNQ'),pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),0)*pd_approved as unknown_prorata_pd_approved

		from slist 
		left join task as t on (slist.service_id = t.service_id)
		left join person as p on (t.person_id = p.person_id)
		group by slist.service_id)
select 
        calc_yrmon_deliv_date as yearmonth,
        sum(pd_allocated) as pd_allocated,
        
        sum(pd_approved) as pd_approved,
        round(sum(os_net_pd_approved),2) as os_net_pd_approved,
        round(sum(lbr_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(cjb_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(pnq_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(atl_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(unknown_prorata_pd_approved),2)
			as in_house_pd_approved,
            
        round(sum(lbr_prorata_pd_approved),2) as lbr_prorata_pd_approved,
        round(sum(cjb_prorata_pd_approved),2) as cjb_prorata_pd_approved,
        round(sum(pnq_prorata_pd_approved),2) as pnq_prorata_pd_approved,
        round(sum(atl_prorata_pd_approved),2) as atl_prorata_pd_approved,
        round(sum(unknown_prorata_pd_approved),2) as unknown_prorata_pd_approved,
        
        round(sum(pd_approved)-(sum(os_net_pd_approved)+sum(lbr_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(cjb_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(pnq_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(atl_prorata_pd_approved)+sum(unknown_prorata_pd_approved)),2) 
			as cross_check
        
	from alist;
END
leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_by_service_month

BEGIN

with slist as

            service_type,
			slist.pd_approved, 
            os_provider_id, 
            sum(pd_allocated),

            if((sum(t.pd_allocated) is null),0,1) as include_alloc, 
            round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='LBR' or isnull(p.der_cur_facility),pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as lbr_alloc,
