        sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*cjb_alloc),0)) as cjb_apd,
        sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*pnq_alloc),0)) as pnq_apd,
        sum(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*atl_alloc),0)) as atl_apd,
        sum(if(not include_alloc and isnull(os_provider_id),pd_approved,0)) as unknown_apd,
        sum(if(not include_alloc and not isnull(os_provider_id),pd_approved,0)) as outsource_pd
	from alist
    group by service_type;
END
leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_details_by_month 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_deliv_pds_details_by_month`(in in_yrmon int)
BEGIN

with slist as 
	(select d.calc_yrmon_deliv_date,
			d.deliv_date,
			svc.service_id, 
            svc.object_id,
            os.os_provider_id,
			asvc.der_service_type_label as service_type,
			svc.pd_approved,
            svc.service_complexity as avg_service_complexity
		from service as svc
        left join auto_service as asvc on (svc.service_id = asvc.service_id)
        join delivery as d on (d.delivery_id = asvc.der_ffd_deliv_id)
        left join os_service as os on os.os_service_id = svc.os_service_id
        where d.calc_yrmon_deliv_date = in_yrmon   and svc.pd_approved>0 
        group by svc.service_id),
alist as
	(select calc_yrmon_deliv_date,
			deliv_date,
			slist.service_id,
            slist.avg_service_complexity,
            slist.object_id,
            service_type,
			slist.pd_approved, 
            os_provider_id, 
            sum(pd_allocated), 
            (slist.pd_approved -sum(pd_allocated)) AS gap,
            if((sum(t.pd_allocated) is null),0,1) as include_alloc, 
            round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='LBR' or isnull(p.der_cur_facility),pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as lbr_alloc,
			round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='CJB',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as cjb_alloc,
			round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='ATL',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as atl_alloc,
            round(sum(if(p.der_cur_facility='PNQ',pd_allocated,0))/sum(pd_allocated),2) as pnq_alloc
		from slist 
		left join task as t on (slist.service_id = t.service_id)
		left join person as p on (t.person_id = p.person_id)
		group by slist.service_id)
select 
        calc_yrmon_deliv_date as yearmonth,
        deliv_date,
        s.show_name,
        o.obj_name,
        o.object_id,
        service_type,
        service_id,
        avg_service_complexity,
        pd_approved,
		round(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*lbr_alloc),0),2) as lbr_apd,
        round(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*cjb_alloc),0),2) as cjb_apd,
        round(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*pnq_alloc),0),2) as pnq_apd,
        round(if(include_alloc,(pd_approved*atl_alloc),0),2) as atl_apd,
        round(if(not include_alloc and isnull(os_provider_id),pd_approved,0),2) as unknown_apd,
        round(if(not include_alloc and not isnull(os_provider_id),pd_approved,0),2) as outsource_pd
	from alist 
    join object as o on (o.object_id = alist.object_id)
    join `auto_show` as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id);
END
leaf_report_mw_de_interim_dashbot_feeder 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_interim_dashbot_feeder`(in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN
select  svc.service_id as service_id,
		s.account_nickname as company,
		s.show_name as `show`,
        o.obj_name as shot,
		og.group_name as group_name,
        asvc.der_service_type_label as service_type,
        svc.service_label as service_label,
        svc.status_label as service_status,
        svc.service_complexity,
        work_to_date_pct as WTD_pct,
        work_to_date_notes as WTD_notes,
        date_bot_due as bot_due,
        date_client_due as client_due,
        date_final_due as final_due,
        svc.pd_bid as bid_pd,
        svc.pd_approved as appr_pd,
        asvc.der_date_ffd as FFD_date,
        asvc.der_pd_actual as total_actual_pd,
        asvc.der_pre_ffd as PreFFD_pd,
        asvc.der_post_ffd as PostFFD_pd,
        svc.working_frame_start as working_start_frame,
        svc.working_frame_end as working_end_frame,
        svc.working_frame_count as working_frame_count,
        if(os_service_id,1,0) as is_outsourced,
        al.artistlist as tc_artist_list,
        abs.creative_lead,
        abs.prodn_lead,
        s.supervisor_nickname as show_supervisor,
        ads.fd_count as full_deliv_count,
        ads.max_ver,
        ads.last_deliv_date
        
	from service as svc
	join auto_service as asvc on (asvc.service_id = svc.service_id)
    join object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
    left join obj_group as og on (og.group_id = o.group_id)  
    join auto_object as ao on (ao.object_id = o.object_id)
    left join auto_show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
    left join root_service_artistlist as al on (al.service_id = svc.service_id)
    left join root_botstaff_by_service as abs on (abs.service_id = svc.service_id)
    left join root_deliv_stats_by_service as ads on (ads.service_id = svc.service_id)
    where date_bot_due between in_start_date and in_end_date
    order by company,`show`,shot; 
END
leaf_report_mw_de_prodn_summary_by_service 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_prodn_summary_by_service`(in in_service_type_id int)
BEGIN

select 
	s.account_nickname,
    s.show_name,
    o.show_id,
    concat('https://s2.botvfx.com/shot?show_id=',o.show_id,'&service_type_id=',in_service_type_id) as link,
    count(distinct o.object_id) as shot_count,
    count(*) as service_count,
	sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Pend','AI'),1,0)) as pending_count,
    sum(if(svc.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),1,0)) as ip_count,
    sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),1,0)) as done_count,
	sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Hold','Omit'),1,0)) as pause_count,
    sum(svc.pd_bid) as total_bid_pd,
    sum(svc.pd_approved) as total_approved_pd,
    sum(asvc.der_pd_assigned) as total_assigned_pd,
    sum(asvc.der_pd_actual) as total_actual_pd,
    sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),svc.pd_approved,0)) as done_appr_pd,
    sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),asvc.der_pd_actual,0)) as done_actual_pd,
    sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),svc.pd_approved,0)) /
		sum(if(svc.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),asvc.der_pd_actual,0)) as done_eff_ratio

  from s2_prodn.service as svc
  join s2_prodn.auto_service as asvc on (svc.service_id = asvc.service_id)
  join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
  join s2_prodn.`auto_show` as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
  where s.stage = "Active" and account_id <>1 and service_type_id=in_service_type_id
  group by o.show_id;
END
leaf_report_mw_de_service_lineitems_by_service 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_mw_de_service_lineitems_by_service`(in in_service_type_id int)
BEGIN

select 
	svc.service_id,
	concat('https://s2.botvfx.com/shot?show_id=',s.show_id,'&service_id=',svc.service_id) as link,
	s.account_nickname,
    s.show_name,
    s.exec_producer_nickname,
    s.producer_nickname,
    o.obj_name,
	ifnull(asvc.der_service_type_label,"") as service,
    svc.service_label,
    ifnull(svc.status_label,'') as `status`,
    pd_bid,
    pd_approved,
    asvc.der_pd_assigned as pd_assigned,
    asvc.der_pd_actual as pd_actual,
    asvc.der_date_ffd as date_ffd,
    asvc.der_pre_ffd as pd_pre_ffd,
    asvc.der_post_ffd as pd_post_ffd,
	o.object_id

		
  from s2_prodn.service as svc
  join s2_prodn.auto_service as asvc on (svc.service_id = asvc.service_id)
  join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
  join s2_prodn.`auto_show` as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
  where s.stage = "Active" and account_id <>1 and service_type_id=in_service_type_id;
END
leaf_report_notes_by_show 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_report_notes_by_show`(in in_show int)
BEGIN
select 
		case assoc_element
			when "Object" then o.obj_type
            when "Show" then "Show"
			else "Other" 
		end as note_type,
        ifnull(o.obj_name,"") as shot_name,
		n.lastupdated as edited_on, 
        ifnull(n.source,"") as note_source,
        p.person_id as author_person_id,
		der_nickname as author, 
        replace(content,'\n',"") as note
from note as n
left join person as p on (p.person_id = n.author_person_id)
left join object as o on (o.object_id = n.object_id)
where n.show_id=in_show
order by note_type,shot_name,edited_on;
END
leaf_service_currently_due 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_service_currently_due`(in in_type enum('BOT Due','Client Due'), in in_start_date date, in in_end_date date)
BEGIN
case in_type
	when 'BOT Due' then
			SELECT 
				`svc`.`date_bot_due` AS `date_bot_due`,
				(CASE (TO_DAYS(`svc`.`date_bot_due`) - TO_DAYS(CURDATE()))
					WHEN -(2) THEN '2 Days Ago'
					WHEN -(1) THEN 'Yesterday'
					WHEN 0 THEN 'Today'
					WHEN 1 THEN 'Tomorrow'
					WHEN 2 THEN '2 Days from Now'
					ELSE `svc`.`date_bot_due`
				END) AS `bot_due_friendly`,
				`svc`.`date_client_due` AS `date_client_due`,
				(CASE (TO_DAYS(`svc`.`date_client_due`) - TO_DAYS(CURDATE()))
					WHEN -(2) THEN '2 Days Ago'
					WHEN -(1) THEN 'Yesterday'
					WHEN 0 THEN 'Today'
					WHEN 1 THEN 'Tomorrow'
					WHEN 2 THEN '2 Days from Now'
					ELSE `svc`.`date_client_due`
				END) AS `client_due_friendly`,
				`ash`.`account_nickname` AS `account_nickname`,
				`ash`.`show_name` AS `show_name`,
				`e`.`episode_name` AS `episode_name`,
				`og`.`group_name` AS `group_name`,
				`o`.`obj_name` AS `obj_name`,
				`asvc`.`der_service_type_label` AS `der_service_type_label`,
				`svc`.`service_label` AS `service_label`,
				`svc`.`client_priority` AS `client_priority`,
				`svc`.`status_label` AS `status_label`,
				`svc`.`pd_bid` AS `pd_bid`,
				`svc`.`pd_approved` AS `pd_approved`,
				`asvc`.`der_pd_actual` AS `der_pd_actual`,
				`asvc`.`der_pre_ffd` AS `der_pre_ffd`,
				`asvc`.`der_post_ffd` AS `der_post_ffd`,
				`asvc`.`der_date_ffd` AS `der_date_ffd`,
                `asvc`.`der_service_bot_staff` AS `der_service_bot_staff`,
				`asvc`.`der_last_deliv_date` AS `der_last_deliv_date`,
				`asvc`.`der_last_deliv_label` AS `der_last_deliv_label`,
				`asvc`.`der_last_delivery_id` AS `der_last_delivery_id`,
				`svc`.`working_frame_start` AS `working_frame_start`,
				`svc`.`working_frame_end` AS `working_frame_end`,
				`svc`.`working_frame_count` AS `working_frame_count`,
				`botstaff`.`exec_producer` AS `exec_producer`,
				`botstaff`.`producer` AS `producer`,
				`botstaff`.`assoc_producer` AS `assoc_producer`,
				`botstaff`.`supervisor` AS `supervisor`,
				`botstaff`.`coordinator` AS `coordinator`,
				`alist`.`artistlist` AS `artistlist`
			FROM
				(((((((`service` `svc`
				LEFT JOIN `auto_service` `asvc` ON ((`asvc`.`service_id` = `svc`.`service_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `root_service_artistlist` `alist` ON ((`alist`.`service_id` = `svc`.`service_id`)))
				JOIN `object` `o` ON ((`o`.`object_id` = `svc`.`object_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `episode` `e` ON ((`o`.`episode_id` = `e`.`episode_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `obj_group` `og` ON ((`og`.`group_id` = `o`.`group_id`)))
				JOIN `auto_show` `ash` ON ((`ash`.`show_id` = `o`.`show_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `root_botstaff_by_show` `botstaff` ON ((`botstaff`.`show_id` = `o`.`show_id`)))
			WHERE
				((`svc`.`date_bot_due` between in_start_date and in_end_date)
					AND (`svc`.`status_label` IN ('WIP' , 'reWIP', 'Pend', 'AI')))
			ORDER BY `svc`.`date_bot_due`;
	when 'Client Due' then
    			SELECT 
				`svc`.`date_bot_due` AS `date_bot_due`,
				(CASE (TO_DAYS(`svc`.`date_bot_due`) - TO_DAYS(CURDATE()))
					WHEN -(2) THEN '2 Days Ago'
					WHEN -(1) THEN 'Yesterday'
					WHEN 0 THEN 'Today'
					WHEN 1 THEN 'Tomorrow'
					WHEN 2 THEN '2 Days from Now'
					ELSE `svc`.`date_bot_due`
				END) AS `bot_due_friendly`,
				`svc`.`date_client_due` AS `date_client_due`,
				(CASE (TO_DAYS(`svc`.`date_client_due`) - TO_DAYS(CURDATE()))
					WHEN -(2) THEN '2 Days Ago'
					WHEN -(1) THEN 'Yesterday'
					WHEN 0 THEN 'Today'
					WHEN 1 THEN 'Tomorrow'
					WHEN 2 THEN '2 Days from Now'
					ELSE `svc`.`date_client_due`
				END) AS `client_due_friendly`,
				`ash`.`account_nickname` AS `account_nickname`,
				`ash`.`show_name` AS `show_name`,
				`e`.`episode_name` AS `episode_name`,
				`og`.`group_name` AS `group_name`,
				`o`.`obj_name` AS `obj_name`,
				`asvc`.`der_service_type_label` AS `der_service_type_label`,
				`svc`.`service_label` AS `service_label`,
				`svc`.`client_priority` AS `client_priority`,
				`svc`.`status_label` AS `status_label`,
				`svc`.`pd_bid` AS `pd_bid`,
				`svc`.`pd_approved` AS `pd_approved`,
				`asvc`.`der_pd_actual` AS `der_pd_actual`,
				`asvc`.`der_pre_ffd` AS `der_pre_ffd`,
				`asvc`.`der_post_ffd` AS `der_post_ffd`,
				`asvc`.`der_date_ffd` AS `der_date_ffd`,
                `asvc`.`der_service_bot_staff` AS `der_service_bot_staff`,
				`asvc`.`der_last_deliv_date` AS `der_last_deliv_date`,
				`asvc`.`der_last_deliv_label` AS `der_last_deliv_label`,
				`asvc`.`der_last_delivery_id` AS `der_last_delivery_id`,
				`svc`.`working_frame_start` AS `working_frame_start`,
				`svc`.`working_frame_end` AS `working_frame_end`,
				`svc`.`working_frame_count` AS `working_frame_count`,
				`botstaff`.`exec_producer` AS `exec_producer`,
				`botstaff`.`producer` AS `producer`,
				`botstaff`.`assoc_producer` AS `assoc_producer`,
				`botstaff`.`supervisor` AS `supervisor`,
				`botstaff`.`coordinator` AS `coordinator`,
				`alist`.`artistlist` AS `artistlist`
			FROM
				(((((((`service` `svc`
				LEFT JOIN `auto_service` `asvc` ON ((`asvc`.`service_id` = `svc`.`service_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `root_service_artistlist` `alist` ON ((`alist`.`service_id` = `svc`.`service_id`)))
				JOIN `object` `o` ON ((`o`.`object_id` = `svc`.`object_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `episode` `e` ON ((`o`.`episode_id` = `e`.`episode_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `obj_group` `og` ON ((`og`.`group_id` = `o`.`group_id`)))
				JOIN `auto_show` `ash` ON ((`ash`.`show_id` = `o`.`show_id`)))
				LEFT JOIN `root_botstaff_by_show` `botstaff` ON ((`botstaff`.`show_id` = `o`.`show_id`)))
			WHERE
				((`svc`.`date_client_due` between in_start_date and in_end_date)
					AND (`svc`.`status_label` IN ('WIP' , 'reWIP', 'Pend', 'AI')))
			ORDER BY `svc`.`date_client_due`;
    end case;
END
leaf_shot_event_timeline 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_shot_event_timeline`(in in_object_id int)
BEGIN
	
    declare in_show_id int;
    select show_id into in_show_id from object where object_id=in_object_id;
    
	(select n.initialentry as 'when',
		"Note - Show" as event,
        null as event_type,
        null as label,
        null as service_type,
		n.author_person_id as who,
        content as content,
        note_id as link_id
	from note as n
	where assoc_element="Show" and n.show_id = in_show_id)
    
    union
    
	(select n.initialentry as 'when',
		"Note - Shot/Asset" as event,
        null as event_type,
        null as label,
        null as service_type,
		n.author_person_id as who,
        content as content,
        note_id as link_id
	from note as n
	where assoc_element <> "Show" and n.object_id = in_object_id)
    
    union
    
	(select 
		abi.auth_date as 'when',
        "Service Authorized" as event,
        null as event_type,
        concat(asvc.der_service_type_label," - ",ifnull(svc.service_label,"")) as label,
        svc.service_type_id as service_type,
        null as who,
        null as content,
        svc.service_id as link_id
	from object as o
		join service as svc on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
        join auto_service as asvc on (asvc.service_id = svc.service_id)
		join auto_billing_item as abi on (abi.bin = svc.bin)
	where o.object_id = in_object_id)
    
    
    union
    
    (
    SELECT 
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() as 'when',
     "Service Status" as event,
     sh.status_label as event_type,
     null as label,
     svc.service_type_id as service_type,
     sh.person_id as who,
     null as content,
     sh.service_id as link_id
     
FROM
    s2_prodn.service_history sh
         JOIN
    s2_prodn.service svc ON svc.service_id = sh.service_id
    where svc.object_id = in_object_id)
    
    
    union
  /* Added by Vignesh 
    (SELECT 
    sh.`timestamp` AS 'when',
    'Service Status' AS event,
    svc.status_label AS event_type,
    svc.status_label AS label,
    svc.service_type_id as service_type,
    sh.person_id AS who,
    NULL AS content,
    sh.service_id AS link_id
FROM
    service_history AS sh
        JOIN
    service AS svc ON (sh.service_id = svc.service_id)
WHERE
    svc.object_id = in_object_id)
 ******************    
    union */

/* Request for service type in Dailies */
    (select e.created_on as 'when',
		"Dailies" as event,
        s.state_label as event_type,
        null as label,
        svc.service_type_id as service_type,
        who as who,
        e.notes as content,
        r.req_id as link_id
	from dailies_ticket_request as r
    join service as svc on (r.service_id = svc.service_id)
	join dailies_ticket_event as e on (r.req_id = e.req_id)
    join dailies_ticket_request_state as s on (e.state_id = s.state_id)
	where r.object_id=in_object_id)
     /*
    (select e.created_on as 'when',
		"Dailies" as event,
        s.state_label as event_type,
        null as label,
        null as service_type,
        who as who,
        e.notes as content,
        r.req_id as link_id
	from dailies_ticket_request as r
	join dailies_ticket_event as e on (r.req_id = e.req_id)
    join dailies_ticket_request_state as s on (e.state_id = s.state_id)
	where r.object_id=in_object_id)
   ************************* */
    union
    
	(select 
		deliv_date as 'when',
        "Delivery" as event,
        deliv_type as event_type,
        deliv_label as label,
        svc.service_type_id as service_type,
        null as who,
        deliv_notes as content,
        delivery_id as link_id
	from delivery as d
    join service as svc on (d.service_id = svc.service_id)
	where svc.object_id = in_object_id )
    
order by `when`;



END
leaf_show_event_timeline 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_show_event_timeline`(in in_show_id int)
BEGIN
	/* Created by Hitesh on 20JUN22 
		For painting a Show timeline of key events and notes
        It includes following events:
			- Bid Start, Work Start, Show Inactive and Show Close
            - Ingest events
            - Bid events (Init Date based)
            - Bid Proposal events (prop_date)
            - Delivery events (first and latest delivery date)
            - show notes
    */
	(select date_bid_start as 'when',
			"Bid Start" as event,
			null as event_type,
            null as label,
            null as who,
            null as content,
            null as link_id
		from `show` where show_id=in_show_id and date_bid_start)
        
	union
    
	(select date_work_start as 'when',
			"Work Start" as event,
            null as event_type,
			null as label,
            null as who,
            null as content,
            null as link_id
		from `show` where show_id=in_show_id and date_work_start)
        
	union
    	
	(select date_inactive as 'when',
			"Show Inactive" as event,
			null as event_type,
			null as label,
            null as who,
            null as content,
            null as link_id
		from `show` where show_id=in_show_id and date_inactive)
        
	union

	(select date_close as 'when',
			"Show Closed" as event,
			null as event_type,
			null as label,
            null as who,
            null as content,
            null as link_id
		from `show` where show_id=in_show_id and date_close)
        
	union
    
	(select created_on as `when`,
		"Ingest" as event,
		job_type as event_type,
		job_label as label,
        p.der_nickname as who,
        concat(itemcount_total," items in ingest") as content,
        job_id as link_id
	from ingest_job as ij
		left join person as p on (ij.creator = p.person_id)
	where show_id=in_show_id)
    
    union
    
    (select init_date as 'when',
		"Bid Requested" as event,
        null as event_type,
        bid_name as label,
        p.der_nickname as who,
        if(e.episode_name,concat(" Episode: ",e.episode_name),null) as content,
        bid_id as link_id
	from (bid as b
		left join person as p on (b.initialentry_by = p.person_id))
        left join episode as e on (b.episode_id = e.episode_id)
    where b.show_id = in_show_id)
    
    union
    
    (select bp.prop_date as 'when',
		"Proposal Sent" as event,
        null as event_type,
        prop_name as label,
		p.der_nickname as who,
        null as content,
        bid_prop_id as link_id
	from bid_prop as bp 
		left join person as p on (bp.initialentry_by = p.person_id)
	where bp.show_id = in_show_id and prop_stage in ("Submitted", "Evaluated"))
    
    union

    (select n.initialentry as 'when',
		"Show Note" as event,
        null as event_type,
        null as label,
		p.der_nickname as who,
        content as content,
        note_id as link_id
	from note as n
	left join person as p on (n.author_person_id = p.person_id)
	where assoc_element="Show" and n.show_id = in_show_id)

	union
    
    (select 
		min(deliv_date) as 'when',
        "Delivery" as event,
        "First" as event_type,
        null as label,
        null as who,
        null as content,
        delivery_id as link_id
	from delivery as d
    join service as svc on (d.service_id = svc.service_id)
    join object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
	where o.show_id = in_show_id)
    
    union
    
	(select 
		max(deliv_date) as 'when',
        "Delivery" as event,
        "Last" as event_type,
        null as label,
        null as who,
        null as content,
        delivery_id as link_id
	from delivery as d
    join service as svc on (d.service_id = svc.service_id)
    join object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
	where o.show_id = in_show_id)

    
order by `when`;

END
leaf_unlink_bin_service_id 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `leaf_unlink_bin_service_id`( in in_bin int, in in_service_id int,in target_entry_by int )
BEGIN

 DECLARE VAR INT;
 DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION SET VAR = 1;
 SET VAR = 0;
 	
     IF EXISTS (select bin from billing_item where bin = in_bin) THEN
     
        update service SET bin = NULL,lastupdated_by=target_entry_by where bin = in_bin and service_id = in_service_id;  
        select in_service_id as service_id, in_bin as bin;
 	ELSE
 		SET var = 1;
 	END IF;
 
 select VAR;
 
 END
manual_generate_auto_show_episode_summary 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `manual_generate_auto_show_episode_summary`()
BEGIN

   

delete from auto_show_episode_summary;
    
insert into auto_show_episode_summary
	(show_id,episode_id,stage,account_name,show_name,episode_name,date_work_start,date_close,show_type)
	select * from (select s.show_id,
			ifnull(o.episode_id,0),
            s.stage as stg,
            a.`name` as aname,
            s.show_name as sname,
            e.episode_name as ename,
            s.date_work_start as datestart,
            s.date_close as dateclose,
            s.show_type as stype
    from `show` as s 
		left join `account` as a on (a.account_id = s.account_id)
		left join object as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
		left join episode as e on (e.show_id = o.show_id)
	group by s.show_id,ifnull(o.episode_id,0)) as placeholder
	on duplicate key update
		stage = stg,
        account_name = aname,
        show_name = sname,
        episode_name = ename,
        date_work_start = datestart,
        date_close = dateclose,
        show_type = stype;
        
insert into auto_show_episode_summary
	(show_id,episode_id,yrweek_earliest_client_due,yrweek_latest_client_due,service_total_count,
    service_type_count_comp,service_type_count_roto,service_type_count_paint,service_type_count_mm,service_type_count_rm,service_type_count_asset,
    service_type_count_extract,service_type_count_mogrph,service_type_count_other)
    select * from (select 	o.show_id,
			ifnull(e.episode_id,0),
			min(calc_yrweek_client_due) as earliestcd,
			max(calc_yrweek_client_due) as latestcd,
			count(distinct service_id) as scnt,
			sum(if(service_type_id=1,1,0)) as scnt_comp,
			sum(if(service_type_id=2,1,0)) as scnt_roto,
			sum(if(service_type_id=3,1,0)) as scnt_paint,
			sum(if(service_type_id=4,1,0)) as scnt_mm,
			sum(if(service_type_id=5,1,0)) as scnt_rm,
			sum(if(service_type_id=6,1,0)) as scnt_asset,
			sum(if(service_type_id=7,1,0)) as scnt_extract,
			sum(if(service_type_id=8,1,0)) as scnt_mogrph,
			sum(if(service_type_id=9,1,0)) as scnt_other
		from object as o
        left join episode as e on (e.episode_id = o.episode_id)
		left join service as s on (s.object_id = o.object_id)
		group by o.show_id,ifnull(o.episode_id,0)) as placeholder
	on duplicate key update
		yrweek_earliest_client_due = earliestcd,
        yrweek_latest_client_due = latestcd,
        service_total_count = scnt,
		service_type_count_comp = scnt_comp,
        service_type_count_roto = scnt_roto,
        service_type_count_paint = scnt_paint,
        service_type_count_mm = scnt_mm,
        service_type_count_rm = scnt_rm,
        service_type_count_asset = scnt_asset,
		service_type_count_extract = scnt_extract,
        service_type_count_mogrph = scnt_mogrph,
        service_type_count_other = scnt_other;


with 
	updset as 
		(select 	o.show_id,
				ifnull(o.episode_id,0) as episode_id,
				count(distinct if(o.obj_type="Shot", o.object_id,null)) as shot_count,
				count(distinct if(o.obj_type="Asset", o.object_id,null)) as asset_count,
				ifnull(count(distinct svc.service_id),0) as service_total_count,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "Pending",1,0)),0) as service_backlog_count,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "IP",1,0)),0) as service_ip_count,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type in ("Delivered","Approved"),1,0)),0) as service_done_count,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "Paused",1,0)),0) as service_pause_count,
				
				ifnull(sum(svc.pd_approved),0) as pd_appr_total,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "Pending",svc.pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_backlog,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "IP",svc.pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_ip,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type in ("Delivered","Approved"),svc.pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_done,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "Paused",svc.pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_pause,
				
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 2,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_roto,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 3,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_paint,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 4,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_mm,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 5,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_rm,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 1,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_comp,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 6,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_asset,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 7,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_extract,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 8,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_mogrph,
				ifnull(sum(if(svc.service_type_id = 9,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_other
				from object as o
					left join service as svc on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
					group by o.show_id,ifnull(o.episode_id,0))
update auto_show_episode_summary as a, updset as u
	set a.shot_count = u.shot_count,
		a.asset_count = u.asset_count,
		a.service_total_count = u.service_total_count,
		a.service_backlog_count = u.service_backlog_count,
        a.service_ip_count = u.service_ip_count,
        a.service_done_count = u.service_done_count,
        a.service_pause_count = u.service_pause_count,
		a.pd_appr_total = u.pd_appr_total,
        a.pd_appr_backlog = u.pd_appr_backlog,
        a.pd_appr_ip = u.pd_appr_ip,
		a.pd_appr_done = u.pd_appr_done,
		a.pd_appr_pause = u.pd_appr_pause,

		a.service_type_count_roto = u.service_type_count_roto,
		a.service_type_count_paint = u.service_type_count_paint,
		a.service_type_count_mm = u.service_type_count_mm,
		a.service_type_count_rm = u.service_type_count_rm,
		a.service_type_count_comp = u.service_type_count_comp,
		a.service_type_count_asset = u.service_type_count_asset,
		a.service_type_count_extract = u.service_type_count_extract,
		a.service_type_count_mogrph = u.service_type_count_mogrph,
		a.service_type_count_other = u.service_type_count_other
    where u.show_id = a.show_id and u.episode_id = a.episode_id;


with
	updset as (select 	o.show_id,
			ifnull(o.episode_id,0) as episode_id,
			ifnull(sum(t.der_pd_actual),0) as pd_actual_total,
					ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "Pending",t.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_backlog,
					ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "IP",t.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_ip,
					ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type in ("Delivered","Approved"),t.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_done,
					ifnull(sum(if(svc.der_status_type = "Paused",t.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_pause
			from object as o
				left join service as svc on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
				left join task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
				group by o.show_id,ifnull(o.episode_id,0))
update auto_show_episode_summary as a, updset as u, episode as e
	set a.episode_name = e.episode_name,
	
	
		a.pd_actual_total = u.pd_actual_total,
		a.pd_actual_backlog = u.pd_actual_backlog,
        a.pd_actual_ip = u.pd_actual_ip,
		a.pd_actual_done = u.pd_actual_done,
        a.pd_actual_pause = u.pd_actual_pause
	where u.show_id = a.show_id and u.episode_id = a.episode_id and a.episode_id = e.episode_id;
END
manualcalc_auto_billing_item 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `manualcalc_auto_billing_item`()
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE b INT;
  DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT bin FROM billing_item;

  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;
  OPEN cur1;

  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur1 INTO b;

    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
    
    call triggercall_auto_billing_item(b);
  END LOOP;

  CLOSE cur1;
END

BEGIN

    IF done THEN

    END IF;
    
    call triggercall_auto_invoice_item(i);
  END LOOP;

  CLOSE cur1;
END

recalc_all_auto_tables_all_shows_by_stage 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `recalc_all_auto_tables_all_shows_by_stage`(in in_stage enum('Active','Inactive','Closed'), in in_after_year int)
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE target_show_id, list_count int default null;
  declare t_list text default ">";
  
  DECLARE cur_show CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT show_id 
        from s2_prodn.`show` 
		where stage = in_stage 
        /*  Added 3/13/22 by Hitesh */
        and year(date_bid_start)>in_after_year ;
        
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur_show;
  set list_count = 0;
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur_show INTO target_show_id;
    set t_list = concat(t_list,", ",target_show_id);
    set list_count = list_count + 1;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
	call recalc_all_auto_tables_by_show(target_show_id);
  END LOOP;
  select  list_count, t_list;
  CLOSE cur_show;

END
recalc_all_auto_tables_by_show 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `recalc_all_auto_tables_by_show`(in in_show_id int)
BEGIN

  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE o_id, svc_id, t_id int default null;
  
  DECLARE cur_task CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT task_id 
        from s2_prodn.`show` as s
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
        join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
        join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;
        
  DECLARE cur_service CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT svc.service_id
        from s2_prodn.service as svc 
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
        join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;

 DECLARE cur_obj CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT o.object_id
        from s2_prodn.`show` as s
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;
        
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur_task;
  read_loop1: LOOP
    FETCH cur_task INTO t_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop1;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_task(t_id,'Task');
    call triggercall_auto_task(t_id,'Actual');
    call triggercall_auto_task(t_id,'Assigned');
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_task;

set done = false;
  OPEN cur_service;
  read_loop2: LOOP
    FETCH cur_service INTO svc_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop2;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_service(svc_id,'Full');
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_service;

set done = false;
  OPEN cur_obj;
  read_loop3: LOOP
    FETCH cur_obj INTO o_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop3;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_object(o_id,'Full');
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_obj;
  
 call triggercall_auto_show(in_show_id,'Full');
END
recalc_all_auto_tables_by_show2 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `recalc_all_auto_tables_by_show2`(in in_show_id int)
BEGIN

  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE o_id, svc_id, t_id int default null;
  DECLARE cur_task CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT task_id 
        from s2_prodn.`show` as s
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
        join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
        join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;
        
  DECLARE cur_service CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT svc.service_id
        from s2_prodn.`show` as s
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
        join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.object_id = o.object_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;

 DECLARE cur_obj CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT o.object_id
        from s2_prodn.`show` as s
        join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id;
        
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur_task;
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur_task INTO t_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_task(t_id);
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_task;

  OPEN cur_service;
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur_service INTO svc_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_service(svc_id);
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_service;

  OPEN cur_obj;
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur_obj INTO o_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
	call triggercall_auto_object(o_id);
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE cur_obj;
  
 call triggercall_auto_show(in_show_id);
END

END

recalc_auto_week_task 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `recalc_auto_week_task`(in in_task_id int)
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE v_yearweek, v_dayofweek int;
  DECLARE v_pd decimal(3,2);
 
  DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT yearweek(day_id,3),dayofweek(day_id),pd FROM assignment where task_id = in_task_id;
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;
  
 delete from auto_week_task
		where task_id = in_task_id;
        
  OPEN cur1;

  my_loop: LOOP
	FETCH cur1 INTO v_yearweek,v_dayofweek,v_pd;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE my_loop;
    END IF;
	case v_dayofweek
		when 2 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_1 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_1 = values(pd_1);
		when 3 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_2 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_2 = values(pd_2);
		when 4 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_3 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_3 = values(pd_3);
		when 5 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_4 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_4 = values(pd_4);
		when 6 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_5 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_5 = values(pd_5);
		when 7 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_6 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_6 = values(pd_6);
		when 1 then
			insert into auto_week_task
				 set yrweek = v_yearweek,
					 task_id = in_task_id,
					 pd_7 = v_pd
			on duplicate key update 
				yrweek = values(yrweek),
				task_id = values(task_id),
				pd_7 = values(pd_7);
	end case;
END LOOP;
CLOSE cur1;
    
END
recalc_close_all_paidup_invoices 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `recalc_close_all_paidup_invoices`()
BEGIN
/*  Created by Hitesh 3/2/22 
	This SP sets the invoice status to 'Closed' if all of the lineitems in the invoice show they are paid up */
    
with ol as 
	(select invoice_id, (sum(inv_amount)-ifnull(sum(paid_to_date),0)) as outstanding 
	from s2_prodn.auto_invoice_item
    where inv_status='Released'
    group by invoice_id)
update s2_prodn.invoice as i, ol 
	set i.`status` = 'Closed'
	where i.invoice_id = ol.invoice_id and ol.outstanding=0;
END

  END LOOP;

  CLOSE cur1;
END
s2_data_migration 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `s2_data_migration`()
BEGIN





with tl as (select t.task_id as task_id
            from s2_prodn.task as t
            join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.actual 
FROM s2_prodn.actual  LEFT JOIN tl ON tl.task_id = actual.task_id
WHERE tl.task_id IS not NULL;
    
with tl as (select t.task_id as task_id
            from s2_prodn.task as t
            join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.assignment 
FROM s2_prodn.assignment LEFT JOIN tl ON tl.task_id = assignment.task_id
WHERE tl.task_id IS not NULL;

with tl as (select t.task_id as task_id
            from s2_prodn.task as t
            join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.note 
FROM s2_prodn.note LEFT JOIN tl ON tl.task_id = note.task_id
WHERE tl.task_id IS not NULL;

with tl as (select t.task_id as task_id
            from s2_prodn.task as t
            join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.published 
FROM s2_prodn.published LEFT JOIN tl ON tl.task_id = published.task_id
WHERE tl.task_id IS not NULL;

with tl as (select t.task_id as task_id
            from s2_prodn.task as t
            join s2_prodn.service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.task 
FROM s2_prodn.task LEFT JOIN tl ON tl.task_id = task.task_id
WHERE tl.task_id IS not NULL;


with sl as (select svc.service_id as service_id
            from s2_prodn.service as svc 
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.delivery 
FROM s2_prodn.delivery LEFT JOIN sl ON sl.service_id = delivery.service_id
WHERE sl.service_id IS not NULL;

with sl as (select svc.service_id as service_id
            from s2_prodn.service as svc 
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.published 
FROM s2_prodn.published LEFT JOIN sl ON sl.service_id = published.service_id
WHERE sl.service_id IS not NULL;

with sl as (select svc.service_id as service_id
            from s2_prodn.service as svc 
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.service 
FROM s2_prodn.service LEFT JOIN sl ON sl.service_id = service.service_id
WHERE sl.service_id IS not NULL;


with ol as (select o.object_id as object_id
            from s2_prodn.object as o 
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.published 
FROM s2_prodn.published LEFT JOIN ol ON ol.object_id = published.object_id
WHERE ol.object_id IS not NULL;

with ol as (select o.object_id as object_id
            from s2_prodn.object as o 
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			where year(s.date_bid_start)>=2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12)
DELETE s2_prodn.object 
FROM s2_prodn.object LEFT JOIN ol ON ol.object_id = object.object_id
WHERE ol.object_id IS not NULL;



		insert into s2_prodn.role_type
			(role_type_id, role_type, role_type_status, dept_id, role_desc,
            billable, `lead`, supervisor, artist, trainee, 
            default_skill_id, default_proficiency, initialentry_by, lastupdated_by)
			select * from (select 	role_type_id,
									role_type,
									role_type_status,
                                    (case dept 
                                        when 'Mgmt' 	then 13
                                        when 'Training' then 6
                                        when 'IT' 		then 9
                                        when 'IT-Training'  	then 9
                                        when 'SoftwareDev' 	then 10
                                        when 'SoftwareDev-Training' 	then 10
                                        when 'Talent Management' 	then 11
                                        when 'Talent Management-Training' 	then 11
                                        when 'PSB' 	then 8
                                        when 'PSB-Training' 	then 8
                                        when 'PrdnMgmt' 	then 7
                                        when 'PrdnMgmt-Training' 	then 7
                                        when 'Roto' 	then 1
                                        when 'Roto-Training' 	then 1
                                        when 'Paint' 	then 2
                                        when 'Paint-Training' 	then 2
                                        when '3D' 	then null
                                        when '3D-Training' 	then null
                                        when 'Comp' 	then 4
                                        when 'Comp-Training' 	then 4
                                        when 'Production' 	then 7
                                        when 'Administration' 	then 11
									end) as dept_id,
                                    role_desc,
									billable, 
                                    `lead`, 
                                    supervisor, 
                                    artist, 
                                    trainee, 
                                    if(isnull(skill),null,(case skill
										when 'Roto'		then 1
                                        when 'Paint'	then 2
                                        when 'Roto-Prep'	then 1
                                        when 'Paint-Prep'	then 2
                                        when 'Comp'		then 5
                                        when 'MM/RM'	then 3
                                        when 'RM'		then 4
                                        when 'Lighting'	then 6
                                        when 'Anim'		then 10
                                        when 'Rigging'	then 50
                                        when 'Texturing' then 9
                                        when 'Modelling' then 8
                                        when 'FX'		then 7
                                        when 'CG General' then 58
                                        when 'Matte Painter' then 54
                                        else 12
									end)) as default_skill_id, 
                                    (case skill_level
                                        when 'Advanced' then 'High'
                                        when 'Mid'		then 'Medium'
                                        when 'Beginner' then 'Basic'
                                        when 'Trainee'	then 'Beginner'
									end) as default_proficiency, 
                                    816 as initialentry_by,
                                    816 as lastupdated_by
									from shotbot_production.role_type) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			role_type_id = orig.role_type_id, 
            role_type = orig.role_type,
            role_type_status = orig.role_type_status,
            dept_id = orig.dept_id, 
            role_desc = orig.role_desc,
            billable = orig.billable, 
            `lead`  = orig.`lead`, 
            supervisor = orig.supervisor, 
            artist = orig.artist,

						from shotbot_production.shottask as st
							join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (s.show_id = st.show_id)
						where not isnull(st.show_id) and not isnull(st.group_id) and s.date_bid_start between "2021-10-01" and "2022-12-31"
						group by st.show_id, st.group_id) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			show_id = orig.show_id,
			group_name = orig.group_name,
			initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by,
			lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by;

            

  
		insert into s2_prodn.object
			(show_id, group_id, obj_type, obj_name, `description`,
			shot_frame_start, shot_frame_end, initialentry_by,
			lastupdated_by)
		select * from 
			(select
				
				st.show_id as show_id,
				og.group_id as group_id,
				"Shot" as obj_type,
				(case substring_index(st.shottask_id,"_",-1)
					when "roto" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_roto",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "paint" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_paint",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "rtmn" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_rtmn",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "mm" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_mm",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "comp" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_comp",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "model" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_model",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "mod" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_mod",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "modeling" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_modeling",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "modelling" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_modelling",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "texture" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_texture",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "lighting" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_lighting",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "CG" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_cg",st.shottask_id)-1)
					when "asset" then left(st.shottask_id,locate("_asset",st.shottask_id)-1)
					else st.shottask_id
				end) as obj_name,
				shot_desc as `description`,
				shot_start_frame as shot_frame_start,
				shot_end_frame as shot_frame_end,
				816 as initialentry_by,
				816 as lastupdated_by
		from shotbot_production.shottask as st
			left join s2_prodn.obj_group as og on (st.show_id = og.show_id and st.group_id = og.group_name)
			left join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (st.show_id = s.show_id)
		where year(s.date_bid_start)>2020 
			and substring_index(st.shottask_id,"_",-1) not in ("ADD1","ADD2","ADD3","v2")) orig
		on duplicate key update
			show_id = orig.show_id, 
			group_id = orig.group_id, 
			obj_type = orig.obj_type, 
			obj_name = orig.obj_name, 
			`description` = orig.`description`,
			shot_frame_start = orig.shot_frame_start, 
			shot_frame_end = orig.shot_frame_end, 
			initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by,
			lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by;
            
            
  
		insert into s2_prodn.service
			(service_type_id, object_id, status_label, client_priority, client_service_desc, 
			bid_work_approach_notes, work_to_date_pct, work_to_date_notes, date_client_due, date_bot_due, 
			date_final_due, service_complexity, pd_bid, pd_approved, showcase_value, working_frame_start, working_frame_end,
			initialentry_by, lastupdated_by, tmp_linkback_stid)
		select * from 
				(select (case st.task_type_id
						when 'roto' then 2
						when 'paint'	then 3
						when 'matchmove' then 4
						when 'comp'		then 1
						when 'gs_extraction' then 7
						when 'custom1' 	then 9
						when 'custom2'	then 9
						when 'dustbust'	then 9
						when 'rotomation' then 5
						when 'asset_dev' then 6
						else 9	
					end )as service_type_id,
					o.object_id,
					(case prodn_status
						when 'AI' then 'AI'
						when 'NS' then 'Pend'
						when 'S'  then 'Pend'
						when 'WIP' then 'WIP'
						when 'RWIP' then 'reWIP'
						when 'U' then 'Deliv'
						when 'A' then 'Appr'
						when 'H' then 'Hold'
						when 'O' then 'Omit'
						when 'F' then 'reWIP'
					end ) as status_label,
					(case st.client_priority
						when 'None' then 'Normal'
						else st.client_priority
					end) as client_priority,
					client_task_desc as client_service_desc,
					bot_task_desc as bid_work_approach_notes,
					(wtd_pct/100) as work_to_date_pct,
					left(wtd_notes,128) as work_to_date_notes,
					client_due_date as date_client_due,
					bot_due_date as date_bot_due,
					final_due as date_final_due,
					complexity as service_complexity,
					bid_pd as pd_bid,
					approved_pd as pd_approved,
					st.showcase_value as showcase_value,
                    if(working_start_frame<0,0,working_start_frame) as working_frame_start,
                    if(working_end_frame<0,0,working_end_frame) as working_frame_end,
					816 as initialentry_by,
					816 as lastupdated_by,
					st.st_id as tmp_linkback_stid
			from shotbot_production.shottask as st
				join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.show_id = st.show_id and instr(st.shottask_id, o.obj_name)>0)
				join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
			where year(date_bid_start)=2022 and month(date_bid_start) between 1 and 12 ) orig
		on duplicate key update
			service_type_id = orig.service_type_id, 
			object_id = orig.object_id, 
			status_label = orig.status_label,
			client_priority = orig.client_priority, 
			client_service_desc = orig.client_service_desc, 
			bid_work_approach_notes = orig.bid_work_approach_notes,
			work_to_date_pct = orig.work_to_date_pct, 
			work_to_date_notes = orig.work_to_date_notes, 
			date_client_due = orig.date_client_due, 
			date_bot_due = orig.date_bot_due, 
			date_final_due = orig.date_final_due, 
			service_complexity = orig.service_complexity, 
			pd_bid = orig.pd_bid, 
			pd_approved = orig.pd_approved, 
			showcase_value = orig.showcase_value, 
            working_frame_start = orig.working_frame_start,
            working_frame_end = orig.working_frame_end,
			initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by, 
			lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by,
			tmp_linkback_stid = orig.tmp_linkback_stid;
 
   
 with orig as (select svc.service_id as service_id, bi.bin as bin 
			from s2_prodn.service as svc
            join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = svc.object_id)
            join s2_prodn.show as s on (s.show_id = o.show_id)
			join shotbot_production.billing_item as bi on (bi.st_id = svc.tmp_linkback_stid)
            join s2_prodn.billing_item as s2bi on (s2bi.bin = bi.bin)
            where year(s.date_bid_start)>2020  and month(s.date_bid_start) between 1 and 12 
				and svc.tmp_linkback_stid is not null and bi.st_id is not null )
update s2_prodn.service as svc, orig
		set svc.bin = orig.bin
        where svc.service_id = orig.service_id;

 
		insert into s2_prodn.task
			(service_id, task_label, task_desc, pd_allocated, person_id,
			task_complexity, task_status, skill_id, facility_code, initialentry_by, 
			lastupdated_by)
		select * from
			(select s.service_id as service_id,
					ifnull(sub_name," ") as task_label,
					task_desc,
					alloc_bid_pds as pd_allocated,
					p.person_id as person_id,
					complexity as task_complexity,
					(case sub_status
						when 'NS' then 'Pend'
						when 'WIP' then 'WIP'
						when 'Paused' then 'Paused'
						when 'Done' then 'Done'
					end) as task_status,
					(case s.service_type_id
						when 1 then 5 
						when 2 then 1 
						when 3 then 2 
						when 4 then 3 
						when 5 then 4 
						when 6 then 8 
						when 7 then 1 
						when 8 then 11 
						when 9 then 12 
					end) as skill_id,
					'LBR' as facility_code,
					816 as initialentry_by,
					816 as lastupdated_by
				from (shotbot_production.subtask as sub
						join s2_prodn.service as s on (sub.st_id = s.tmp_linkback_stid))
						left join s2_prodn.person as p on (sub.emp_id = p.der_badge_id) 
						left join object as o on (s.object_id = o.object_id)
						left join `show` as sh on (o.show_id = sh.show_id)
				where year(sh.date_bid_start)= 2021 and month(sh.date_bid_start) between 6 and 12) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			service_id = orig.service_id, 
			task_label = orig.task_label, 
			task_desc = orig.task_desc, 
			pd_allocated = orig.pd_allocated, 
			person_id = orig.person_id,
			task_complexity = orig.task_complexity, 
			task_status = orig.task_status, 
			skill_id = orig.skill_id, 
			facility_code = orig.facility_code, 
			initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by, 
			lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by;
            


 
		insert into s2_prodn.actual
			(day_id, person_id, task_class, task_id, hours, 
			initialentry_by, lastupdated_by)
		select * from 
			(select td.date as day_id, 
				p.person_id as person_id,
				(case tt.taskclass 
					when 'Shottask' then 'Task'
					when 'Unassigned' then 'Unassigned'
					when 'System-Downtime' then 'System-Downtime'
					when 'IO-Downtime' then 'IO-Downtime'
					when 'Permission' then 'Permission'
					when 'Training' then 'Training'
					when 'Bodhi' then 'Bodhi'
				end) as task_class,
				max(t.task_id) as task_id,
				tt.hours as hours,
				816 as initialentry_by,
				816 as lastupdated_by
			from shotbot_production.timecard_task as tt
				join shotbot_production.timecard_date as td on (tt.td_id = td.td_id)
				join s2_prodn.person as p on (td.emp_id = p.der_badge_id)
				join s2_prodn.service as s on (s.tmp_linkback_stid = tt.st_id)
				join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = s.service_id and t.person_id = p.person_id)
				where extract(year_month from td.date)>202100
				group by tt.tt_id) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			day_id = orig.day_id,  
			person_id = orig.person_id, 
			task_class = orig.task_class, 
			task_id = orig.task_id,
			hours = orig.hours, 
			initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by, 
			lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by;
            

 
		insert into s2_prodn.delivery
			(delivery_id, service_id, deliv_date, deliv_type, deliv_label,
			deliv_notes, initialentry_by, lastupdated_by)
		select * from (
			select d.delivery_id,
					s.service_id,
					d.delivery_date as deliv_date,
					(case delivery_label 
						when 'v0' then 'Handshake'
						when 'v00' then 'Handshake'
						when 'v000' then 'Handshake'
						when 'test' then 'Handshake'
						when 'hsk' then 'Handshake'
						when 'WIP' then 'WIP'
						when 'WI2' then 'WIP'
						when 'WI2' then 'WIP'
						when 'WIP3' then 'WIP'
						when 'WIP4' then 'WIP'
						else 'Full'
					end) as deliv_type,
					delivery_label as deliv_label,
					delivery_note as deliv_notes,
					816 as initialentry_by, 
					816 as lastupdated_by
			from shotbot_production.delivery as d 
				join s2_prodn.service as s on (d.st_id = s.tmp_linkback_stid)) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			service_id = orig.service_id, 
			deliv_date = orig.deliv_date, 
			deliv_type = orig.deliv_type, 
			deliv_label = orig.deliv_label,
			deliv_notes = orig.deliv_notes,
			initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by, 
			lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by;
		END
s2_data_migration_vendor 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `s2_data_migration_vendor`()
BEGIN
insert into s2_prodn.os_service
	(os_service_id, os_provider_id, tmp_linkback_stid, award_status, os_deliv_status,
    pd_os, unit_price_os, net_price_os, date_os_target,initialentry_by,lastupdated_by)
select * from (select 	vt.vtask_id as os_service_id,
		vt.vendor_id as os_provider_id,
		vt.st_id as tmp_linkback_stid,
        ifnull(vt.award_status,'Pend') as award_status,
        (case vt.vendor_status 
			when 'Delivered' then 'Completed'
            when 'Finaled' then 'Completed'
            when 'WIP' then 'WIP'
            when 'Rework' then 'reWIP'
            else 'Pend'
		end) as os_deliv_status,
        vt.vendor_apd as pd_os,
        vt.unit_price as unit_price_os,
        vt.price as net_price_os,
        vt.target_due_date as date_os_target,
        816 as initialentry_by,
        816 as lastupdated_by
	from shotbot_production.vendor_task as vt
	where year(vt.initialentry)>2020 ) as orig
on duplicate key update
	os_service_id = orig.os_service_id, 
    os_provider_id = orig.os_provider_id, 
    tmp_linkback_stid = orig.tmp_linkback_stid, 
    award_status = orig.award_status, 
    os_deliv_status = orig.os_deliv_status,
    pd_os = orig.pd_os, 
    unit_price_os = orig.unit_price_os, 
    net_price_os = orig.net_price_os, 
    date_os_target = orig.date_os_target,
    initialentry_by = orig.initialentry_by,
    lastupdated_by = orig.lastupdated_by;

update s2_prodn.service as s, s2_prodn.os_service as os
	set s.os_service_id = os.os_service_id
    where s.tmp_linkback_stid = os.tmp_linkback_stid;
END
temp_triggercall_actual_loop 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `temp_triggercall_actual_loop`(in in_start_wk int, in in_end_wk int)
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE task,wk, per_id INT;
  DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR select task_id, calc_yrweek, person_id from actual where calc_yrweek between in_start_wk and in_end_wk;

  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur1;
  
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur1 INTO task,wk,per_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
    call triggercall_actual(task,wk,per_id);
  END LOOP;

  CLOSE cur1;

END
temp_triggercall_show_loop 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `temp_triggercall_show_loop`(in in_start_year int, in in_end_year int)
BEGIN
 DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE t_show_id INT;
  DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR select show_id 
	from `show` where year(date_bid_start) between in_start_year and in_end_year;

  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur1;
  
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur1 INTO t_show_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
    call triggercall_show("Create", t_show_id);
  END LOOP;

  CLOSE cur1;
END
triggercal_auto_week_task 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercal_auto_week_task`(in in_task_id int, in in_date date)
BEGIN

declare rec_count, in_calc_yrweek int;
declare pd_tot decimal(10,2) default 0;
   
select yearweek(in_date,3) into in_calc_yrweek;
select count(*) into rec_count from s2_prodn.auto_week_task where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;

if rec_count=0 then
    insert into s2_prodn.auto_week_task
		(yrweek,task_id,pd_1,pd_2,pd_3,pd_4,pd_5,pd_6,pd_7)
		select * from (select calc_yrweek,task_id,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2,pd,0)) as asgn1,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3,pd,0)) as asgn2,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4,pd,0)) as asgn3,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5,pd,0)) as asgn4,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6,pd,0)) as asgn5,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7,pd,0)) as asgn6,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1,pd,0)) as asgn7
				from assignment
                where calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id
				group by calc_yrweek,task_id) as placeholder
		on duplicate key update
				pd_1 = asgn1,
                pd_2 = asgn2,
                pd_3 = asgn3,
                pd_4 = asgn4,
                pd_5 = asgn5,
                pd_6 = asgn6,
                pd_7 = asgn7;
else 
	
	select pd into pd_tot from s2_prodn.assignment
							where day_id = in_date and task_id = in_task_id 
							group by calc_yrweek,task_id;
	case dayofweek(in_date)
		when 2 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_1 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
		when 3 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_2 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
		when 4 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_3 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
		when 5 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_4 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
		when 6 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_5 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
		when 7 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_6 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
		when 1 then
			update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set awk.pd_7 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
	end case;
end if;

END
triggercall_account 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_account`(in in_account_id int, 
															in in_nickname varchar(45),
                                                            in in_segment_label varchar(45),
                                                            in in_account_group varchar(45))
BEGIN
	
        
  
    insert into auto_show
		(show_id, der_account_nickname, der_segment, der_account_group_name)
        select * from (select 	s.show_id,
								a.nickname,
                                a.segment_label,
								ag.account_group_name
								from s2_prodn.`account` as a
								left join s2_prodn.`show` as s on(s.account_id = a.account_id)
                                left join s2_prodn.`account_group` as ag on(ag.account_group_id = a.account_group_id)
                                where a.account_id = in_account_id
                                group by s.show_id) as tgt where tgt.show_id is not null
		on duplicate key update
			der_account_nickname = values(der_account_nickname),
            der_segment = values(der_segment),
            der_account_group_name = values(der_account_group_name);

  
  insert into auto_object
	(object_id,der_account_nickname)
	select * from (select o.object_id,a.nickname
		from  `account` as a
			join `show` as s on (a.account_id = s.account_id)
            join `object` as o on (o.show_id = s.show_id)
		where a.account_id = in_account_id
        group by o.object_id) as tgt where tgt.object_id is not null
	on duplicate key update
		der_account_nickname = values(der_account_nickname);
  

	update s2_prodn.`show` 
		set der_account_nickname = in_nickname,
			der_segment = in_segment_label,
            der_account_group_name = in_account_group
		where account_id = in_account_id;
        
	
END
triggercall_account_group 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_account_group`(in in_account_group_id int, in in_account_group_name varchar(45))
BEGIN

	
    
    insert into auto_show
		(show_id, der_account_group_name)
        select * from (select s.show_id,ag.account_group_name
								from s2_prodn.`account` as a
                                join s2_prodn.`show` as s on(s.account_id = a.account_id)
                                join s2_prodn.`account_group` as ag on(ag.account_group_id = a.account_group_id)
                                where ag.account_group_id = in_account_group_id
                                group by s.show_id) as tgt
		on duplicate key update
			der_account_group_name = values(der_account_group_name);

	
  
        
END
triggercall_affiliation 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_affiliation`(in in_person_id int)
BEGIN

	
    update person as p, affiliation as a
		set p.der_cur_affil_type = a.affil_type,
			p.der_cur_affil_is_active = a.is_active,
			p.der_badge_id = a.badge_id,
			p.der_nickname = a.nickname,
			p.der_bot_internal_email = a.bot_internal_email,
            p.der_bot_external_email = a.bot_external_email,
            p.der_active_dir_name = a.active_dir_name,
			p.der_shotbot_userid = a.shotbot_userid
		where a.is_active and a.person_id=in_person_id and p.person_id=in_person_id;
    
END
triggercall_assignment 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_assignment`(in in_task_id int, in in_calc_yrweek int)
BEGIN
	
	
    declare t_svc_id,t_obj_id,t_show_id,t_episode_id, t_person_id int;
    declare show_assigned_pd, obj_assigned_pd, svc_assigned_pd, task_assigned_pd decimal(7,2);
    
    
    select svc.service_id,obj.object_id,obj.show_id,obj.episode_id into 
				t_svc_id, t_obj_id, t_show_id, t_episode_id
		from  task as t 
		left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
		left join object as obj on (obj.object_id = svc.object_id)
		where t.task_id = in_task_id
    group by obj.object_id;
    
    
        
insert into auto_object
	(object_id,der_pd_assigned)
	select * from (select obj.object_id,sum(asgn.pd) 
		from assignment as asgn 
			left join task as t on (t.task_id = asgn.task_id)
            left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
			left join object as obj on (obj.object_id = svc.object_id)
		where obj.object_id = t_obj_id)as tgt
	on duplicate key update
		der_pd_assigned = values(der_pd_assigned);
	
     
insert into auto_service
	(service_id, der_pd_assigned)
    select * from (select svc.service_id,sum(asgn.pd) 
		from assignment as asgn  
			left join task as t on (t.task_id = asgn.task_id)
            left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = t.service_id)
		where svc.service_id = t_svc_id
        group by svc.service_id) as tgt
	on duplicate key update
		der_pd_assigned = values(der_pd_assigned);
        

     
insert into auto_task
	(task_id, der_pd_assigned)
    select * from (select asgn.task_id, sum(asgn.pd)  
		from assignment as asgn 
		where asgn.task_id = in_task_id
        group by asgn.task_id) as tgt
	on duplicate key update
		der_pd_assigned = values(der_pd_assigned);
    
     
    
      
	select person_id into t_person_id from task where task_id = in_task_id;
     
	if not isnull(t_person_id) then 
		insert into auto_week_person
			(yrweek,person_id,task_id_1,task_id_2,task_id_3,task_id_4,task_id_5,task_id_6,task_id_7,
			tot_pd_1,tot_pd_2,tot_pd_3,tot_pd_4,tot_pd_5,tot_pd_6,tot_pd_7)
			select * from (select a.calc_yrweek,t.person_id,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 2,a.task_id,null)) as task1,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 3,a.task_id,null)) as task2,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 4,a.task_id,null)) as task3,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 5,a.task_id,null)) as task4,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 6,a.task_id,null)) as task5,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 7,a.task_id,null)) as task6,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 1,a.task_id,null)) as task7,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 2,a.pd,0)) as asgn1,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 3,a.pd,0)) as asgn2,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 4,a.pd,0)) as asgn3,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 5,a.pd,0)) as asgn4,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 6,a.pd,0)) as asgn5,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 7,a.pd,0)) as asgn6,
				sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 1,a.pd,0)) as asgn7
			from assignment as a left join task as t on (a.task_id = t.task_id)
				where t.person_id=t_person_id and a.calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek
				group by calc_yrweek,person_id) as placeholder
			on duplicate key update
				task_id_1 = task1,
				task_id_2 = task2,
				task_id_3 = task3,
				task_id_4 = task4,
				task_id_5 = task5,
				task_id_6 = task6,
				task_id_7 = task7,
				tot_pd_1 = asgn1,
				tot_pd_2 = asgn2,
				tot_pd_3 = asgn3,
				tot_pd_4 = asgn4,
				tot_pd_5 = asgn5,
				tot_pd_6 = asgn6,
				tot_pd_7 = asgn7;
	end if;
    
    
    insert into auto_week_task
		(yrweek,task_id,pd_1,pd_2,pd_3,pd_4,pd_5,pd_6,pd_7)
		select * from (select calc_yrweek,task_id,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2,pd,0)) as asgn1,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3,pd,0)) as asgn2,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4,pd,0)) as asgn3,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5,pd,0)) as asgn4,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6,pd,0)) as asgn5,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7,pd,0)) as asgn6,
				sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1,pd,0)) as asgn7
				from assignment
                where calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id
				group by calc_yrweek,task_id) as placeholder
		on duplicate key update
				pd_1 = asgn1,
                pd_2 = asgn2,
                pd_3 = asgn3,
                pd_4 = asgn4,
                pd_5 = asgn5,
                pd_6 = asgn6,
                pd_7 = asgn7;


END
triggercall_authorization 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_authorization`(in in_auth_id int)
BEGIN



insert into auto_service
	(service_id, der_date_auth_on)
	select * from (select s.service_id, a.auth_on from service as s 
				join billing_item as bi on (bi.bin = s.bin)
				join authorization as a on (a.auth_id = bi.auth_id)
				where a.auth_id= in_auth_id) as tgt
	on duplicate key update
		der_date_auth_on = values(der_date_auth_on);
	
END
triggercall_auto_billing_item 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_billing_item`(in in_bin int)
BEGIN

declare ri2d,p2d decimal(10,2);

select 	
		sum(if(i.status in ("Released","Closed"),inv_amount,0)),
        sum(pi.item_alloc_payment) into ri2d,p2d
	from invoice_item as ii 
	left join invoice as i on (i.invoice_id = ii.invoice_id)
    left join payment_item as pi on (pi.inv_item_id = ii.inv_item_id)
    where bin=in_bin
    group by ii.bin;
    
insert into auto_billing_item 
(bin, bid_id, show_id, episode_id, service_type_id, auth_status, auth_date, net_price, rel_inv_to_date, paid_to_date)
select * from 
(select 
	bi.bin as bin,
    b.bid_id as bid_id,
    b.show_id as show_id,
    b.episode_id as episode_id,
    bi.service_type_id as service_type_id,
    bi.status as auth_status,
    a.auth_on as auth_date,
    q.net_price as net_price,
    ri2d as rel_inv_to_date,
    p2d as paid_to_date
    
	from billing_item as bi 
	left join bid as b on (b.bid_id = bi.bid_id)
    left join quote as q on (bi.quote_id = q.quote_id)
    left join authorization as a on (a.auth_id = bi.auth_id)
    where bi.bin= in_bin
    group by bi.bin) as orig
on duplicate key update
	bid_id = orig.bid_id,
    show_id = orig.show_id, 
    episode_id = orig.episode_id, 
    service_type_id = orig.service_type_id, 
    auth_status = orig.auth_status, 
    auth_date = orig.auth_date,
    net_price = orig.net_price, 
    rel_inv_to_date = orig.rel_inv_to_date, 
    paid_to_date = orig.paid_to_date;
        
END
triggercall_auto_invoice_item 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_invoice_item`(in in_inv_item_id int)
BEGIN

insert into auto_invoice_item
(inv_item_id,bin,item_category,invoice_id,inv_date,inv_status,inv_type,inv_amount,paid_to_date,last_payment_date)
select * from (select
	ii.inv_item_id as inv_item_id,
    ii.bin as bin,
    ii.item_category as item_category,
    ii.invoice_id as invoice_id,
    inv_date as inv_date,
    status as inv_status,
    invoice_type as inv_type,
    inv_amount as inv_amount,
    sum(item_alloc_payment) as paid_to_date,
    max(p.paid_on) as last_payment_date
	from invoice_item as ii left join invoice as i on (ii.invoice_id=i.invoice_id) 
    left join payment_item as pi on (ii.inv_item_id = pi.inv_item_id)
    left join payment as p on (pi.payment_id = p.payment_id)
	where ii.inv_item_id= in_inv_item_id
    group by ii.inv_item_id) as orig
on duplicate key update
	bin = orig.bin,
    item_category = orig.item_category,
    invoice_id = orig.invoice_id,
    inv_date = orig.inv_date,
    inv_status = orig.inv_status,
    inv_type = orig.inv_type,
    inv_amount = orig.inv_amount,
    paid_to_date = orig.paid_to_date,
    last_payment_date = orig.last_payment_date;
END
triggercall_auto_object 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_object`(in in_object_id int, in upd_type enum('Full','Service','ActAssgnAlloc','Note','Object'))
BEGIN


case upd_type
when 'Full' then
	insert into auto_object 
			(object_id, der_pd_bid, der_pd_approved, der_pd_actual, der_pd_allocated, 
            der_pd_assigned, der_note_count, der_thumb_mediafile_id, der_proxyqt_mediafile_id)
	select * from (
				with notecnt as (select object_id, count(note_id) as note_count
							from s2_prodn.note 
							where assoc_element = 'Object' and object_id = in_object_id
							group by object_id)
				select 	o.object_id,
							ifnull(sum(svc.pd_bid),0) as der_pd_bid,
                            ifnull(sum(svc.pd_approved),0) as der_pd_approved,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_actual),0) as der_pd_actual,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_allocated),0) as der_pd_allocated,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_assigned),0) as der_pd_assigned,
                            ifnull(notecnt.note_count,0) as der_note_count,  
							p.thumb_mediafile_id as der_thumb_mediafile_id,
                            p.proxyqt_mediafile_id as der_proxyqt_mediafile_id
						from s2_prodn.object as o
						left join s2_prodn.`show` as s on (o.show_id = s.show_id) 
						left join s2_prodn.published as p on (o.reference_pub_id = p.pub_id)  
                        left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (o.object_id = svc.object_id) 
                        left join s2_prodn.auto_service as asvc on (asvc.service_id = svc.service_id)  
                        left join notecnt on (o.object_id = notecnt.object_id)
                    where o.object_id = in_object_id
                    group by o.object_id
					) as orig
	on duplicate key update
			der_pd_bid = orig.der_pd_bid, 
            der_pd_approved = orig.der_pd_approved, 
            der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual, 
            der_pd_allocated = orig.der_pd_allocated, 
            der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned, 
            der_note_count = orig.der_note_count,
            der_thumb_mediafile_id = orig.der_thumb_mediafile_id, 
            der_proxyqt_mediafile_id = orig.der_proxyqt_mediafile_id;


when 'Service' then
	insert into auto_object 
			(object_id, der_pd_bid, der_pd_approved, der_pd_actual, der_pd_allocated, der_pd_assigned)
	select * from (select 	o.object_id,
							ifnull(sum(svc.pd_bid),0) as der_pd_bid,
                            ifnull(sum(svc.pd_approved),0) as der_pd_approved,
							ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_actual),0) as der_pd_actual,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_allocated),0) as der_pd_allocated,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_assigned),0) as der_pd_assigned
                           
						from s2_prodn.object as o
                        left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (o.object_id = svc.object_id) 
                        left join s2_prodn.auto_service as asvc on (asvc.service_id = svc.service_id)  
                    where o.object_id = in_object_id
                    group by o.object_id
					) as orig
	on duplicate key update
			der_pd_bid = orig.der_pd_bid, 
            der_pd_approved = orig.der_pd_approved,
            der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual, 
            der_pd_allocated = orig.der_pd_allocated, 
            der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned ;


when 'ActAssgnAlloc' then
	insert into auto_object 
			(object_id,  der_pd_actual, der_pd_allocated, der_pd_assigned)
	select * from (select 	o.object_id,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_actual),0) as der_pd_actual,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_allocated),0) as der_pd_allocated,
                            ifnull(sum(asvc.der_pd_assigned),0) as der_pd_assigned
						from s2_prodn.object as o
                        left join s2_prodn.service as svc on (o.object_id = svc.object_id) 
                        left join s2_prodn.auto_service as asvc on (asvc.service_id = svc.service_id)  
                    where o.object_id = in_object_id
                    group by o.object_id
					) as orig
	on duplicate key update
            der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual,
            der_pd_allocated = orig.der_pd_allocated, 
            der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned;


when 'Note' then
	insert into auto_object 
			(object_id, der_note_count)
	select * from (
				with notecnt as (select object_id, count(note_id) as note_count
							from s2_prodn.note 
							where assoc_element = 'Object' and object_id = in_object_id
							group by object_id)
				select 	o.object_id,
						ifnull(notecnt.note_count,0) as der_note_count
							
						from s2_prodn.object as o
						left join notecnt on (notecnt.object_id = o.object_id)
                    where o.object_id = in_object_id
                    group by o.object_id
					) as orig
	on duplicate key update
            der_note_count = orig.der_note_count;
            
when 'Object' then
	insert into auto_object 
			(object_id, der_thumb_mediafile_id, der_proxyqt_mediafile_id)
	select * from (select 	o.object_id,
							p.thumb_mediafile_id as der_thumb_mediafile_id,
                            p.proxyqt_mediafile_id as der_proxyqt_mediafile_id
						from s2_prodn.object as o
						left join s2_prodn.published as p on (o.reference_pub_id = p.pub_id)  

                    where o.object_id = in_object_id
                    group by o.object_id
					) as orig
	on duplicate key update
            der_thumb_mediafile_id = orig.der_thumb_mediafile_id, 
            der_proxyqt_mediafile_id = orig.der_proxyqt_mediafile_id;
            
end case;
END
triggercall_auto_service 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_service`(in in_service_id int,in upd_type enum('Full','Task','Service','Actual','Assigned','Note','Delivery','Service_Staff'))
BEGIN


Declare t_date_ffd date default null;
declare t_ffd_deliv_id int default null;
Declare t_last_delivery_id int default null;
Declare t_last_deliv_date date default null;
Declare t_last_deliv_label varchar(16) default null;

case upd_type 
when 'Full' then
	
		select deliv_date, delivery_id into t_date_ffd, t_ffd_deliv_id
			from delivery as d
			left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = d.service_id)
		where d.deliv_type="Full" and svc.service_id=in_service_id
        order by deliv_date asc limit 1;
			
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_auth_id, der_date_auth_on, der_status_type, der_pd_allocated, 
			der_pd_actual, der_pd_assigned, der_note_count, der_service_type_label, der_date_ffd, 
			der_pre_ffd, der_post_ffd, der_ffd_deliv_id)
		select * from (
			with ffd_pds as (
					select  t.service_id as service_id,
						sum(if(act.day_id <= t_date_ffd ,act.pd,0)) as pre_ffd,
						sum(if(act.day_id > t_date_ffd ,act.pd,0)) as post_ffd
					from actual as act
					join task as t on (t.task_id = act.task_id)
                    where t.service_id = in_service_id
					group by t.service_id)
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					a.auth_id as der_auth_id,  
					a.auth_on as der_date_auth_on,  
					(case svc.status_label
						when 'Appr' then 'Approved'
						when 'Deliv' then 'Delivered'
						when 'Hold' then 'Paused'
						when 'Omit' then 'Paused'
						when 'Pend' then 'Pending'
						when 'reWIP' then 'IP'
						when 'WIP' then 'IP'
					end) as der_status_type,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_allocated),0) as der_pd_allocated,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_actual),0) as der_pd_actual,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_assigned),0) as der_pd_assigned,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_note_count),0) as der_note_count,
					st.service_type_label as der_service_type_label,
					t_date_ffd as der_date_ffd,
					ffd_pds.pre_ffd as der_pre_ffd,  
					ffd_pds.post_ffd as der_post_ffd,
