					t_ffd_deliv_id as der_ffd_deliv_id
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
                left join s2_prodn.billing_item as bi on (svc.bin = bi.bin)
                left join s2_prodn.authorization as a on (bi.auth_id = a.auth_id)
				left join s2_prodn.service_type as st on (svc.service_type_id = st.service_type_id)
				left join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
				left join s2_prodn.auto_task as atask on (atask.task_id = t.task_id)
				left join ffd_pds on (svc.service_id = ffd_pds.service_id)
			where svc.service_id = in_service_id
			group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_auth_id = orig.der_auth_id, 
			der_date_auth_on = orig.der_date_auth_on, 
			der_status_type = orig.der_status_type, 
			der_pd_allocated = orig.der_pd_allocated, 
			der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual, 
			der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned, 
			der_note_count = orig.der_note_count, 
			der_service_type_label = orig.der_service_type_label, 
			der_date_ffd = orig.der_date_ffd,
			der_pre_ffd = orig.der_pre_ffd, 
			der_post_ffd = orig.der_post_ffd,
            der_ffd_deliv_id = orig.der_ffd_deliv_id;
            
when 'Task' then
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_pd_allocated, der_pd_actual, der_pd_assigned)
		select * from (
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_allocated),0) as der_pd_allocated,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_actual),0) as der_pd_actual,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_assigned),0) as der_pd_assigned
					
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
				left join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
				left join s2_prodn.auto_task as atask on (atask.task_id = t.task_id)
			where svc.service_id = in_service_id
			group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_pd_allocated = orig.der_pd_allocated, 
			der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual, 
			der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned;
            
            
when 'Service' then
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_auth_id, der_date_auth_on, der_status_type, der_service_type_label)
		select * from (
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					a.auth_id as der_auth_id,  
					a.auth_on as der_date_auth_on, 
					(case svc.status_label
						when 'Appr' then 'Approved'
						when 'Deliv' then 'Delivered'
						when 'Hold' then 'Paused'
						when 'Omit' then 'Paused'
						when 'Pend' then 'Pending'
						when 'reWIP' then 'IP'
						when 'WIP' then 'IP'
					end) as der_status_type,
					st.service_type_label as der_service_type_label
					
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
				left join s2_prodn.service_type as st on (svc.service_type_id = st.service_type_id)
				left join s2_prodn.billing_item as bi on (svc.bin = bi.bin)
                left join s2_prodn.authorization as a on (bi.auth_id = a.auth_id)
				where svc.service_id = in_service_id
				group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_auth_id = orig.der_auth_id, 
			der_date_auth_on = orig.der_date_auth_on, 
			der_status_type = orig.der_status_type, 
			der_service_type_label = orig.der_service_type_label;


when 'Service_Staff' then
	with ss as (SELECT DISTINCT
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        p.der_nickname,
        ' - ',
        sbs.`role`
        separator '; ' ) AS service_staff,
    service_id
FROM
    s2_prodn.service_bot_staff sbs
        JOIN
    s2_prodn.person p ON sbs.person_id = p.person_id
    where sbs.service_id = in_service_id
GROUP BY sbs.service_id)
	update s2_prodn.auto_service as s2as, ss set s2as.der_service_bot_staff=ss.service_staff where s2as.service_id=ss.service_id;
    
when 'Actual' then
		
		select deliv_date, delivery_id into t_date_ffd, t_ffd_deliv_id
			from delivery as d
			left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = d.service_id)
		where d.deliv_type="Full" and svc.service_id=in_service_id
        order by deliv_date asc limit 1;
        
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_pd_actual, der_date_ffd, der_pre_ffd, der_post_ffd, der_ffd_deliv_id)
		select * from (
			with ffd_pds as (
					select  t.service_id as service_id,
						sum(if(act.day_id <= t_date_ffd ,act.pd,0)) as pre_ffd,
						sum(if(act.day_id > t_date_ffd ,act.pd,0)) as post_ffd
					from actual as act
					join task as t on (t.task_id = act.task_id)
                    where t.service_id = in_service_id
					group by t.service_id)
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_actual),0) as der_pd_actual,
					t_date_ffd as der_date_ffd,
					ffd_pds.pre_ffd as der_pre_ffd,  
					ffd_pds.post_ffd as der_post_ffd,
                    t_ffd_deliv_id as der_ffd_deliv_id
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
				left join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
                left join s2_prodn.auto_task as atask on (atask.task_id = t.task_id)
				left join ffd_pds on (svc.service_id = ffd_pds.service_id)
			where svc.service_id = in_service_id
			group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual, 
			der_date_ffd = orig.der_date_ffd,
			der_pre_ffd = orig.der_pre_ffd, 
			der_post_ffd = orig.der_post_ffd,
            der_ffd_deliv_id = orig.der_ffd_deliv_id;

when 'Assigned' then
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_pd_assigned)
		select * from (
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					ifnull(sum(atask.der_pd_assigned),0) as der_pd_assigned
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
				left join s2_prodn.task as t on (t.service_id = svc.service_id)
				left join s2_prodn.auto_task as atask on (atask.task_id = t.task_id)
				where svc.service_id = in_service_id
				group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned;

when 'Note' then
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_note_count)
		select * from (
			with notecnt as (select service_id, count(note_id) as note_count
							from s2_prodn.note 
							where assoc_element = 'Service'
								and service_id = in_service_id
							group by service_id)
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					ifnull(notecnt.note_count,0) as der_note_count
				  
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
                left join notecnt on (svc.service_id = notecnt.service_id)
			where svc.service_id = in_service_id
			group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_note_count = orig.der_note_count;
            
            
when 'Delivery' then
	
		select deliv_date, delivery_id into t_date_ffd, t_ffd_deliv_id
			from delivery as d
			left join service as svc on (svc.service_id = d.service_id)
		where d.deliv_type="Full" and svc.service_id=in_service_id
        order by deliv_date asc limit 1;
        
        select 
			deliv_date,
			delivery_id,
			deliv_label into
            t_last_deliv_date,
            t_last_delivery_id,
            t_last_deliv_label
		from 
			s2_prodn.delivery
		where service_id = in_service_id
		order by deliv_date desc limit 1;
			
		insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_date_ffd, der_pre_ffd, der_post_ffd, der_ffd_deliv_id,der_last_delivery_id,der_last_deliv_date,der_last_deliv_label)
		select * from (
			with ffd_pds as (
					select  t.service_id as service_id,
						sum(if(act.day_id <= t_date_ffd ,act.pd,0)) as pre_ffd,
						sum(if(act.day_id > t_date_ffd ,act.pd,0)) as post_ffd
					from actual as act
					join task as t on (t.task_id = act.task_id)
                    where t.service_id = in_service_id
					group by t.service_id)
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					t_date_ffd as der_date_ffd,
					ffd_pds.pre_ffd as der_pre_ffd,  
					ffd_pds.post_ffd as der_post_ffd,
					t_ffd_deliv_id as der_ffd_deliv_id,
                    t_last_delivery_id as der_last_delivery_id,
					t_last_deliv_date as der_last_deliv_date,
					t_last_deliv_label as der_last_deliv_label
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
				left join ffd_pds on (svc.service_id = ffd_pds.service_id)
			where svc.service_id = in_service_id
			group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_date_ffd = orig.der_date_ffd,
			der_pre_ffd = orig.der_pre_ffd, 
			der_post_ffd = orig.der_post_ffd,
            der_ffd_deliv_id = orig.der_ffd_deliv_id,
            der_last_delivery_id = orig.der_last_delivery_id,
            der_last_deliv_date = orig.der_last_deliv_date,
            der_last_deliv_label = orig.der_last_deliv_label;
            
end case;
END
triggercall_auto_show 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_show`(in in_show_id int, in upd_type enum('Full', 'Show','Episode','BOTStaff' ,'Object','Service','Note'))
BEGIN
/* Created by Hitesh Jan 2022
	last updated 21MAR22
*/
Declare show_missing bool default null;


select isnull(show_id) into show_missing from s2_prodn.auto_show where show_id = in_show_id;

if show_missing or upd_type = 'Full' then
	insert into s2_prodn.auto_show
		(show_id, stage, show_name, account_nickname, show_type, 
        account_group_name, segment_label, episode_count, date_work_start, date_close, 
        exec_producer_nickname, producer_nickname, supervisor_nickname, assoc_producer_nickname, coordinator_nickname,
        shot_count,
        
        asset_count, yrweek_earliest_client_due, yrweek_latest_client_due, show_note_count, thumb_mediafile_id,
        service_total_count, service_ip_count, service_done_count, service_pause_count, service_pending_count,
        pd_appr_total, pd_appr_ip, pd_appr_done, pd_appr_pause,  pd_appr_pending, 
        pd_actual_total, pd_actual_ip, pd_actual_done, pd_actual_pause, pd_actual_pending,
        service_type_count_roto, service_type_count_paint, service_type_count_mm, service_type_count_rm, service_type_count_comp,
        service_type_count_asset, service_type_count_extract, service_type_count_mogrph, service_type_count_other, account_id
        )
	select * from (
		with 
			epi as (select show_id, count(episode_id) as episode_count from s2_prodn.episode where show_id = in_show_id group by show_id),
            prd as (select show_id, 
						max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Executive Producer',p.der_nickname,null)) as exec_producer_nickname, 
                        max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Producer',p.der_nickname,null)) as producer_nickname, 
						max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Supervisor',p.der_nickname,null)) as supervisor_nickname,
                        max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Associate Producer',p.der_nickname,null)) as assoc_producer_nickname,
                        max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Coordinator',p.der_nickname,null)) as coordinator_nickname 
						from s2_prodn.show_bot_staff as sbs
                        left join s2_prodn.person as p on (sbs.person_id = p.person_id)
                        where sbs.role_type in ('Executive Producer','Producer','Supervisor','Associate Producer','Coordinator') and show_id = in_show_id
                        group by show_id),
            obj as (select 	show_id, 
							ifnull(sum(if(obj_type='Shot',1,0)),0) as shot_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(obj_type='Asset',1,0)),0) as asset_count
						from s2_prodn.object 
                        where show_id = in_show_id
                        group by show_id),
			note as (select show_id,count(*) as show_note_count from s2_prodn.note where assoc_element = 'Show' and show_id = in_show_id group by show_id),
			svc as (select o.show_id,
							count(s.service_id) as service_total_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),1,0)),0) as service_ip_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),1,0)),0) as service_done_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Omit','Hold'),1,0)),0) as service_pause_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label ='Pend',1,0)),0) as service_pending_count,
                            
                            ifnull(sum(pd_approved),0) as pd_appr_total,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_ip,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_done,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Omit','Hold'),pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_pause,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label ='Pend',pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_pending,
                            
                            ifnull(sum(aus.der_pd_actual),0) as pd_actual_total,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_ip,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_done,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Omit','Hold'),aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_pause,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label ='Pend',aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_pending,
                            
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 2,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_roto,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 3,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_paint,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 4,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_mm,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 5,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_rm,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 1,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_comp,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 6,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_asset,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 7,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_extract,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 8,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_mogrph,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 9,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_other
                            
						from s2_prodn.service as s 
                        left join s2_prodn.auto_service as aus on (aus.service_id = s.service_id)
                        left join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = s.object_id)
                        where o.show_id = in_show_id
                        group by o.show_id)
		select 	s.show_id,
				s.stage, 
				s.show_name, 
				a.nickname as account_nickname, 
				s.show_type, 
                
                ag.account_group_name as account_group_name, 
                a.segment_label,
                
				ifnull(epi.episode_count,0) as episode_count, 
				ifnull(s.date_work_start,ifnull(s.date_bid_start,curdate())) as date_work_start, 
				s.date_close, 
				prd.exec_producer_nickname as exec_producer_nickname, 
				prd.producer_nickname as producer_nickname, 
				prd.supervisor_nickname as supervisor_nickname,
				prd.assoc_producer_nickname as assoc_producer_nickname,
				prd.coordinator_nickname as coordinator_nickname,
				ifnull(obj.shot_count,0) as shot_count,
				ifnull(obj.asset_count,0) as asset_count, 
				0 as yrweek_earliest_client_due, 
				0 as yrweek_latest_client_due, 
				ifnull(note.show_note_count,0) as show_note_count, 
				s.thumb_mediafile_id,
				ifnull(svc.service_total_count,0) as service_total_count, 
				svc.service_ip_count as service_ip_count, 
				svc.service_done_count as service_done_count, 
				svc.service_pause_count as service_pause_count, 
				svc.service_pending_count as service_pending_count,
				svc.pd_appr_total as pd_appr_total, 
				svc.pd_appr_ip as pd_appr_ip, 
				svc.pd_appr_done as pd_appr_done, 
				svc.pd_appr_pause as pd_appr_pause,  
				svc.pd_appr_pending as pd_appr_pending, 
				svc.pd_actual_total as pd_actual_total, 
				svc.pd_actual_ip as pd_actual_ip, 
				svc.pd_actual_done as pd_actual_done, 
				svc.pd_actual_pause as pd_actual_pause, 
				svc.pd_actual_pending as pd_actual_pending,
				svc.service_type_count_roto as service_type_count_roto, 
				svc.service_type_count_paint as service_type_count_paint, 
				svc.service_type_count_mm as service_type_count_mm, 
				svc.service_type_count_rm as service_type_count_rm, 
				svc.service_type_count_comp as service_type_count_comp,
				svc.service_type_count_asset as service_type_count_asset, 
				svc.service_type_count_extract as service_type_count_extract, 
				svc.service_type_count_mogrph as service_type_count_mogrph, 
				svc.service_type_count_other as service_type_count_other,
                a.account_id as account_id
		from s2_prodn.`show` as s 
			left join s2_prodn.`account` as a on (s.account_id = a.account_id)
            left join s2_prodn.account_group as ag on (ag.account_group_id = a.account_group_id)
            left join epi on (epi.show_id = s.show_id)
            left join obj on (obj.show_id = s.show_id)
            left join svc on (svc.show_id = s.show_id)
            left join prd on (prd.show_id = s.show_id) 
            left join note on (note.show_id = s.show_id)
		where s.show_id = in_show_id
        group by s.show_id
    ) as orig
	on duplicate key update
		stage = orig.stage, 
        show_name = orig.show_name, 
        account_nickname = orig.account_nickname, 
        show_type = orig.show_type, 
        account_group_name = orig.account_group_name, 
        segment_label = orig.segment_label,
        episode_count = orig.episode_count, 
        date_work_start = orig.date_work_start, 
        date_close = orig.date_close, 
        exec_producer_nickname = orig.exec_producer_nickname, 
		producer_nickname = orig.producer_nickname, 
		supervisor_nickname = orig.supervisor_nickname,
		assoc_producer_nickname = orig.assoc_producer_nickname,
		coordinator_nickname = orig.coordinator_nickname,
        shot_count = orig.shot_count,
        asset_count = orig.asset_count,
        yrweek_earliest_client_due = orig.yrweek_earliest_client_due, 
        yrweek_latest_client_due = orig.yrweek_latest_client_due, 
        show_note_count = orig.show_note_count, 
        thumb_mediafile_id = orig.thumb_mediafile_id,
        service_total_count = orig.service_total_count, 
        service_ip_count = orig.service_ip_count, 
        service_done_count = orig.service_done_count, 
        service_pause_count = orig.service_pause_count, 
        service_pending_count = orig.service_pending_count,
        pd_appr_total = orig.pd_appr_total, 
        pd_appr_ip = orig.pd_appr_ip, 
        pd_appr_done = orig.pd_appr_done, 
        pd_appr_pause = orig.pd_appr_pause,  
        pd_appr_pending = orig.pd_appr_pending, 
        pd_actual_total = orig.pd_actual_total, 
        pd_actual_ip = orig.pd_actual_ip, 
        pd_actual_done = orig.pd_actual_done, 
        pd_actual_pause = orig.pd_actual_pause,  
        pd_actual_pending = orig.pd_actual_pending,
        service_type_count_roto = orig.service_type_count_roto, 
        service_type_count_paint = orig.service_type_count_paint, 
        service_type_count_mm = orig.service_type_count_mm, 
        service_type_count_rm = orig.service_type_count_rm, 
        service_type_count_comp = orig.service_type_count_comp,
        service_type_count_asset = orig.service_type_count_asset, 
        service_type_count_extract = orig.service_type_count_extract, 
        service_type_count_mogrph = orig.service_type_count_mogrph, 
        service_type_count_other = orig.service_type_count_other,
        account_id = orig.account_id;
else

case upd_type 

when 'Show' then
	update s2_prodn.auto_show as ash, s2_prodn.`show` as s 
		set ash.stage = s.stage,
			ash.show_name = s.show_name, 
			ash.show_type = s.show_type, 
			ash.date_work_start = ifnull(s.date_work_start,ifnull(s.date_bid_start,curdate())), 
			ash.date_close = s.date_close, 
			ash.thumb_mediafile_id = s.thumb_mediafile_id
		where ash.show_id = s.show_id and ash.show_id = in_show_id;


when 'Episode' then
	with epcnt as (select show_id, count(*) as episode_count from s2_prodn.`episode` group by show_id)
	update s2_prodn.auto_show as ash, epcnt 
		set ash.episode_count = epcnt.episode_count
		where ash.show_id = epcnt.show_id and ash.show_id = in_show_id;      
        
        
when 'BOTStaff' then
	with prd as (select show_id, 
						max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Executive Producer',p.der_nickname,null)) as exec_producer_nickname, 
                        max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Producer',p.der_nickname,null)) as producer_nickname, 
						max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Supervisor',p.der_nickname,null)) as supervisor_nickname,
                        max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Associate Producer',p.der_nickname,null)) as assoc_producer_nickname,
                        max(if(sbs.role_type = 'Coordinator',p.der_nickname,null)) as coordinator_nickname 
						from s2_prodn.show_bot_staff as sbs
                        left join s2_prodn.person as p on (sbs.person_id = p.person_id)
                        where sbs.role_type in ('Executive Producer','Producer','Supervisor','Associate Producer','Coordinator') and show_id = in_show_id
                        group by show_id)
	update s2_prodn.auto_show as ash, prd 
		set ash.producer_nickname = prd.producer_nickname,
			ash.exec_producer_nickname = prd.exec_producer_nickname,
            ash.supervisor_nickname = prd.supervisor_nickname,
            ash.assoc_producer_nickname = prd.assoc_producer_nickname,
            ash.coordinator_nickname = prd.coordinator_nickname
		where ash.show_id = prd.show_id and ash.show_id = in_show_id; 

when 'Object' then
	with obj as (select 	show_id, 
							ifnull(sum(if(obj_type='Shot',1,0)),0) as shot_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(obj_type='Asset',1,0)),0) as asset_count
						from s2_prodn.object 
                        where show_id = in_show_id
                        group by show_id)
	update s2_prodn.auto_show as ash, obj 
		set ash.shot_count = obj.shot_count,
			ash.asset_count = obj.asset_count
		where ash.show_id = obj.show_id and ash.show_id = in_show_id; 
        
        
when 'Service' then
	with svc as (select o.show_id,
							count(s.service_id) as service_total_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),1,0)),0) as service_ip_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),1,0)),0) as service_done_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Omit','Hold'),1,0)),0) as service_pause_count,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label ='Pend',1,0)),0) as service_pending_count,
                            ifnull(sum(pd_approved),0) as pd_appr_total,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_ip,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_done,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Omit','Hold'),pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_pause,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label ='Pend',pd_approved,0)),0) as pd_appr_pending,
                            ifnull(sum(aus.der_pd_actual),0) as pd_actual_total,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('WIP','reWIP'),aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_ip,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Appr','Deliv'),aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_done,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label in ('Omit','Hold'),aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_pause,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.status_label ='Pend',aus.der_pd_actual,0)),0) as pd_actual_pending,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 2,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_roto,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 3,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_paint,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 4,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_mm,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 5,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_rm,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 1,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_comp,
                            ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 6,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_asset,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 7,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_extract,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 8,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_mogrph,
							ifnull(sum(if(s.service_type_id = 9,1,0)),0) as service_type_count_other
						from s2_prodn.service as s 
                        left join s2_prodn.auto_service as aus on (aus.service_id = s.service_id)
                        left join s2_prodn.object as o on (o.object_id = s.object_id)
                        where o.show_id = in_show_id
                        group by o.show_id)
	update s2_prodn.auto_show as ash, svc  
		set		ash.yrweek_earliest_client_due = 0, 
				ash.yrweek_latest_client_due = 0, 
				ash.service_total_count = ifnull(svc.service_total_count,0), 
				ash.service_ip_count = svc.service_ip_count, 
				ash.service_done_count = svc.service_done_count, 
				ash.service_pause_count = svc.service_pause_count, 
				ash.service_pending_count = svc.service_pending_count,
				ash.pd_appr_total = svc.pd_appr_total, 
				ash.pd_appr_ip = svc.pd_appr_ip, 
				ash.pd_appr_done = svc.pd_appr_done, 
				ash.pd_appr_pause = svc.pd_appr_pause,  
				ash.pd_appr_pending = svc.pd_appr_pending, 
				ash.pd_actual_total = svc.pd_actual_total, 
				ash.pd_actual_ip = svc.pd_actual_ip, 
				ash.pd_actual_done = svc.pd_actual_done, 
				ash.pd_actual_pause = svc.pd_actual_pause, 
				ash.pd_actual_pending = svc.pd_actual_pending,
				ash.service_type_count_roto = svc.service_type_count_roto, 
				ash.service_type_count_paint = svc.service_type_count_paint, 
				ash.service_type_count_mm = svc.service_type_count_mm, 
				ash.service_type_count_rm = svc.service_type_count_rm, 
				ash.service_type_count_comp = svc.service_type_count_comp,
				ash.service_type_count_asset = svc.service_type_count_asset, 
				ash.service_type_count_extract = svc.service_type_count_extract, 
				ash.service_type_count_mogrph = svc.service_type_count_mogrph, 
				ash.service_type_count_other = svc.service_type_count_other 
			where ash.show_id = svc.show_id and ash.show_id = in_show_id;
                    
when 'Note' then
	with note as (select show_id,count(*) as show_note_count from s2_prodn.note where assoc_element = 'Show' and show_id = in_show_id group by show_id)
	update s2_prodn.auto_show as s, note
		set s.show_note_count = ifnull(note.show_note_count,0)
        where  note.show_id = s.show_id and s.show_id = in_show_id;
		
        
end case;
end if;
END
triggercall_auto_task 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_task`(in in_task_id int, in upd_type enum('Task','Actual','Assigned','Note'))
BEGIN


case upd_type
when 'Task' then
	insert into s2_prodn.auto_task 
		(task_id, der_pd_allocated, der_pd_assigned, der_pd_actual, der_note_count, 
        der_person_nickname, der_person_badge_id, der_person_role_type, der_person_billable )
    select * from (
		with act_by_task as (select t.task_id, sum(act.pd) as tot_act_pd
								from s2_prodn.task as t 
								left join s2_prodn.actual as act on (act.task_id = t.task_id)
                                where t.task_id = in_task_id
                                group by t.task_id),
			 assgn_by_task as (select t.task_id, sum(asgn.pd) as tot_assgn_pd
								from s2_prodn.task as t 
								left join s2_prodn.assignment as asgn on (asgn.task_id = t.task_id)
                                where t.task_id = in_task_id
                                group by t.task_id),
			 notecnt as (select task_id, count(note_id) as note_count
								from s2_prodn.note 
                                where assoc_element = 'Task' and task_id = in_task_id
                                group by task_id)
		select 	t.task_id as task_id,
				ifnull(t.pd_allocated,0) as der_pd_allocated,
				ifnull(assgn_by_task.tot_assgn_pd,0) as der_pd_assigned,
				ifnull(act_by_task.tot_act_pd,0) as der_pd_actual,
                ifnull(notecnt.note_count,0) as der_note_count,   
                p.der_nickname as der_person_nickname,
                p.der_badge_id as der_person_badge_id,
                p.der_cur_role_type as der_person_role_type,
                p.der_cur_billable as der_person_billable
                
				from s2_prodn.task as t 
				left join s2_prodn.person as p on (t.person_id = p.person_id)
				left join act_by_task  on (t.task_id = act_by_task.task_id)
                left join assgn_by_task on (t.task_id = assgn_by_task.task_id)
                left join notecnt on (t.task_id = notecnt.task_id)
  
			where t.task_id = in_task_id
			group by t.task_id
			) as orig
	on duplicate key update
		der_pd_allocated = orig.der_pd_allocated, 
        der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned, 
        der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual, 
        der_note_count = orig.der_note_count, 
        der_person_nickname = orig.der_person_nickname,
        der_person_badge_id = orig.der_person_badge_id, 
        der_person_role_type = orig.der_person_role_type, 
        der_person_billable = orig.der_person_billable;
        
when 'Actual' then

	insert into s2_prodn.auto_task 
		(task_id, der_pd_actual)
    select * from (
		with act_by_task as (select t.task_id, sum(act.pd) as tot_act_pd
								from s2_prodn.task as t 
								left join s2_prodn.actual as act on (act.task_id = t.task_id)
                                where t.task_id = in_task_id
                                group by t.task_id)
		select 	t.task_id as task_id,
				ifnull(act_by_task.tot_act_pd,0) as der_pd_actual

				from s2_prodn.task as t 
				left join act_by_task  on (t.task_id = act_by_task.task_id)
			where t.task_id = in_task_id
			group by t.task_id
			) as orig
	on duplicate key update
        der_pd_actual = orig.der_pd_actual;
        
when 'Assigned' then
	insert into s2_prodn.auto_task 
		(task_id,  der_pd_assigned,der_task_due_date,der_task_start_date)
    select * from (
		with assgn_by_task as (select t.task_id, sum(asgn.pd) as tot_assgn_pd, max(asgn.day_id) as task_due,min(asgn.day_id) as task_start
								from s2_prodn.task as t 
								left join s2_prodn.assignment as asgn on (asgn.task_id = t.task_id)
                                where t.task_id = in_task_id
                                group by t.task_id)
		select 	t.task_id as task_id,
				ifnull(assgn_by_task.tot_assgn_pd,0) as der_pd_assigned,
				ifnull(task_due,null) as der_task_due_date,
				ifnull(task_start,null) as der_task_start_date
				from s2_prodn.task as t 
                left join assgn_by_task on (t.task_id = assgn_by_task.task_id)
			where t.task_id = in_task_id
			group by t.task_id
			) as orig
	on duplicate key update
        der_pd_assigned = orig.der_pd_assigned,
        der_task_due_date = orig.der_task_due_date,
        der_task_start_date = orig.der_task_start_date;

when 'Note' then
	insert into s2_prodn.auto_task 
		(task_id,  der_note_count)
    select * from (
		with notecnt as (select task_id, count(note_id) as note_count
								from s2_prodn.note 
                                where assoc_element = 'Task' and task_id = in_task_id
                                group by task_id)
		select 	t.task_id as task_id,
                ifnull(notecnt.note_count,0) as der_note_count
               
				from s2_prodn.task as t 
                left join notecnt on (t.task_id = notecnt.task_id)
			where t.task_id = in_task_id
			group by t.task_id
			) as orig
	on duplicate key update
        der_note_count = orig.der_note_count; 

end case;
END
triggercall_auto_week_person 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_week_person`(in in_person_id int, in in_date date, in upd_type enum('Actual','Assigned','Full'))
BEGIN

declare rec_count, in_calc_yrweek, t_task_id int;
declare assign_pd_tot, actual_pd_tot decimal(5,2) default 0;
   
select yearweek(in_date,3) into in_calc_yrweek;
select count(*) into rec_count from s2_prodn.auto_week_person where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;


if rec_count=0 or upd_type = 'Full' then

		
		insert into s2_prodn.auto_week_person
			(yrweek,person_id,task_id_1,task_id_2,task_id_3,task_id_4,task_id_5,task_id_6,task_id_7,
			tot_pd_1,tot_pd_2,tot_pd_3,tot_pd_4,tot_pd_5,tot_pd_6,tot_pd_7)
			select * from (select a.calc_yrweek,t.person_id,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 2,a.task_id,null)) as task1,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 3,a.task_id,null)) as task2,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 4,a.task_id,null)) as task3,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 5,a.task_id,null)) as task4,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 6,a.task_id,null)) as task5,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 7,a.task_id,null)) as task6,
				max(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 1,a.task_id,null)) as task7,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 2,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn1,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 3,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn2,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 4,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn3,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 5,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn4,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 6,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn5,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 7,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn6,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(a.day_id) = 1,a.pd,0)),0) as asgn7
			from s2_prodn.assignment as a left join task as t on (a.task_id = t.task_id)
				where t.person_id= in_person_id and a.calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek
				group by calc_yrweek,person_id) as placeholder
			on duplicate key update
				task_id_1 = task1,
				task_id_2 = task2,
				task_id_3 = task3,
				task_id_4 = task4,
				task_id_5 = task5,
				task_id_6 = task6,
				task_id_7 = task7,
				tot_pd_1 = asgn1,
				tot_pd_2 = asgn2,
				tot_pd_3 = asgn3,
				tot_pd_4 = asgn4,
				tot_pd_5 = asgn5,
				tot_pd_6 = asgn6,
				tot_pd_7 = asgn7;
            
            
		with act as (select person_id, 
							calc_yrweek, 
							sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2,pd,0)) as actual_pd_1,
                            sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3,pd,0)) as actual_pd_2,
                            sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4,pd,0)) as actual_pd_3,
                            sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5,pd,0)) as actual_pd_4,
                            sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6,pd,0)) as actual_pd_5,
                            sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7,pd,0)) as actual_pd_6,
                            sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1,pd,0)) as actual_pd_7
					from s2_prodn.actual 
                    where person_id = in_person_id and calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek
                    group by person_id, calc_yrweek)
        update s2_prodn.auto_week_person as awp, act
			set awp.actual_pd_1 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_1,0),
				awp.actual_pd_2 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_2,0),
                awp.actual_pd_3 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_3,0),
                awp.actual_pd_4 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_4,0),
                awp.actual_pd_5 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_5,0),
                awp.actual_pd_6 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_6,0),
                awp.actual_pd_7 = ifnull(act.actual_pd_7,0)
			where awp.yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and awp.person_id = in_person_id;
                    
else 
	case upd_type 
		when 'Assigned' then
			select ifnull(sum(pd),0), max(t.task_id) into assign_pd_tot,t_task_id 
					from s2_prodn.assignment as a
                    join s2_prodn.task as t on (a.task_id = t.task_id)
					where a.day_id = in_date and t.person_id = in_person_id 
					group by a.day_id, t.person_id;
			case dayofweek(in_date)
				when 2 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_1 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_1= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 3 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_2 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_2= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 4 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_3 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_3= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 5 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_4 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_4= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 6 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_5 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_5= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 7 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_6 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_6= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 1 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set tot_pd_7 = assign_pd_tot, task_id_7= t_task_id where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
			end case;
            
		when 'Actual' then
			
			select ifnull(sum(pd),0) into actual_pd_tot 
					from s2_prodn.actual 
					where day_id = in_date and person_id = in_person_id 
					group by day_id, person_id;
			case dayofweek(in_date)
				when 2 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_1 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 3 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_2 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 4 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_3 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 5 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_4 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 6 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_5 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 7 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_6 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
				when 1 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_person set actual_pd_7 = actual_pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and person_id = in_person_id;
			end case;
	end case;

end if;


END
triggercall_auto_week_task 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_week_task`(in in_task_id int, in in_date date, in upd_type enum('Actual','Assigned','Full') )
BEGIN

declare rec_count, in_calc_yrweek int;
declare pd_tot decimal(5,2) default 0;
   
select yearweek(in_date,3) into in_calc_yrweek;
select count(*) into rec_count from s2_prodn.auto_week_task where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;


if rec_count=0 or upd_type = 'Full' then
    insert into s2_prodn.auto_week_task
		(yrweek,task_id,person_id,pd_1,pd_2,pd_3,pd_4,pd_5,pd_6,pd_7)
		select * from (
        select calc_yrweek,
				a.task_id,
				t.person_id as person_id,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2,pd,0)),0) as asgn1,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3,pd,0)),0) as asgn2,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4,pd,0)),0) as asgn3,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5,pd,0)),0) as asgn4,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6,pd,0)),0) as asgn5,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7,pd,0)),0) as asgn6,
				ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1,pd,0)),0) as asgn7
				from s2_prodn.assignment as a
					join s2_prodn.task as t on (a.task_id = t.task_id)
                where calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and a.task_id = in_task_id
				group by calc_yrweek,task_id) as orig
		on duplicate key update
				person_id = orig.person_id,
				pd_1 = orig.asgn1,
                pd_2 = orig.asgn2,
                pd_3 = orig.asgn3,
                pd_4 = orig.asgn4,
                pd_5 = orig.asgn5,
                pd_6 = orig.asgn6,
                pd_7 = orig.asgn7;
                
		with act as (select task_id, 
							calc_yrweek, 
							ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_1,
                            ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_2,
                            ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_3,
                            ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_4,
                            ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_5,
                            ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_6,
                            ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1,pd,0)),0) as pd_actual_7
					from s2_prodn.actual 
                    where task_id = in_task_id and calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek
                    group by task_id, calc_yrweek)
        update s2_prodn.auto_week_task as awk, act
			set awk.pd_actual_1 = act.pd_actual_1,
				awk.pd_actual_2 = act.pd_actual_2,
                awk.pd_actual_3 = act.pd_actual_3,
                awk.pd_actual_4 = act.pd_actual_4,
                awk.pd_actual_5 = act.pd_actual_5,
                awk.pd_actual_6 = act.pd_actual_6,
                awk.pd_actual_7 = act.pd_actual_7
			where awk.yrweek = act.calc_yrweek and awk.task_id = act.task_id and
					act.calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and act.task_id = in_task_id;
else 
	case upd_type 
		when 'Assigned' then
			select ifnull(pd,0) into pd_tot from s2_prodn.assignment
									where day_id = in_date and task_id = in_task_id 
									group by calc_yrweek,task_id;
			case dayofweek(in_date)
				when 2 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_1 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 3 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_2 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 4 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_3 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 5 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_4 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 6 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_5 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 7 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_6 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 1 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_7 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
			end case;
            
		when 'Actual' then
			select ifnull(sum(pd),0) into pd_tot from s2_prodn.actual
									where day_id = in_date and task_id = in_task_id 
									group by day_id,task_id;
			case dayofweek(in_date)
				when 2 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_1 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 3 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_2 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 4 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_3 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 5 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_4 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 6 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_5 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 7 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_6 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
				when 1 then
					update s2_prodn.auto_week_task set pd_actual_7 = pd_tot where yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and task_id = in_task_id;
			end case;

        
	end case;
end if;

END
triggercall_auto_week_task_nodate 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_auto_week_task_nodate`(in in_task_id int)
BEGIN
insert into s2_prodn.auto_week_task
		(yrweek,task_id,person_id,pd_1,pd_2,pd_3,pd_4,pd_5,pd_6,pd_7)
		select * from 
				(select  a.calc_yrweek as yrweek,
					a.task_id as task_id,
					t.person_id as person_id,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2,pd,0)),0) as asgn1,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3,pd,0)),0) as asgn2,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4,pd,0)),0) as asgn3,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5,pd,0)),0) as asgn4,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6,pd,0)),0) as asgn5,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7,pd,0)),0) as asgn6,
					ifnull(sum(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1,pd,0)),0) as asgn7
				from s2_prodn.assignment as a
					join s2_prodn.task as t on (a.task_id = t.task_id)
                where a.task_id = in_task_id
				group by calc_yrweek,task_id) as orig
		on duplicate key update
				person_id = orig.person_id,
				pd_1 = orig.asgn1,
                pd_2 = orig.asgn2,
                pd_3 = orig.asgn3,
                pd_4 = orig.asgn4,
                pd_5 = orig.asgn5,
                pd_6 = orig.asgn6,
                pd_7 = orig.asgn7;
END
triggercall_billing_item 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_billing_item`(in in_bin int)
BEGIN




	
insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_auth_id, der_date_auth_on)
		select * from (
			select 	svc.service_id as service_id,
					a.auth_id as der_auth_id,  
					a.auth_on as der_date_auth_on
				
				from s2_prodn.service as svc
				left join s2_prodn.service_type as st on (svc.service_type_id = st.service_type_id)
				left join s2_prodn.billing_item as bi on (svc.bin = bi.bin)
                left join s2_prodn.authorization as a on (bi.auth_id = a.auth_id)
				where svc.bin = in_bin
				group by svc.service_id
			) as orig
		on duplicate key update
			der_auth_id = orig.der_auth_id, 
			der_date_auth_on = orig.der_date_auth_on;
END
triggercall_payment_item 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_payment_item`(in in_payment_id int)
BEGIN
   
    with gap as (SELECT 
    p.payment_id,
    p.paid_amount,
    SUM(pi.item_alloc_payment) iPay,
    (p.paid_amount - SUM(pi.item_alloc_payment)) AS allocation_gap
FROM
    s2_prodn.payment p
        LEFT JOIN
    s2_prodn.payment_item pi ON p.payment_id = pi.payment_id where pi.payment_id=in_payment_id group by pi.payment_id) 
    update s2_prodn.payment p, gap set p.allocation_gap = gap.allocation_gap where p.payment_id = gap.payment_id;
END
triggercall_pcal 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_pcal`(in in_calc_yrweek int, in in_facility varchar(4))
BEGIN
 
 
insert into auto_week_pcal
	(yrweek,facility_code,prodn_1,prodn_2,prodn_3,prodn_4,prodn_5,prodn_6,prodn_7)
	select * from (select calc_yrweek,facility_code,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 2 and working,1,0)) as day1,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 3 and working,1,0)) as day2,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 4 and working,1,0)) as day3,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 5 and working,1,0)) as day4,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 6 and working,1,0)) as day5,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 7 and working,1,0)) as day6,
		max(if(dayofweek(day_id) = 1 and working,1,0)) as day7
		from pcal 
		where calc_yrweek = in_calc_yrweek and facility_code = in_facility
		group by calc_yrweek,facility_code) as placeholder
	on duplicate key update
		prodn_1 = day1,
        prodn_2 = day2,
        prodn_3 = day3,
        prodn_4 = day4,
        prodn_5 = day5,
        prodn_6 = day6,
        prodn_7 = day7;
END
triggercall_person 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_person`(in in_person_id int, in upd_type enum('Affiliation','Role','Location', 'Skill'))
BEGIN
DECLARE total_active_affiliation int;
case upd_type
	when 'Affiliation' then
		with aff as (
			select * from (
            select 
				a.person_id,
             	a.affiliation_id as der_cur_affil_id,
                a.is_active,
 				a.badge_id as der_badge_id, 
 				a.nickname as der_nickname, 
 				a.affil_type as der_cur_affil_type, 
 				a.active_dir_name as der_active_dir_name, 
 				a.bot_internal_email as der_bot_internal_email, 
 				a.bot_external_email as der_bot_external_email, 				
                a.shotbot_userid as der_shotbot_userid, 
				a.start_date as der_cur_affil_start_date,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn
				from s2_prodn.affiliation a where a.person_id = in_person_id
            )  as affiliation_desc where affiliation_desc.rn = 1
        )
        
		update s2_prodn.person as p, aff 
			set p.der_cur_affil_is_active =  aff.is_active,
			p.der_cur_affil_id = aff.der_cur_affil_id,
			p.der_badge_id = aff.der_badge_id, 
			p.der_nickname = aff.der_nickname, 
			p.der_cur_affil_type = aff.der_cur_affil_type,  
			p.der_active_dir_name =  aff.der_active_dir_name, 
			p.der_bot_internal_email = aff.der_bot_internal_email,
			p.der_bot_external_email = aff.der_bot_external_email, 
			p.der_shotbot_userid = aff.der_shotbot_userid, 
			p.der_cur_affil_start_date = aff.der_cur_affil_start_date
			where p.person_id = aff.person_id and p.person_id = in_person_id;
                
	when 'Role' then
		with rol as (select p.person_id as person_id,
							max(if(r.is_active, rt.role_type, null)) as der_cur_role_type,
							max(if(r.is_active, d.dept_label, null)) as der_cur_dept_label,
                            max(if(r.is_active, rt.billable, null)) as der_cur_billable
					from s2_prodn.person as p
                    join s2_prodn.affiliation as a on (p.person_id = a.person_id)
					join s2_prodn.person_role as r on (r.affiliation_id = a.affiliation_id)
                    join s2_prodn.role_type as rt on (rt.role_type_id = r.role_type_id)
                    join s2_prodn.department as d on (rt.dept_id = d.dept_id)
                    where p.person_id = in_person_id
                    group by p.person_id)
		update s2_prodn.person as p, rol 
			set p.der_cur_role_type = rol.der_cur_role_type, 
				p.der_cur_dept_label = rol.der_cur_dept_label, 
				p.der_cur_billable = rol.der_cur_billable
			where p.person_id = rol.person_id and p.person_id = in_person_id;
 
 	when 'Skill' then
		with skl as (select p.person_id as person_id,
							ps.skill_id as der_cur_primary_skill_id,
							sk.skill_label as der_cur_primary_skill,
							ps.proficiency as der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency
					from s2_prodn.person as p
                    join s2_prodn.person_skill as ps on (p.person_id = ps.person_id)
					join s2_prodn.skill as sk on (sk.skill_id = ps.skill_id)
                    where ps.is_primary and p.person_id = in_person_id
                    group by p.person_id)
		update s2_prodn.person as p, skl 
			set p.der_cur_primary_skill = skl.der_cur_primary_skill, 
				p.der_cur_primary_skill_id = skl.der_cur_primary_skill_id, 
				p.der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency = skl.der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency
			where p.person_id = skl.person_id and p.person_id = in_person_id;
            
	when 'Location' then
		with loc as (select p.person_id as person_id,
							pl.facility_code as der_cur_facility
					from s2_prodn.person as p
                    join s2_prodn.person_location as pl on (p.person_id = pl.person_id)
                    where pl.is_active and p.person_id = in_person_id
                    group by p.person_id)
		update s2_prodn.person as p, loc 
			set p.der_cur_facility = loc.der_cur_facility
			where p.person_id = loc.person_id and p.person_id = in_person_id;
end case;

END
triggercall_person_location 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_person_location`(in in_person_id int, in in_facility_code varchar(4), in in_seat_id varchar(16))
BEGIN
	
	UPDATE s2_prodn.person 
		SET der_cur_facility = in_facility_code,
			der_cur_seat_id = in_seat_id
		WHERE person_id = in_person_id;
END
triggercall_person_skill 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_person_skill`(in in_person_id int, in in_skill_id int, in in_proficiency enum('Very High','High','Medium','Basic','Beginner') )
BEGIN
	
 
   
   UPDATE s2_prodn.person
		SET der_cur_primary_skill_id = in_skill_id,
			der_cur_primary_skill = (SELECT skill_label FROM s2_prodn.skill WHERE skill_id=in_skill_id),
			der_cur_primary_skill_proficiency = in_proficiency
		WHERE person_id = in_person_id;
END
triggercall_person_unique 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_person_unique`(in in_nickname varchar(150), in in_person_id int)
BEGIN

	 DECLARE total_records int;
     DECLARE msg varchar(100);
	 set total_records = (select count(affiliation_id)  from s2_prodn.affiliation a where person_id <> in_person_id and nickname = in_nickname);
     if total_records > 0 then
	 	set msg = concat("Nickname ", in_nickname," already exists");
	 	signal sqlstate '45000' set message_text = msg;
     end if;
    
END
triggercall_role_type 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_role_type`(in in_role_type_id int, in in_dept_id int, in in_role_type varchar(50), in in_billable tinyint(1))
BEGIN
	
	UPDATE s2_prodn.person 
	SET  der_cur_dept_id = in_dept_id,
		 der_cur_role_type = in_role_type,
		 der_cur_billable = in_billable
	WHERE der_cur_affil_id in  (SELECT affiliation_id FROM s2_prodn.person_role WHERE role_type_id=in_role_type_id);
END
triggercall_service_status 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_service_status`(in in_status_label varchar(16))
BEGIN



insert into auto_service
	(service_id, der_status_type)
    select * from (select s.service_id, ss.status_type	from service as s
							join service_status as ss on (ss.status_label = s.status_label)
                            where ss.status_label = in_status_label) as tgt
	on duplicate key update
		der_status_type=values(der_status_type);
END
triggercall_service_type 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `triggercall_service_type`(in in_service_type_id int)
BEGIN



insert into auto_service 
			(service_id, der_service_type_label)
            select * from (select s.service_id, st.service_type_label
									from service as s
									join service_type as st on (st.service_type_id = s.service_type_id)
                                    where st.service_type_id = in_service_type_id) as tgt
		on duplicate key update
			der_service_type_label = values(der_service_type_label);
END
vermillion_data_load 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `vermillion_data_load`()
BEGIN




insert into s2_prodn.account_group
	(account_group_id,account_group_name,`description`)
    select * from (select account_group_id as id,
		group_name as gname,
        group_description as descri
        from shotbot_production.account_group where account_group_id =1013) as placeholder
	on duplicate key update
		account_group_name = gname,
        `description` = descri;
		
insert into s2_prodn.`account`
	(account_id, `name`,nickname,account_group_id,crm_account_id,segment_label) 
	select * from (select account_id,
			`name` as aname,
			nickname as anickname,
			account_group_id as agid,
			hs_company_id as crmid,
			'Overflow VFX' as seg
		from shotbot_production.account where account_id =234) as placeholder
	on duplicate key update
		`name` = aname,
        nickname = anickname,
        account_group_id = agid,
        crm_account_id = crmid,
        segment_label = seg; 
 
insert into s2_prodn.`show`
	(show_id,show_name,show_actual_name,win_status,stage,show_billing_type,account_id,show_type,studio,
     date_bid_start, date_nda_execute, date_work_start, date_inactive, date_close, date_go_public, date_show_release,
     textblock_show_info, textblock_marketing_info,textblock_billing_info, bill_to, textblock_billing_address,
     billing_metro,payment_terms,production_metro,security_sensitivity,showcase_value,native_timezone,facility_code,
     archival_target_date,archival_status,archival_type)
	select * from 
		(select 
			show_id as sid,
			show_name as sname,
			show_real_name as saname,
			win_status as win,
			stage as stg,
			'Billable' as billing_type,
			234 as actid, 
			show_type as stype,
			studio as studioname,
			bid_start_date as date_bid,
			nda_exec_date as date_nda,
			work_start_date as date_start,
			inactive_date as date_inact,
			close_date as date_cls,
			go_public_date as date_public,
			release_date as date_rel,
			show_info_block as sinfo,
			marketing_info_block as minfo,
			billing_info_block as binfo,
			bill_to as billto,
			concat(billing_addr1," ",billing_addr2," ",billing_city,",",billing_state," ",billing_country,billing_zip) as billaddr,
			billing_metro as bmetro,
			payment_structure as pterms,
			production_metro as pmetro,
			content_sensitivity as sensitivity,
			marketing_value_rating as mvalue,
			native_timezone as timez,
			'LBR' as facil,
			archival_target_date as archdate,
			archival_status as archstat,
			archival_type as archtype
		from shotbot_production.`show` where show_id=4054) as placeholder
	on duplicate key update
            show_name = sname,
            show_actual_name = saname,
            win_status = win,
            stage = stg,
            show_billing_type = billing_type,
            account_id = actid,
            show_type = stype,
            studio = studioname,
			date_bid_start = date_bid, 
            date_nda_execute = date_nda, 
            date_work_start = date_start, 
            date_inactive = date_inact, 
            date_close = date_cls, 
            date_go_public = date_public, 
            date_show_release = date_rel,
			textblock_show_info = sinfo, 
            textblock_marketing_info = minfo,
            textblock_billing_info = binfo, 
            bill_to = billto, 
            textblock_billing_address = billaddr,
			billing_metro = bmetro,
            payment_terms = pterms,
            production_metro = pmetro,
            security_sensitivity = sensitivity,
            showcase_value = mvalue,
            native_timezone = timez,
            facility_code = facil,
			archival_target_date =archdate,
            archival_status = archstat,
            archival_type = archtype;
    

insert into obj_group
	(show_id,group_name)
	select 4054,grp_name from (select distinct group_id as grp_name from shotbot_production.shottask where show_id=4054) as p;
    

insert into object
	(show_id,group_id,obj_type,obj_name,`description`,shot_frame_start,shot_frame_end)
	select * from (select st.show_id as show_id,
				og.group_id as grp_id,
				'Shot' as objtype,
			   if(locate("_roto",shottask_id)>0,substring_index(shottask_id,"_roto",1),
					if(locate("_paint",shottask_id)>0,substring_index(shottask_id,"_paint",1),shottask_id)) as objname,
				shot_desc as `descr`,
				shot_start_frame as frstart,
				shot_end_frame as frend
		from shotbot_production.shottask as st left join obj_group as og on (st.group_id = og.group_name and og.show_id=4054)
			where st.show_id=4054) as placeholder
on duplicate key update
	group_id = grp_id,
    obj_type = objtype,
    obj_name = objname,
    `description` = descr,
    shot_frame_start = frstart,
    shot_frame_end = frend;
    
    
 insert into service
 (object_id,service_type_id,status_label,client_service_desc,bot_service_notes,client_priority,
   service_complexity,pd_bid,pd_approved,showcase_value,date_client_due,date_bot_due,date_final_due,work_to_date_pct,work_to_date_notes)
 select * from (select 
                (select object_id from object where obj_name= (if(locate("_roto",shottask_id)>0,substring_index(shottask_id,"_roto",1),
					if(locate("_paint",shottask_id)>0,substring_index(shottask_id,"_paint",1),shottask_id)))) as obj_id,
				if(locate("_roto",shottask_id)>0,2,if(locate("_paint",shottask_id)>0,3,1)) as svc_type_id,
				case 
					when prodn_status="AI" then "AI"
                    when prodn_status="NS" then "Pend"
                    when prodn_status="S" then "Pend"
                    when prodn_status="WIP" then "WIP"
                    when prodn_status="RWIP" then "reWIP"
                    when prodn_status="U" then "Deliv"
                    when prodn_status="A" then "Appr"
                    when prodn_status="H" then "Hold"
                    when prodn_status="O" then "Omit"
                    when prodn_status="F" then "reWIP"
					else null
				end as status_label,
                client_task_desc as client_service_desc,
                bot_task_desc as bot_service_notes,
                case client_priority
					when "None" then "Normal"
                    else client_priority
				end as client_priority,
                complexity as service_complexity,
                bid_pd as pd_bid,
                approved_pd as pd_approved,
                showcase_value,
                client_due_date as date_client_due,
				bot_due_date as date_bot_due,
				final_due as date_final_due,
                wtd_pct/100 as work_to_date_pct,
				wtd_notes as work_to_date_notes
                
		from shotbot_production.shottask as st left join obj_group as og on (st.group_id = og.group_name and og.show_id=4054)
			where st.show_id=4054) as placeholder;
END
vermillion_load2 
CREATE  PROCEDURE `vermillion_load2`()
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE obj_id INT;
  DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT object_id FROM object where show_id=4054;
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;

  OPEN cur1;

  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur1 INTO obj_id;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
    call triggercall_object(obj_id,4054,null);
  END LOOP;

  CLOSE cur1;
END
